import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.HeckeCoefficientHolomorphicSeries
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.TauDiscriminantSeriesPrefix
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.NomeTauDiscriminantAgreement

namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert DomainFunctions

def tauComplexCoefficient (n : Nat) : ComplexRaw := scaleRat (tau n : Rat) one

theorem tauComplexCoefficient_valid (n : Nat) : (tauComplexCoefficient n).Valid :=
  scaleRat_valid (ofQComplex_valid _)

theorem tauComplexCoefficient_bound (n : Nat) : Small (tauComplexCoefficient n) (2*(256:Rat)^n) := by
  have ho : Small one 1 := by
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · intro k l; change (-1:Rat)≤1; decide +kernel
    · intro k l; change (1:Rat)≤1; decide +kernel
    · intro k l; change (-1:Rat)≤0; decide +kernel
    · intro k l; change (0:Rat)≤1; decide +kernel
  have hs := small_scale_integer one (ofQComplex_valid _) 1 ho (tau n)
  rw [Rat.mul_one] at hs
  exact hs.mono (tau_absolute_exponential_bound n)

/-- Ordinary integer prefixes are literal bounded-series prefixes. -/
theorem integerCoefficientPrefix_boundedSeries (a : Nat → Int) (q : Scalar) (N : Nat) :
    (BoundedSeries.valueBlock (fun n => scaleRat (a n : Rat) one) q.val 0 N).Equiv
      (integerCoefficientPrefix a q N).val := by
  induction N with
  | zero => exact equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid _)
  | succ N ih =>
    have hp := LocalODE.power_valid _ q.property N
    have ht : (mul (scaleRat (a N:Rat) one) (LocalODE.power q.val N)).Equiv
        (scaleRat (a N:Rat) (LocalODE.power q.val N)) := by
      apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
        (hleft := mul_valid (scaleRat_valid (ofQComplex_valid _)) hp)
        (hright := scaleRat_valid hp)
      change ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (a N:Rat) 1*
        ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (LocalODE.power q.val N) hp=
        ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (a N:Rat) (ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (LocalODE.power q.val N) hp)
      rw [←ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat_mul]
      congr 1
      grind only
    simp only [BoundedSeries.valueBlock,Nat.zero_add,integerCoefficientPrefix]
    exact add_equiv ih ht

/-- The bounded sum with literal full tau coefficients agrees with the
actual normalized discriminant throughout the supplied small nome disk. -/
theorem tauBoundedSeries_nome_discriminant_agreement (q : Scalar)
    (hq : tauEulerNomeDomain q) (hs : Small q.val (1/2048)) :
    (BoundedSeries.sumValue tauComplexCoefficient q.val tauComplexCoefficient_valid q.property
      2 256 (1/2048)).Equiv (nomeNormalizedDiscriminantMap.eval q hq).val := by
  let F := BoundedSeries.sumValue tauComplexCoefficient q.val tauComplexCoefficient_valid q.property
    2 256 (1/2048)
  let G := mul (tauSeriesValue q (LocalODE.interior_bound _ q hq)).val q.val
  have hF : F.Valid := BoundedSeries.sumValue_valid _ _ tauComplexCoefficient_valid q.property
    2 256 (1/2048) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel)
    tauComplexCoefficient_bound hs (by decide +kernel)
  have hG : G.Valid := mul_valid (tauSeriesValue q (LocalODE.interior_bound _ q hq)).property q.property
  let E := fun N => LocalODE.valueTail 2 256 (1/2048) (N+1)
  have hE : ShrinksToZero E := SeriesLimitLaws.shrinks_shift _
    (LocalODE.tail_bound_shrinks 2 (2*256*(1/2048)) (by decide +kernel)
      (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel)) 1
  have hEn (N : Nat) : 0≤E N := Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide +kernel) (Rat.pow_nonneg (by decide +kernel))
  have he : F.Equiv G := by
    apply RepresentedCauchySum.unique
      (fun N => (integerCoefficientPrefix tau q (N+1)).val)
      (fun N => (integerCoefficientPrefix tau q (N+1)).property)
      (fun N => E N+tauDiscriminantPrefixError N)
      (RepresentedCauchySum.sum_shrinks _ _ hE tauDiscriminantPrefixError_shrinks) F G hF hG
    · intro N
      have hb := BoundedSeries.sumValue_close_prefix tauComplexCoefficient q.val
        tauComplexCoefficient_valid q.property 2 256 (1/2048)
        (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel)
        tauComplexCoefficient_bound hs (by decide +kernel) (N+1)
      have ht := Small.congr
        (sub_valid hF (BoundedSeries.valueBlock_valid _ _ tauComplexCoefficient_valid q.property 0 (N+1)))
        (sub_valid hF (integerCoefficientPrefix tau q (N+1)).property)
        (FunctionTheory.sub_congr (equiv_refl _ hF)
          (integerCoefficientPrefix_boundedSeries tau q (N+1))) hb
      exact ht.mono (by have h := tauDiscriminantPrefixError_nonnegative N; change E N≤_; grind only)
    · intro N
      exact (tauDiscriminantSeries_close_prefix q (LocalODE.interior_bound _ q hq) N).mono
        (by have h := hEn N; grind only)
  exact equiv_trans hF hG (nomeNormalizedDiscriminantMap.eval q hq).property he
    (equiv_symm (nomeNormalizedDiscriminantMap_tau_series q hq))

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.PrimeHeckeNomeVanishing
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.TauBoundedSeriesAgreement
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.BoundedSeriesIntegerScaling
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.BoundedSeriesCoefficientUniqueness
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.HeckeCoefficients

namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert DomainFunctions

/-- Coefficient extraction from the proved actual modular eigenform identity. -/
theorem discriminantPrimeHecke_coefficients_eigenvector (p : Nat) (hp : BasicPrime p)
    (hpR : 0<(p:Rat)) (n : Nat) :
    discriminantHeckeCoefficients p n=tau p*tau n := by
  let C := heckeCoefficientGrowthConstant p
  let K := heckeCoefficientGrowthBase p
  let R := heckeCoefficientSeriesRadius p
  let M : Rat := ((tau p).natAbs:Rat)
  let c : Nat → Scalar := fun n => ⟨heckeComplexCoefficient p n,heckeComplexCoefficient_valid p n⟩
  let d : Nat → Scalar := fun n => ⟨scaleRat (tau p:Rat) (tauComplexCoefficient n),
    scaleRat_valid (tauComplexCoefficient_valid n)⟩
  let rho : QPos := ⟨(heckeDifferenceNomeRadius p).val/2,
    Rat.mul_pos (heckeDifferenceNomeRadius p).property (by decide +kernel)⟩
  have hC := heckeCoefficientGrowthConstant_nonnegative p
  have hK := Rat.le_of_lt (heckeCoefficientGrowthBase_positive p)
  have hR := Rat.le_of_lt (heckeCoefficientSeriesRadius_positive p)
  have hM : 0≤M := Rat.natCast_nonneg
  have hd (j : Nat) : Small (d j).val ((M*2)*(256:Rat)^j) := by
    have h := small_scale_integer (tauComplexCoefficient j) (tauComplexCoefficient_valid j)
      (2*(256:Rat)^j) (tauComplexCoefficient_bound j) (tau p)
    simpa only [Rat.mul_assoc] using h
  have hl : 2*K*R≤(1:Rat)/2 := by
    have h := heckeCoefficientSeriesRadius_local p
    have hKR := Rat.mul_nonneg hK hR
    dsimp [K,R] at *
    grind only
  have hrho : rho.val<(heckeDifferenceNomeRadius p).val := by
    have h := (heckeDifferenceNomeRadius p).property
    dsimp [rho]
    grind only
  have hcommon := QPos.minimum_le_left (heckeCuspExtensionRadius p) ⟨1/2048,by decide +kernel⟩
  have hsmall := QPos.minimum_le_right (heckeCuspExtensionRadius p) ⟨1/2048,by decide +kernel⟩
  have hrR : rho.val≤R := by
    have h := heckeCuspExtensionRadius_series p
    change (heckeDifferenceNomeRadius p).val≤(heckeCuspExtensionRadius p).val at hcommon
    dsimp [R]
    grind only
  have hrS : rho.val≤(1:Rat)/2048 := by
    change (heckeDifferenceNomeRadius p).val≤(1:Rat)/2048 at hsmall
    grind only
  have he := boundedSeries_coefficients_unique c d C K R (M*2) 256 (1/2048)
    hC hK hR (Rat.mul_nonneg hM (by decide +kernel)) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel)
    (heckeComplexCoefficient_bound p) hd hl (by decide +kernel) rho hrR hrS
    (by
      intro r hr
      let q := realStep r
      have hqr : r.val<(heckeDifferenceNomeRadius p).val := by grind only
      have hq : heckeDifferenceNomeDomain p q :=
        ⟨r.val,Rat.le_of_lt r.property,hqr,realStep_small r⟩
      have hqs : Small q.val (1/2048) := (realStep_small r).mono (Rat.le_trans hr hrS)
      let H := (heckeCoefficientSeriesMap p).eval q
      let T := BoundedSeries.sumValue tauComplexCoefficient q.val tauComplexCoefficient_valid q.property 2 256 (1/2048)
      let ht := heckeDifferenceNomeDomain_tau p q hq
      let D := nomeNormalizedDiscriminantMap.eval q ht
      have hD := tauBoundedSeries_nome_discriminant_agreement q ht hqs
      have hT := BoundedSeries.sumValue_valid tauComplexCoefficient q.val tauComplexCoefficient_valid q.property
        2 256 (1/2048) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel)
        tauComplexCoefficient_bound hqs (by decide +kernel)
      have hH := (heckeCoefficientSeriesMap p).valid q (heckeDifferenceNomeDomain_series p q hq)
      have hzero := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_eq_ofRaw
        (hleft := ((discriminantPrimeHeckeDifferenceNome p).eval q hq).property)
        (hright := ofQComplex_valid _) (discriminantPrimeHeckeDifferenceNome_global_zero p hp hpR q hq)
      have hactual : H.Equiv (scaleRat (tau p:Rat) D.val) := by
        let A := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw H hH
        let B := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw D.val D.property
        change A+ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (-(tau p:Rat)) 1*B=0 at hzero
        rw [←ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat_mul] at hzero
        have hone : (1:ScalarAlgebra.Value)*B=B := by grind only
        rw [hone,←ComplexRawQuotient.neg_scaleRat] at hzero
        apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq (hleft := hH) (hright := scaleRat_valid D.property)
        change A=ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (tau p:Rat) B
        grind only
      have hscaled := boundedSeries_integer_scaling tauComplexCoefficient tauComplexCoefficient_valid q (tau p)
        2 256 (1/2048) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel)
        tauComplexCoefficient_bound hqs (by decide +kernel)
      have hweighted := scaleRat_equiv (r := (tau p:Rat)) (equiv_symm hD)
      have hleft := equiv_trans hH (scaleRat_valid D.property) (scaleRat_valid hT) hactual hweighted
      exact equiv_trans hH (scaleRat_valid hT)
        (BoundedSeries.sumValue_valid _ _ (fun j => (d j).property) q.property (M*2) 256 (1/2048)
          (Rat.mul_nonneg hM (by decide +kernel)) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) hd hqs (by decide +kernel))
        hleft (equiv_symm hscaled)) n
  have hprod := ComplexRaw.scaleRat_scaleRat_equiv (tau p:Rat) (tau n:Rat) one (ofQComplex_valid _)
  have heq := equiv_trans (c n).property (d n).property (scaleRat_valid (ofQComplex_valid _)) he hprod
  have hreal := (RealRaw.compareAt_overlap_iff _ _ 0 0).1 (realPart_equiv heq 0)
  have hrat : (discriminantHeckeCoefficients p n:Rat)=(tau p:Rat)*(tau n:Rat) := by
    dsimp [c,heckeComplexCoefficient,realPart,scaleRat,one,ofQComplex,QBox.scaleRat,
      QComplex.scaleRat,QComplex.one,QInterval.Overlaps] at hreal
    split at hreal <;> split at hreal <;> grind only
  exact_mod_cast hrat

/-- The literal tau coefficients satisfy every prime-index Hecke equation. -/
theorem tau_prime_hecke_eigenvector (p : Nat) (hp : BasicPrime p) :
    IsHeckeEigenvector p tau (tau p) := by
  have hpR : 0<(p:Rat) := Rat.natCast_pos.mpr (by have h := hp.1; omega)
  intro n
  have h := discriminantPrimeHecke_coefficients_eigenvector p hp hpR n
  simp only [hecke12,discriminantHeckeCoefficients,heckeDilationCoefficients,Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero] at h ⊢
  by_cases hn : n%p=0 <;> simpa only [hn,ite_true,ite_false,Int.mul_zero] using h

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

/-- Any actual repeated Hecke value satisfies the checked integer diagonal.
This law does not assume the numerical value of the singular modulus. -/
theorem hecke41_repeated_j_diagonal_root (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val)
    (i : Fin 42)
    (he : (latticeJMap.eval (hecke41Point i z)
      (latticeJMap_global_domain _ (hecke41Point_upper i z hz))).val.Equiv
      (latticeJMap.eval z (latticeJMap_global_domain z hz)).val) :
    Root (integerPolynomialEmbedding hecke41DiagonalCandidate)
      ⟨(latticeJMap.eval z (latticeJMap_global_domain z hz)).val,
        (latticeJMap.eval z (latticeJMap_global_domain z hz)).property⟩ := by
  let hd : hecke41CommonDomain z := ⟨hz,fun k =>
    latticeJMap_global_domain _ (hecke41Point_upper k z hz)⟩
  let J := latticeJMap.eval z (latticeJMap_global_domain z hz)
  have hm : hecke41JCert z hd.2 i ∈ List.ofFn (hecke41JCert z hd.2)  := List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i,rfl⟩
  have hr := rootProduct_zero_of_mem (List.ofFn (hecke41JCert z hd.2)) _ hm
  have hc : Root (hecke41RootPolynomial z hd.2) ⟨J.val,J.property⟩ :=
    root_congr (equivalent_refl _) he (certTrans (eval_rootPolynomial _ _) hr)
  have hp : Root (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 J) ⟨J.val,J.property⟩ :=
    root_congr (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41_equivalent z hz)
      (equiv_refl _ J.property) hc
  rw [←hecke41Diagonal_agreement_of_newton hecke41ExpandedNewton_cellwise_actualAgreement]
  exact equiv_trans
    (eval (integerPolynomialEmbedding integerHeckeDiagonalPolynomial41) ⟨J.val,J.property⟩).valid
    (eval (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 J) ⟨J.val,J.property⟩).valid zero.valid
    (integerHeckeDiagonalPolynomial41_eval J) hp

    Root (integerPolynomialEmbedding hecke41DiagonalCandidate) ⟨cmJValue43.val,cmJValue43.property⟩ :=

namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

/-- Integer first-argument coefficients for each second-argument degree. -/
def integerHeckeIntegerRow41 (i : Fin 43) : List Int :=
  if i.val=42 then [1] else
    integerPrincipalPartPolynomialList (integerHeckePrincipalCutoff41 (41-i.val))
      (integerHeckePrincipalPolynomialCoefficients41 (41-i.val))
      (integerHeckePrincipalCutoff41 (41-i.val)+1)

/-- The integer diagonal polynomial, built by finite addition and shifts.
Its coefficients are independent of every represented analytic argument. -/
def integerHeckeDiagonalPolynomial41 : List Int :=
  integerPolynomialDiagonal (List.ofFn integerHeckeIntegerRow41)

private theorem one_eval (J : Scalar) :
    (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerPolynomialEmbedding [1]) ⟨J.val,J.property⟩).raw.Equiv one := by
  apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
    (hleft := (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerPolynomialEmbedding [1]) ⟨J.val,J.property⟩).valid)
    (hright := ofQComplex_valid QComplex.one)
  change RepresentedPolynomial.certClass (RepresentedPolynomial.eval
    (integerPolynomialEmbedding [1]) ⟨J.val,J.property⟩)=1
  rw [integerPolynomialEmbedding_eval_class]
  change ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat ((1:Int):Rat) 1+
    RepresentedPolynomial.certClass ⟨J.val,J.property⟩*0=1
  rw [show ((1:Int):Rat)=1 by decide +kernel,ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat_one]
  grind only

private theorem rows_equivalent (J : Scalar) :
    RepresentedPolynomial.Equivalent
      ((List.ofFn integerHeckeIntegerRow41).map (fun p =>
        RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerPolynomialEmbedding p) ⟨J.val,J.property⟩))
      (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 J) := by
  rw [List.map_ofFn]
  apply RepresentedPolynomial.equivalent_ofFn
  intro i
  change (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerPolynomialEmbedding (integerHeckeIntegerRow41 i))
    ⟨J.val,J.property⟩).raw.Equiv (integerHeckeRecoveredCoefficient41 J i).raw
  by_cases hi : i.val=42
  · simp only [integerHeckeIntegerRow41,integerHeckeRecoveredCoefficient41,if_pos hi]
    exact one_eval J
  · simp only [integerHeckeIntegerRow41,integerHeckeRecoveredCoefficient41,if_neg hi]
    exact integerPrincipalPartPolynomialList_eval _ _ J

/-- Flattening the bivariate diagonal preserves its actual Horner value
at every valid represented complex input. -/
theorem integerHeckeDiagonalPolynomial41_eval (J : Scalar) :
    (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerPolynomialEmbedding integerHeckeDiagonalPolynomial41)
      ⟨J.val,J.property⟩).raw.Equiv
      (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 J)
        ⟨J.val,J.property⟩).raw :=
  equiv_trans (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerPolynomialEmbedding integerHeckeDiagonalPolynomial41)
      ⟨J.val,J.property⟩).valid
    (RepresentedPolynomial.eval ((List.ofFn integerHeckeIntegerRow41).map (fun p =>
      RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerPolynomialEmbedding p) ⟨J.val,J.property⟩))
      ⟨J.val,J.property⟩).valid
    (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 J) ⟨J.val,J.property⟩).valid
    (integerPolynomialDiagonal_eval (List.ofFn integerHeckeIntegerRow41) ⟨J.val,J.property⟩)
    (RepresentedPolynomial.eval_equiv (rows_equivalent J) (equiv_refl _ J.property))

/-- The concrete CM value is an exact root of a literal integer polynomial
constructed from the actual modular correspondence. -/
theorem cmJValue163_integer_diagonal_root :
    RepresentedPolynomial.Root (integerPolynomialEmbedding integerHeckeDiagonalPolynomial41)
      ⟨cmJValue163.val,cmJValue163.property⟩ :=
  equiv_trans (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerPolynomialEmbedding integerHeckeDiagonalPolynomial41)
      ⟨cmJValue163.val,cmJValue163.property⟩).valid
    (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 cmJValue163)
      ⟨cmJValue163.val,cmJValue163.property⟩).valid
    RepresentedPolynomial.zero.valid (integerHeckeDiagonalPolynomial41_eval cmJValue163)
    cmJValue163_recovered_polynomial_root

/-! Exact modular fixed-point laws for the actual lattice sums and j function.
These laws use genuine transformation and fixed-point evidence; they do not
assume algebraicity or a class-polynomial certificate. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open ComplexRaw RiemannHilbert FunctionTheory

/-- A value multiplied by a nonidentity scalar can be fixed only if it vanishes. -/
theorem modular_weight_fixed_value_zero (x m : Scalar)
    (h : x.val.Equiv (mul m.val x.val))
    (hm : ¬m.val.Equiv (ofQComplex QComplex.one)) :
    x.val.Equiv zero := by
  let X := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw x.val x.property
  let M := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw m.val m.property
  have he : X=M*X := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_eq_ofRaw h
  have hn : M-1≠0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hm
    apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
      (hleft := m.property) (hright := ofQComplex_valid _)
    change M=1
    grind only
  apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
    (hleft := x.property) (hright := ofQComplex_valid _)
  change X=0
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hx
  apply scalarClass_mul_nonzero (M-1) X hn hx
  grind only

theorem upperWeightFour_zero_of_modular_fixed (g : SL2Z) (z : Scalar)
    (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val)
    (hfix : (fractionalLinear g z hz).val.Equiv z.val)
    (hm : ¬(LocalODE.power (integerAffine g.c g.d z.val) 4).Equiv
      (ofQComplex QComplex.one)) :
    (upperWeightFourLatticeSum z hz).Equiv zero := by
  apply modular_weight_fixed_value_zero
    ⟨upperWeightFourLatticeSum z hz,upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid z hz⟩
    ⟨LocalODE.power (integerAffine g.c g.d z.val) 4,
      LocalODE.power_valid _ (integerAffine_valid _ _ z.property) 4⟩ _ hm
  exact equiv_trans (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid z hz)
    (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid _ (fractionalLinear_mem g z hz))
    (mul_valid (LocalODE.power_valid _ (integerAffine_valid _ _ z.property) 4)
      (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid z hz))
    (equiv_symm (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_congr _ _ _ hz hfix))
    (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_action g z hz)

theorem upperWeightSix_zero_of_modular_fixed (g : SL2Z) (z : Scalar)
    (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val)
    (hfix : (fractionalLinear g z hz).val.Equiv z.val)
    (hm : ¬(LocalODE.power (integerAffine g.c g.d z.val) 6).Equiv
      (ofQComplex QComplex.one)) :
    (upperWeightSixLatticeSum z hz).Equiv zero := by
  apply modular_weight_fixed_value_zero
    ⟨upperWeightSixLatticeSum z hz,upperWeightSixLatticeSum_valid z hz⟩
    ⟨LocalODE.power (integerAffine g.c g.d z.val) 6,
      LocalODE.power_valid _ (integerAffine_valid _ _ z.property) 6⟩ _ hm
  exact equiv_trans (upperWeightSixLatticeSum_valid z hz)
    (upperWeightSixLatticeSum_valid _ (fractionalLinear_mem g z hz))
    (mul_valid (LocalODE.power_valid _ (integerAffine_valid _ _ z.property) 6)
      (upperWeightSixLatticeSum_valid z hz))
    (equiv_symm (upperWeightSixLatticeSum_congr _ _ _ hz hfix))
    (upperWeightSixLatticeSum_action g z hz)

theorem latticeJMap_value_of_weightFour_zero (z : Scalar)
    (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val)
    (h4 : (upperWeightFourLatticeSum z hz).Equiv zero) :
    (latticeJMap.eval z (latticeJMap_global_domain z hz)).val.Equiv zero := by
  have he := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_eq_ofRaw
    (hleft := upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid z hz) (hright := ofQComplex_valid _) h4
  apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
    (hleft := (latticeJMap.eval z (latticeJMap_global_domain z hz)).property)
    (hright := ofQComplex_valid _)
  let V := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (upperWeightFourLatticeSum z hz)
    (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid z hz)
  let R := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw
    (RepresentedReciprocal.inverse (latticeDiscriminantMap.eval z hz)
      (latticeDiscriminantMap_global_nonzero z hz)).val
    (RepresentedReciprocal.inverse (latticeDiscriminantMap.eval z hz)
      (latticeDiscriminantMap_global_nonzero z hz)).property
  let C60 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofQComplex ⟨60,0⟩
  let C := ComplexRawQuotient.ofQComplex ⟨1728,0⟩
  change V=0 at he
  change R*(C*(((C60*V)*(C60*V))*(C60*V)))=0
  rw [he]
  grind only

theorem latticeJMap_value_of_weightSix_zero (z : Scalar)
    (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val)
    (h6 : (upperWeightSixLatticeSum z hz).Equiv zero) :
    (latticeJMap.eval z (latticeJMap_global_domain z hz)).val.Equiv
      (ofQComplex ⟨1728,0⟩) := by
  let D := latticeDiscriminantMap.eval z hz
  let R := RepresentedReciprocal.inverse D (latticeDiscriminantMap_global_nonzero z hz)
  let N := latticeG2CubeMap.eval z hz
  let DV := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw D.val D.property
  let RV := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw R.val R.property
  let NV := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw N.val N.property
  let V6 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (upperWeightSixLatticeSum z hz)
    (upperWeightSixLatticeSum_valid z hz)
  let C140 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofQComplex ⟨140,0⟩
  let C27 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofQComplex ⟨27,0⟩
  let C := ComplexRawQuotient.ofQComplex ⟨1728,0⟩
  have he : V6=0 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_eq_ofRaw h6
  have hd : DV=NV := by
    change NV + -(C27*((C140*V6)*(C140*V6)))=NV
    rw [he]
    grind only
  have hi : DV*RV=1 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_eq_ofRaw
    (RepresentedReciprocal.mul_inverse D (latticeDiscriminantMap_global_nonzero z hz))
  apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
    (hleft := (latticeJMap.eval z (latticeJMap_global_domain z hz)).property)
    (hright := ofQComplex_valid _)
  change RV*(C*NV)=C
  grind only

/-- At a modular fixed point with nontrivial weight-four multiplier, j is zero. -/
theorem latticeJMap_zero_of_modular_fixed (g : SL2Z) (z : Scalar)
    (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val)
    (hfix : (fractionalLinear g z hz).val.Equiv z.val)
    (hm : ¬(LocalODE.power (integerAffine g.c g.d z.val) 4).Equiv
      (ofQComplex QComplex.one)) :
    (latticeJMap.eval z (latticeJMap_global_domain z hz)).val.Equiv zero :=
  latticeJMap_value_of_weightFour_zero z hz
    (upperWeightFour_zero_of_modular_fixed g z hz hfix hm)

/-- At a modular fixed point with nontrivial weight-six multiplier, j is 1728. -/
theorem latticeJMap_1728_of_modular_fixed (g : SL2Z) (z : Scalar)
    (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val)
    (hfix : (fractionalLinear g z hz).val.Equiv z.val)
    (hm : ¬(LocalODE.power (integerAffine g.c g.d z.val) 6).Equiv
      (ofQComplex QComplex.one)) :
    (latticeJMap.eval z (latticeJMap_global_domain z hz)).val.Equiv
      (ofQComplex ⟨1728,0⟩) :=
  latticeJMap_value_of_weightSix_zero z hz
    (upperWeightSix_zero_of_modular_fixed g z hz hfix hm)

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

/-! Magnitude and sign of the actual CM j error, without assuming the CM integer identity. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

  let q := nome.eval cmScalar43 cmPoint43_upper
  let u := RepresentedReciprocal.inverse q (nome_nonzero cmScalar43 cmPoint43_upper)
  ⟨sub cmJValue43.val (add (add u.val (ofQComplex ⟨744,0⟩)) (scaleRat 196884 q.val)),
    sub_valid cmJValue43.property (add_valid (add_valid u.property (ofQComplex_valid _))
      (scaleRat_valid q.property))⟩

private theorem cancellation (J U K L : ScalarAlgebra.Value) :
    (J-((U+K)+L))+L=J-(U+K) := by grind only

private theorem error_decomposition :
    (add linearError.val (scaleRat 196884 (nome.eval cmScalar43 cmPoint43_upper).val)).Equiv
      cmJGrowthError43.val := by
  let q := nome.eval cmScalar43 cmPoint43_upper
  let u := RepresentedReciprocal.inverse q (nome_nonzero cmScalar43 cmPoint43_upper)
  have hc : (add linearError.val (scaleRat 196884 q.val)).Equiv
      (sub cmJValue43.val (add u.val (ofQComplex ⟨744,0⟩))) := by
    apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
      (hleft := add_valid linearError.property (scaleRat_valid q.property))
      (hright := sub_valid cmJValue43.property (add_valid u.property (ofQComplex_valid _)))
    let J := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw cmJValue43.val cmJValue43.property
    let U := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw u.val u.property
    let K := ComplexRawQuotient.ofQComplex ⟨744,0⟩
    let L := ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat 196884 (ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw q.val q.property)
    change (J-((U+K)+L))+L=J-(U+K)
    exact cancellation J U K L
  have hn := FunctionTheory.sub_congr (equiv_refl cmJValue43.val cmJValue43.property)
    (ComplexRaw.add_equiv cmNomeInverse43_growth (equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid ⟨744,0⟩)))
  exact equiv_trans (add_valid linearError.property (scaleRat_valid q.property))
    (sub_valid cmJValue43.property (add_valid u.property (ofQComplex_valid _)))
    cmJGrowthError43.property hc hn

/-- The actual CM j versus growth error is below the desired three ten-thousandths. -/

  have h := LocalODE.small_add cmJValue43_linear_laurent_bound
    (LocalODE.small_scale (show (0:Rat)≤196884 by decide +kernel) nome_cm43_small)

    (add_valid linearError.property (scaleRat_valid (nome.eval cmScalar43 cmPoint43_upper).property))
    cmJGrowthError43.property error_decomposition h

    · exact hx

    unfold maxRat2
    split <;> grind only

  change (1/(1400000000:Rat))≤((RealRaw.positiveReciprocal cmGrowthValue43 750000000).compute m).hi
  rw [RealRaw.positiveReciprocal_compute cmGrowthValue43 750000000 (by decide +kernel) m]

/-- The actual CM j versus growth error has a strictly negative real part. -/
theorem cmJGrowthError43_real_upper_negative :
    cmJGrowthError43.val.realPart.Le (RealRaw.ofRat (-1/10000)) := by
  let q := nome.eval cmScalar43 cmPoint43_upper
  let s : Scalar := ⟨add linearError.val (scaleRat 196884 q.val),
    add_valid linearError.property (scaleRat_valid q.property)⟩

    (realPart_equiv (equiv_symm error_decomposition))
  exact RealRaw.le_trans (realPart_valid s.property) hi hs

theorem cmJGrowthDeficit43_valid : cmJGrowthDeficit43.Valid :=

  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := cmJGrowthDeficit43_valid.2.2 (⟨1/100000,by decide +kernel⟩ : QPos)

  unfold QInterval.width at hw

  change 0<(cmJGrowthDeficit43.compute N).lo
  grind only

def cmIntegerGrowthDeficit43 : RealRaw :=
  RealRaw.add (RealRaw.ofRat 884736744) (RealRaw.neg cmGrowthValue43)

  RealRaw.add_valid (RealRaw.ofRat_valid _) (RealRaw.neg_valid (realPart_valid (entireExponentialValue cmGrowthExponent43).property))

theorem cmIntegerGrowthDeficit43_agreement_of_cm_value
    (hcm : cmJValue43.val.Equiv (ofQComplex ⟨-((960:Rat)^3),0⟩)) :
    cmJGrowthDeficit43.Equiv cmIntegerGrowthDeficit43 := by
  let t : Scalar := ⟨add (neg (entireExponentialValue cmGrowthExponent43).val) (ofQComplex ⟨744,0⟩),
    add_valid (neg_valid (entireExponentialValue cmGrowthExponent43).property) (ofQComplex_valid _)⟩
  have he := RealRaw.neg_equiv (realPart_equiv
    (FunctionTheory.sub_congr hcm (equiv_refl t.val t.property)))
  have hc : (RealRaw.neg (sub (ofQComplex ⟨-((960:Rat)^3),0⟩) t.val).realPart).Equiv
      cmIntegerGrowthDeficit43 := by
    intro n

    have ho := RealRaw.interval_order_of_valid cmGrowthValue43
      (realPart_valid (entireExponentialValue cmGrowthExponent43).property) n
    have hk : -(-((960:Rat)^3))+744=884736744 := by decide +kernel
    change (-( -((960:Rat)^3)+ -(-(cmGrowthValue43.compute n).hi+744))≤
        884736744+ -(cmGrowthValue43.compute n).lo) ∧
      (884736744+ -(cmGrowthValue43.compute n).hi≤
        -( -((960:Rat)^3)+ -(-(cmGrowthValue43.compute n).lo+744)))
    constructor <;> grind only
  exact RealRaw.equiv_trans cmJGrowthDeficit43_valid
    (RealRaw.neg_valid (realPart_valid (sub_valid (ofQComplex_valid _) t.property)))
    cmIntegerGrowthDeficit43_valid he hc

/-- The proved analytic estimates imply the number-theoretic deficit bounds once the exact CM value is established. -/
theorem cmIntegerGrowthDeficit43_bounds_of_cm_value
    (hcm : cmJValue43.val.Equiv (ofQComplex ⟨-((960:Rat)^3),0⟩)) :
    (RealRaw.ofRat (1/10000)).Le cmIntegerGrowthDeficit43 ∧
      cmIntegerGrowthDeficit43.Le (RealRaw.ofRat (3/10000)) := by
  have he := cmIntegerGrowthDeficit43_agreement_of_cm_value hcm
  constructor
  · exact RealRaw.le_trans cmJGrowthDeficit43_valid cmJGrowthDeficit43_lower
      (RealRaw.le_of_equiv cmJGrowthDeficit43_valid cmIntegerGrowthDeficit43_valid he)
  · exact RealRaw.le_trans cmJGrowthDeficit43_valid
      (RealRaw.le_of_equiv cmIntegerGrowthDeficit43_valid cmJGrowthDeficit43_valid (RealRaw.equiv_symm he))
      cmJGrowthDeficit43_upper

    (RealRaw.add_valid (RealRaw.sub_valid (realPart_valid cmJValue43.property) main_valid) main_valid)
    (realPart_valid cmJValue43.property)
    (RealRaw.add_equiv (realPart_valid cmJGrowthError43.property)
      (RealRaw.sub_valid (realPart_valid cmJValue43.property) main_valid)
      main_valid main_valid error_agreement (RealRaw.equiv_refl mainTerm main_valid))
    (RealRaw.sub_add_cancel_equiv (realPart_valid cmJValue43.property) main_valid)

  · apply RealRaw.le_trans hv _

  have hg := cmGrowthExponential43_lower_sharp_power 0 n
  change (cmJGrowthError43.val.realPart.compute n).lo≤(4:Rat) at he

/-- Actual positive denominator for the interval substitution at the CM coordinate. -/
def cmJIsolationDenominator43 : RealRaw :=
  RealRaw.sub (RealRaw.ofRat (-750000000)) cmJValue43.val.realPart

theorem cmJIsolationDenominator43_valid : cmJIsolationDenominator43.Valid :=
  RealRaw.sub_valid (RealRaw.ofRat_valid _) (ComplexRaw.realPart_valid cmJValue43.property)

/-- Quantitative denominator separation is proved from the actual CM estimate. -/
theorem cmJIsolationDenominator43_lower :
    (RealRaw.ofRat 255).Le cmJIsolationDenominator43 := by
  intro n m
  have h := cmJValue43_real_isolation_upper_margin m 0
  change (cmJValue43.val.realPart.compute m).lo≤(-750000255:Rat) at h
  change (255:Rat)≤(-750000000:Rat)-(cmJValue43.val.realPart.compute m).lo

/-- A positive interval stage is obtained constructively from validity and the margin. -/
theorem cmJIsolationDenominator43_positive : cmJIsolationDenominator43.Pos := by

def cmJIsolationNumerator43 : RealRaw :=

theorem cmJIsolationNumerator43_valid : cmJIsolationNumerator43.Valid :=
  RealRaw.sub_valid (ComplexRaw.realPart_valid cmJValue43.property) (RealRaw.ofRat_valid _)

theorem cmJIsolationNumerator43_nonnegative :
    (RealRaw.ofRat 0).Le cmJIsolationNumerator43 := by
  intro n m
  have h := cmJValue43_real_isolation_bounds.1 0 m
  change (-1500000000:Rat)≤(cmJValue43.val.realPart.compute m).hi at h
  change (0:Rat)≤(cmJValue43.val.realPart.compute m).hi-(-1500000000:Rat)
  grind only

def cmJIsolationInverse43 : RealRaw := RealRaw.positiveReciprocal cmJIsolationDenominator43 255

theorem cmJIsolationInverse43_valid : cmJIsolationInverse43.Valid :=
  RealRaw.positiveReciprocal_valid _ _ cmJIsolationDenominator43_valid (by decide +kernel)
    (fun n => cmJIsolationDenominator43_lower 0 n)

theorem cmJIsolationInverse43_nonnegative :
    (RealRaw.ofRat 0).Le cmJIsolationInverse43 := by
  intro n m
  rw [show cmJIsolationInverse43=RealRaw.positiveReciprocal cmJIsolationDenominator43 255 by rfl,
    RealRaw.positiveReciprocal_compute _ _ (by decide +kernel) m]
  change (0:Rat)≤1/maxRat2 (cmJIsolationDenominator43.compute m).lo 255
  have h : (0:Rat)<maxRat2 (cmJIsolationDenominator43.compute m).lo 255 := by
    unfold maxRat2; split <;> grind only
  rw [Rat.div_def]
  exact Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide +kernel) (Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr h))

def cmJIsolationParameter43 : RealRaw := RealRaw.mul cmJIsolationNumerator43 cmJIsolationInverse43

theorem cmJIsolationParameter43_valid : cmJIsolationParameter43.Valid :=

/-- The actual constructed parameter is nonnegative on the full represented domain. -/

    (RealRaw.ofRat 0).Le cmJIsolationParameter43 := by
  intro n m
  have hn := cmJIsolationNumerator43_nonnegative 0 m
  have hi := cmJIsolationInverse43_nonnegative 0 m
  change (0:Rat)≤(cmJIsolationNumerator43.compute m).hi at hn
  change (0:Rat)≤(cmJIsolationInverse43.compute m).hi at hi
  have ho := QBox.mulRealInterval_contains
    (RealRaw.interval_order_of_valid _ cmJIsolationNumerator43_valid m)
    (Rat.le_refl : (cmJIsolationNumerator43.compute m).hi≤(cmJIsolationNumerator43.compute m).hi)
    (RealRaw.interval_order_of_valid _ cmJIsolationInverse43_valid m)
    (Rat.le_refl : (cmJIsolationInverse43.compute m).hi≤(cmJIsolationInverse43.compute m).hi)
  change (0:Rat)≤(QBox.mulRealInterval (cmJIsolationNumerator43.compute m).lo
    (cmJIsolationNumerator43.compute m).hi (cmJIsolationInverse43.compute m).lo
    (cmJIsolationInverse43.compute m).hi).hi
  exact Rat.le_trans (Rat.mul_nonneg hn hi) ho.2

this concrete denominator, using its proved margin. -/
theorem cmJIsolationInverse43_product_identity :
    (RealRaw.mul cmJIsolationDenominator43 cmJIsolationInverse43).Equiv RealRaw.one :=
  positiveReciprocal_mul_identity _ cmJIsolationDenominator43_valid 255
    (by decide +kernel) cmJIsolationDenominator43_lower

namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open RiemannHilbert

/-- Exact affine relation for the actual executable CM interval parameter. -/
theorem cmJIsolationParameter43_substitution :
    let T := realAxisClass cmJIsolationParameter43 cmJIsolationParameter43_valid
    let X := realAxisClass cmJValue43.val.realPart (ComplexRaw.realPart_valid cmJValue43.property)
    (1+T)*X=((-1500000000:Int):ScalarAlgebra.Value)+
      ((-750000000:Int):ScalarAlgebra.Value)*T := by
  dsimp only
  have hN : realAxisClass cmJIsolationNumerator43 cmJIsolationNumerator43_valid=
      realAxisClass cmJValue43.val.realPart (ComplexRaw.realPart_valid cmJValue43.property)-
        ((-1500000000:Int):ScalarAlgebra.Value) := by
    unfold cmJIsolationNumerator43
    have hc := realAxisClass_int (-1500000000)
    rw [show ((-1500000000:Int):Rat)=(-1500000000:Rat) by decide +kernel] at hc
    rw [realAxisClass_sub cmJValue43.val.realPart (RealRaw.ofRat (-1500000000))
      (ComplexRaw.realPart_valid cmJValue43.property) (RealRaw.ofRat_valid _),
      hc]
  have hD : realAxisClass cmJIsolationDenominator43 cmJIsolationDenominator43_valid=
      ((-750000000:Int):ScalarAlgebra.Value)-
        realAxisClass cmJValue43.val.realPart (ComplexRaw.realPart_valid cmJValue43.property) := by
    unfold cmJIsolationDenominator43
    have hc := realAxisClass_int (-750000000)
    rw [show ((-750000000:Int):Rat)=(-750000000:Rat) by decide +kernel] at hc
    rw [realAxisClass_sub (RealRaw.ofRat (-750000000)) cmJValue43.val.realPart
      (RealRaw.ofRat_valid _) (ComplexRaw.realPart_valid cmJValue43.property),
      hc]
  have hI := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_eq_ofRaw
    (hleft := ComplexRaw.ofRealRaw_valid _
      (RealRaw.mul_valid cmJIsolationDenominator43_valid cmJIsolationInverse43_valid))
    (hright := ComplexRaw.ofRealRaw_valid RealRaw.one (RealRaw.ofRat_valid 1))
    (ComplexRaw.ofRealRaw_equiv_of_equiv (y := RealRaw.one)
      (RealRaw.mul_valid cmJIsolationDenominator43_valid cmJIsolationInverse43_valid)
      (RealRaw.ofRat_valid 1) cmJIsolationInverse43_product_identity)
  change realAxisClass (RealRaw.mul cmJIsolationDenominator43 cmJIsolationInverse43)
      (RealRaw.mul_valid cmJIsolationDenominator43_valid cmJIsolationInverse43_valid)=
      realAxisClass RealRaw.one (RealRaw.ofRat_valid 1) at hI
  rw [realAxisClass_mul _ _ cmJIsolationDenominator43_valid cmJIsolationInverse43_valid,hD] at hI
  have hOne : realAxisClass RealRaw.one (RealRaw.ofRat_valid 1)=(1:ScalarAlgebra.Value) := by
    have h := realAxisClass_int 1
    change realAxisClass RealRaw.one (RealRaw.ofRat_valid 1)=((1:Int):ScalarAlgebra.Value) at h
    rw [h]; grind only
  rw [hOne] at hI
  have hT : realAxisClass cmJIsolationParameter43 cmJIsolationParameter43_valid=
      (realAxisClass cmJValue43.val.realPart (ComplexRaw.realPart_valid cmJValue43.property)-
        ((-1500000000:Int):ScalarAlgebra.Value))*
      realAxisClass cmJIsolationInverse43 cmJIsolationInverse43_valid := by
    change realAxisClass (RealRaw.mul cmJIsolationNumerator43 cmJIsolationInverse43)
      (RealRaw.mul_valid cmJIsolationNumerator43_valid cmJIsolationInverse43_valid)=_
    rw [realAxisClass_mul _ _ cmJIsolationNumerator43_valid cmJIsolationInverse43_valid,hN]
  rw [hT]
  grind only

/-! The quadratic equation of the executable CM point. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

def cmPoint163Value : ScalarAlgebra.Value :=
  ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw cmPoint163 cmPoint163_valid

private def halfValue : ScalarAlgebra.Value := ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (1/2) 1

private theorem half_twice : halfValue+halfValue=1 := by
  unfold halfValue
  rw [ComplexRawQuotient.add_scaleRat]
  have h : (1/2:Rat)+1/2=1 := by decide +kernel
  rw [h,ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat_one]

theorem cmPoint163Value_formula :
    cmPoint163Value=ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (1/2)
      (1+imaginaryUnitValue*sqrt163Value) := by
  have hi := mulI_class (⟨sqrt163Complex,sqrt163Complex_valid⟩ : Scalar)
  change ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (ComplexRaw.imaginaryAxis sqrt163)
    (ComplexRaw.imaginaryAxis_valid sqrt163_valid)=imaginaryUnitValue*sqrt163Value at hi
  change ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (1/2)
    (1+ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (ComplexRaw.imaginaryAxis sqrt163)
      (ComplexRaw.imaginaryAxis_valid sqrt163_valid)) = _
  rw [hi]

theorem cmPoint163Value_quadratic :
    cmPoint163Value*cmPoint163Value=cmPoint163Value-41 := by
  have hform := cmPoint163Value_formula
  have hscale : ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (1/2)
      (1+imaginaryUnitValue*sqrt163Value)=halfValue*(1+imaginaryUnitValue*sqrt163Value) := by
    unfold halfValue
    rw [← ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat_mul]
    congr 1
    grind
  rw [hscale] at hform
  have hs := sqrt163Value_square
  have hi := imaginaryUnitValue_square
  have hh := half_twice
  have ht : 2*(cmPoint163Value*cmPoint163Value-cmPoint163Value+41)=0 := by grind
  have hm := congrArg (fun x : ScalarAlgebra.Value => halfValue*x) ht
  grind

    (ComplexRaw.mul cmPoint163 cmPoint163).Equiv
      (integerAffine 1 (-41) cmPoint163) := by
  apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
    (hleft := ComplexRaw.mul_valid cmPoint163_valid cmPoint163_valid)
    (hright := integerAffine_valid _ _ cmPoint163_valid)
  rw [ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_mul,
    integerAffine_class 1 (-41) (⟨cmPoint163,cmPoint163_valid⟩ : Scalar)]
  have h := cmPoint163Value_quadratic
  change cmPoint163Value*cmPoint163Value =
    ((1:Int):ScalarAlgebra.Value)*cmPoint163Value+((-41:Int):ScalarAlgebra.Value)

namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

private theorem coefficient_getD (p : RepresentedPolynomial.Coefficients) (k : Nat) :
    RepresentedPolynomial.coefficient p k=p[k]?.getD RepresentedPolynomial.zero := by
  induction p generalizing k with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a p ih => cases k with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k => exact ih k

/-- Finite coefficient agreement proves agreement of literal represented
polynomials, including their actual Horner evaluations. -/
theorem representedPolynomial_equivalent_of_coefficients
    (p q : RepresentedPolynomial.Coefficients) (hlen : p.length=q.length)
    (hc : ∀ i, i<p.length → (RepresentedPolynomial.coefficient p i).raw.Equiv
      (RepresentedPolynomial.coefficient q i).raw) : RepresentedPolynomial.Equivalent p q := by
  induction p generalizing q with
  | nil => cases q with
    | nil => exact .nil
    | cons b q => simp at hlen
  | cons a p ih => cases q with
    | nil => simp at hlen
    | cons b q =>
      refine .cons (hc 0 (by simp)) (ih q (by simpa using hlen) ?_)
      intro i hi
      exact hc (i+1) (by simp; omega)

/-- An integer polynomial in the first j argument supplies each coefficient
of the recovered degree-forty-two polynomial in the second argument. -/
def integerHeckeRecoveredCoefficient41 (J : Scalar) (i : Fin 43) : ComplexCert :=
  if i.val=42 then RepresentedPolynomial.one else
    ⟨integerPrincipalPartJPolynomial J (integerHeckePrincipalCutoff41 (41-i.val))
      (integerHeckePrincipalPolynomialCoefficients41 (41-i.val)),
      integerPrincipalPartJPolynomial_valid _ _ _⟩

/-- The literal recovered polynomial, with executable integer coefficient
polynomials and its monic leading term, in ascending second-argument order. -/
def integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 (J : Scalar) : RepresentedPolynomial.Coefficients :=
  List.ofFn (integerHeckeRecoveredCoefficient41 J)

theorem integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41_length (J : Scalar) :
    (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 J).length=43 := by simp [integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41]

private theorem recovered_coefficient (J : Scalar) (i : Fin 43) :
    RepresentedPolynomial.coefficient (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 J) i.val=
      integerHeckeRecoveredCoefficient41 J i := by
  rw [coefficient_getD]
  change (List.ofFn (integerHeckeRecoveredCoefficient41 J))[i.val]?.getD
    RepresentedPolynomial.zero=integerHeckeRecoveredCoefficient41 J i
  rw [List.getElem?_ofFn]
  simp only [dif_pos i.isLt,Option.getD_some]

/-- The entire actual root polynomial is recovered, not merely its individual
auxiliary coefficient functions. -/
theorem integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41_equivalent (z : Scalar)
    (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) :
    let hd : hecke41CommonDomain z := ⟨hz,fun i =>
      latticeJMap_global_domain (hecke41Point i z) (hecke41Point_upper i z hz)⟩
    RepresentedPolynomial.Equivalent (hecke41RootPolynomial z hd.2)
      (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 (latticeJMap.eval z (latticeJMap_global_domain z hz))) := by
  let hd : hecke41CommonDomain z := ⟨hz,fun i =>
    latticeJMap_global_domain (hecke41Point i z) (hecke41Point_upper i z hz)⟩
  let J := latticeJMap.eval z (latticeJMap_global_domain z hz)
  apply representedPolynomial_equivalent_of_coefficients
    (hecke41RootPolynomial z hd.2) (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 J)
    (by rw [hecke41RootPolynomial_length,integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41_length])
  intro i hi
  rw [hecke41RootPolynomial_length] at hi
  rw [recovered_coefficient J ⟨i,hi⟩]
  by_cases he : i=42
  · subst i
    simp only [integerHeckeRecoveredCoefficient41,if_pos rfl]
    exact equiv_trans (RepresentedPolynomial.coefficient (hecke41RootPolynomial z hd.2) 42).valid
      ((hecke41PolynomialCoefficient 42).value z hd).property RepresentedPolynomial.one.valid
      (equiv_symm (hecke41PolynomialCoefficient_value 42 z hd))
      (hecke41PolynomialCoefficient_leading z hd)
  · have hil : i≤41 := by omega
    simp only [integerHeckeRecoveredCoefficient41,if_neg he]
    have h := integerHeckeRootPolynomialCoefficient41_recovery (41-i) (by omega) z hz
    rw [Nat.sub_sub_self hil] at h
    exact h

/-- Literal Horner evaluation of the recovered integer-coefficient polynomial
agrees with the actual analytic correspondence at every second argument. -/
theorem integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41_eval (z : Scalar)
    (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (x : ComplexCert) :
    let hd : hecke41CommonDomain z := ⟨hz,fun i =>
      latticeJMap_global_domain (hecke41Point i z) (hecke41Point_upper i z hz)⟩
    (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (hecke41RootPolynomial z hd.2) x).raw.Equiv
      (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41
        (latticeJMap.eval z (latticeJMap_global_domain z hz))) x).raw :=
  RepresentedPolynomial.eval_equiv (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41_equivalent z hz)
    (equiv_refl _ x.valid)

/-- The actual CM value satisfies the recovered integer bivariate polynomial
on the diagonal. No algebraicity or singular-modulus value is assumed. -/
theorem cmJValue163_recovered_polynomial_root :
    RepresentedPolynomial.Root (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 cmJValue163)
      ⟨cmJValue163.val,cmJValue163.property⟩ :=
  RepresentedPolynomial.root_congr
    (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41_equivalent cmScalar163 cmPoint163_upper)
    (equiv_refl _ cmJValue163.property) cmHeckeRootPolynomial41_cm_root

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

def hecke41CandidateIntegerRow (i : Fin 43) : List Int :=
  if i.val=42 then [1] else
    integerPrincipalPartPolynomialList (integerHeckePrincipalCutoff41 (41-i.val))
      (integerArrayCoefficient (hecke41PrincipalRowRow (41-i.val)))
      (integerHeckePrincipalCutoff41 (41-i.val)+1)

/-- The already checked triangular rows produce exactly the supplied diagonal. -/
theorem hecke41PrincipalRows_diagonal_checked :
    integerPolynomialDiagonal (List.ofFn hecke41CandidateIntegerRow)=
      hecke41DiagonalCandidate := by
  decide +kernel

private theorem principal_list_prefix_equal (a b : Coefficients) (M N : Nat)
    (h : ∀ n, n<N → a n=b n) :
    integerPrincipalPartPolynomialList M a N=integerPrincipalPartPolynomialList M b N := by
  induction N with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [integerPrincipalPartPolynomialList,integerPrincipalPartPolynomialList,
      ih (fun n hn => h n (by omega)),h N (by omega)]

/-- Exact equality of the actual diagonal and supplied integer polynomial
from the checked Newton prefix; all principal elimination choices are internal. -/
theorem hecke41Diagonal_agreement_of_newton
    (hnewton : ∀ k n, k≤41 → n<1723 → hecke41ExpandedNewtonCandidate k n=
      integerOrbitNewtonCoefficient41 integerJWeightedCoefficients 40 k n) :
    integerHeckeDiagonalPolynomial41=hecke41DiagonalCandidate := by
  rw [← hecke41PrincipalRows_diagonal_checked]
  unfold integerHeckeDiagonalPolynomial41
  congr 1
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext i
  unfold integerHeckeIntegerRow41 hecke41CandidateIntegerRow
  by_cases hi : i.val=42
  · simp only [if_pos hi]
  · simp only [if_neg hi]
    apply principal_list_prefix_equal
    intro n hn
    exact (hecke41PrincipalRow_agreement_of_newton hnewton (41-i.val) n
      (by omega) (by omega)).symm

/-- The actual CM value is a root of the verified supplied polynomial once
the Newton witness prefix has been checked. -/
theorem cmJValue163_candidate_diagonal_root_of_newton
    (hnewton : ∀ k n, k≤41 → n<1723 → hecke41ExpandedNewtonCandidate k n=
      integerOrbitNewtonCoefficient41 integerJWeightedCoefficients 40 k n) :
    RepresentedPolynomial.Root (integerPolynomialEmbedding hecke41DiagonalCandidate)
      ⟨cmJValue163.val,cmJValue163.property⟩ := by
  rw [← hecke41Diagonal_agreement_of_newton hnewton]
  exact cmJValue163_integer_diagonal_root

private theorem shift_class (p : List Int) (X : ScalarAlgebra.Value) :
    integerPolynomialClass (0::p) X=X*integerPolynomialClass p X := by
  change ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat ((0:Int):Rat) 1+X*integerPolynomialClass p X=_
  rw [show ((0:Int):Rat)=0 by decide +kernel,ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat_zeroScalar]
  grind only

private theorem scale_class (p : List Int) (a : Int) (X : ScalarAlgebra.Value) :
    integerPolynomialClass (p.map (fun b => a*b)) X=
      (a:ScalarAlgebra.Value)*integerPolynomialClass p X := by
  induction p with
  | nil => change (0:ScalarAlgebra.Value)=(a:ScalarAlgebra.Value)*0; grind only
  | cons b p ih =>
    change ((a*b:Int):ScalarAlgebra.Value)+X*integerPolynomialClass (p.map (fun b => a*b)) X=
      (a:ScalarAlgebra.Value)*((b:ScalarAlgebra.Value)+X*integerPolynomialClass p X)

  dsimp only
  rw [integerPolynomialAdd_class,integerPolynomialAdd_class,
    shift_class,shift_class,shift_class,scale_class,scale_class]

/-! The real exponential API on arbitrary valid represented inputs. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ExponentialComputations
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert LocalODE DomainFunctions ModularForms
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000

theorem real_embedding_congr {x y : RealRaw} (hx : x.Valid) (hy : y.Valid) (h : x.Equiv y) :
    (ofRealRaw x).Equiv (ofRealRaw y) := ofRealRaw_equiv_of_equiv hx hy h

abbrev RealInput := {x : RealRaw // x.Valid}
def realAxis (x : RealInput) : Scalar := ⟨ofRealRaw x.val,ofRealRaw_valid _ x.property⟩
def exp (x : RealInput) : RealInput :=
  ⟨(entireExponentialValue (realAxis x)).val.realPart,realPart_valid (entireExponentialValue (realAxis x)).property⟩

theorem exp_congr (x y : RealInput) (h : x.val.Equiv y.val) : (exp x).val.Equiv (exp y).val :=
  realPart_equiv (entireExponentialValue_congr (realAxis x) (realAxis y) (real_embedding_congr x.property y.property h))

theorem exp_real_embedding (x : RealInput) :
    (entireExponentialValue (realAxis x)).val.Equiv (realAxis (exp x)).val :=
  entireExponential_real_embedding x.val x.property

/-- A strictly positive real name cannot represent zero. -/
theorem positive_real_nonzero (x : RealInput) (hx : x.val.Pos) : NonzeroBoxSearch.Nonzero (realAxis x) := by
  intro hzero
  have h := realPart_equiv hzero
  obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := hx
  have hb := (RealRaw.compareAt_overlap_iff _ _ k k).mp (h k)
  change (x.val.compute k).lo≤(0:Rat) ∧ (0:Rat)≤(x.val.compute k).hi at hb
  change 0<(x.val.compute k).lo at hk
  grind only

set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
/-- Exponential positivity on the entire represented real axis. -/
theorem exp_positive (x : RealInput) : (exp x).val.Pos := by
  let h : Scalar := realAxis ⟨RealRaw.scaleRat (1/2) x.val,RealRaw.scaleRat_valid x.property⟩
  have he : (ofRealRaw (RealRaw.scaleRat 2 h.val.realPart)).Equiv (realAxis x).val := by
    intro n
    apply (compareAt_overlap_iff _ _ n n).mpr
    have ho := RealRaw.interval_order_of_valid x.val x.property n
    simp only [h,realAxis,ofRealRaw,realPart,RealRaw.scaleRat,RealRaw.scaleRatCompute,
      if_pos (show (0:Rat)≤2 by decide +kernel),if_pos (show (0:Rat)≤1/2 by decide +kernel)]
    constructor <;> constructor <;> grind [Rat.div_def]
  have hmag := entireExponential_squared_magnitude_real h
  have hnonneg := scalar_squared_magnitude_nonnegative (entireExponentialValue h)
  have hv := realPart_valid (mul_valid (entireExponentialValue h).property (conj_valid _ (entireExponentialValue h).property))
  let r : Scalar := ⟨ofRealRaw (RealRaw.scaleRat 2 h.val.realPart),
    ofRealRaw_valid _ (RealRaw.scaleRat_valid (realPart_valid h.property))⟩
  have hvalue := realPart_equiv (entireExponentialValue_congr r (realAxis x) he)
  have h0 : (RealRaw.ofRat 0).Le (exp x).val :=
    RealRaw.le_trans hv hnonneg
      (RealRaw.le_of_equiv hv (exp x).property
        (RealRaw.equiv_trans hv (realPart_valid (entireExponentialValue _).property) (exp x).property hmag hvalue))
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hp
  have hle : (exp x).val.Le (RealRaw.ofRat 0) := by
    intro n m
    have hn : ¬0<((exp x).val.compute n).lo := fun hn => hp ⟨n,hn⟩
    change ((exp x).val.compute n).lo≤(0:Rat)
    grind only
  have hz := RealRaw.le_antisymm hle h0
  have hzero := real_embedding_congr (x := (exp x).val) (y := RealRaw.ofRat 0)
    (exp x).property (RealRaw.ofRat_valid 0) hz
  have hzembed : (ofRealRaw (RealRaw.ofRat 0)).Equiv zero := by
    intro n
    apply (compareAt_overlap_iff _ _ n n).mpr
    constructor <;> exact QComplex.le_refl _
  have hc := equiv_trans (entireExponentialValue (realAxis x)).property
    (realAxis (exp x)).property (ofQComplex_valid QComplex.zero)
    (exp_real_embedding x) (equiv_trans (realAxis (exp x)).property
      (ofRealRaw_valid (RealRaw.ofRat 0) (RealRaw.ofRat_valid 0)) (ofQComplex_valid _) hzero hzembed)
  exact entireExponential_ne_zero (realAxis x) hc

/-- Real-axis injectivity, derived from the exact complex exponential fiber law. -/
theorem exp_injective (x y : RealInput) (h : (exp x).val.Equiv (exp y).val) : x.val.Equiv y.val := by
  have he := equiv_trans (entireExponentialValue (realAxis x)).property
    (realAxis (exp x)).property (entireExponentialValue (realAxis y)).property
    (exp_real_embedding x)
    (equiv_trans (realAxis (exp x)).property (realAxis (exp y)).property
      (entireExponentialValue (realAxis y)).property (real_embedding_congr (exp x).property (exp y).property h) (equiv_symm (exp_real_embedding y)))
  exact entireExponential_fiber_realPart (realAxis x) (realAxis y) he
end ComputableAnalysis.ExponentialComputations

import ComputableAnalysis.HolomorphicJet
import ComputableAnalysis.FiniteExponentialTaylor
import ComputableAnalysis.ComplexMultiplication
import ComputableAnalysis.PolynomialHolomorphicChart

/-!
# Finite complex exponential approximations

This module supplies the missing rational-complex majorant for exponential
Taylor prefixes.  Every statement concerns finite sums.  The scheduled
extension theorem is a potential-infinity certificate: every later finite
prefix differs from the scheduled prefix by an explicitly bounded rational
complex error.
-/

namespace ComputableAnalysis

namespace QComplex

theorem normBound_nonneg (z : QComplex) : 0 <= normBound z := by
  unfold normBound
  exact Rat.add_nonneg (qabs_nonneg _) (qabs_nonneg _)

theorem normBound_zero : normBound zero = 0 := by
  decide +kernel

theorem normBound_add_le (z w : QComplex) :
    normBound (add z w) <= normBound z + normBound w := by
  unfold normBound add
  have hre := qabs_add_le z.re w.re
  have him := qabs_add_le z.im w.im
  grind [Rat.add_assoc, Rat.add_comm, Rat.add_left_comm]

theorem normBound_mul_le (z w : QComplex) :
    normBound (mul z w) <= normBound z * normBound w := by
  unfold normBound mul
  have hre := qabs_sub_le (z.re * w.re) (z.im * w.im)
  have him := qabs_add_le (z.re * w.im) (z.im * w.re)
  rw [qabs_mul, qabs_mul] at hre
  rw [qabs_mul, qabs_mul] at him
  calc
    qabs (z.re * w.re - z.im * w.im) +
        qabs (z.re * w.im + z.im * w.re) <=
      (qabs z.re * qabs w.re + qabs z.im * qabs w.im) +
        (qabs z.re * qabs w.im + qabs z.im * qabs w.re) :=
      rat_add_le_add hre him
    _ = (qabs z.re + qabs z.im) * (qabs w.re + qabs w.im) := by
      grind [Rat.mul_add, Rat.add_mul, Rat.add_assoc, Rat.add_comm,
        Rat.add_left_comm]

theorem normBound_pow_le {z : QComplex} {C : Rat}
    (hC : 0 <= C) (hz : normBound z <= C) :
    forall n, normBound (pow z n) <= C ^ n
  | 0 => by
      rw [Rat.pow_zero]
      change normBound one <= (1 : Rat)
      decide +kernel
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [pow]
      calc
        normBound (mul z (pow z n)) <=
            normBound z * normBound (pow z n) := normBound_mul_le _ _
        _ <= C * normBound (pow z n) :=
          Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hz (normBound_nonneg _)
        _ <= C * C ^ n :=
          Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (normBound_pow_le hC hz n) hC
        _ = C ^ (n + 1) := by
          rw [Rat.pow_succ]
          exact Rat.mul_comm _ _

theorem normBound_divRat_eq (z : QComplex) {q : Rat} (hq : 0 < q) :
    normBound (divRat z q) = normBound z * q⁻¹ := by
  have hinv : 0 <= q⁻¹ := Rat.le_of_lt ((Rat.inv_pos).2 hq)
  unfold normBound divRat
  rw [Rat.div_def, Rat.div_def, qabs_mul, qabs_mul,
    qabs_eq_self_of_nonneg hinv]
  grind [Rat.mul_add, Rat.add_mul, Rat.mul_assoc, Rat.mul_comm]

end QComplex

namespace ComplexExponentialApproximation

abbrev term := ComplexSeries.expTerm

/-- A finite complex exponential block with degrees
`start, ..., start + terms - 1`. -/
def tailPartial (z : QComplex) (start : Nat) : Nat -> QComplex
  | 0 => QComplex.zero
  | terms + 1 =>
      QComplex.add (tailPartial z start terms)
        (term z (start + terms))

/-- The first `terms` complex exponential monomials. -/
def expPrefix (z : QComplex) (terms : Nat) : QComplex :=
  tailPartial z 0 terms

theorem expPrefix_succ (z : QComplex) (terms : Nat) :
    expPrefix z (terms + 1) =
      QComplex.add (expPrefix z terms) (term z terms) := by
  unfold expPrefix
  simp only [tailPartial, Nat.zero_add]

theorem complexSeries_expPartial_succ (z : QComplex) (terms : Nat) :
    ComplexSeries.expPartial z (terms + 1) =
      QComplex.add (ComplexSeries.expPartial z terms) (term z terms) := by
  unfold ComplexSeries.expPartial
  rw [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append]
  rfl

/-- The new recursive prefix is definitionally compatible with the existing
public finite complex exponential evaluator. -/
theorem expPrefix_eq_complexSeries_expPartial
    (z : QComplex) (terms : Nat) :
    expPrefix z terms = ComplexSeries.expPartial z terms := by
  induction terms with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ terms ih =>
      rw [expPrefix_succ, complexSeries_expPartial_succ, ih]

/-! ## Uniform evaluation on rational complex boxes -/

def boxPow (input : QBox) : Nat -> QBox
  | 0 => QBox.point QComplex.one
  | n + 1 => QBox.mul input (boxPow input n)

theorem boxPow_contains {input : QBox} {z : QComplex}
    (hzlo : input.lo <= z) (hzhi : z <= input.hi) :
    forall n,
      (boxPow input n).lo <= QComplex.pow z n /\
        QComplex.pow z n <= (boxPow input n).hi
  | 0 => ⟨QComplex.le_refl _, QComplex.le_refl _⟩
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [boxPow, QComplex.pow]
      exact QBox.mul_contains hzlo hzhi
        (boxPow_contains hzlo hzhi n).1
        (boxPow_contains hzlo hzhi n).2

def termBox (input : QBox) (n : Nat) : QBox :=
  QBox.scaleRat (FormalPowerSeries.expCoeff n) (boxPow input n)

theorem term_eq_scaleRat (z : QComplex) (n : Nat) :
    term z n = QComplex.scaleRat
      (FormalPowerSeries.expCoeff n) (QComplex.pow z n) := by
  cases hpow : QComplex.pow z n with
  | mk re im =>
      unfold term ComplexSeries.expTerm QComplex.divRat
        QComplex.scaleRat FormalPowerSeries.expCoeff
      simp only [hpow]
      congr <;> grind [Rat.div_def, Rat.mul_comm]

theorem termBox_contains {input : QBox} {z : QComplex}
    (hzlo : input.lo <= z) (hzhi : z <= input.hi) (n : Nat) :
    (termBox input n).lo <= term z n /\
      term z n <= (termBox input n).hi := by
  rw [term_eq_scaleRat]
  exact QBox.scaleRat_contains
    (boxPow_contains hzlo hzhi n).1
    (boxPow_contains hzlo hzhi n).2

def prefixBox (input : QBox) : Nat -> QBox
  | 0 => QBox.point QComplex.zero
  | terms + 1 => QBox.add (prefixBox input terms) (termBox input terms)

theorem prefixBox_contains {input : QBox} {z : QComplex}
    (hzlo : input.lo <= z) (hzhi : z <= input.hi) :
    forall terms,
      (prefixBox input terms).lo <= expPrefix z terms /\
        expPrefix z terms <= (prefixBox input terms).hi
  | 0 => ⟨QComplex.le_refl _, QComplex.le_refl _⟩
  | terms + 1 => by
      rw [prefixBox, expPrefix_succ]
      exact QBox.add_contains
        (prefixBox_contains hzlo hzhi terms).1
        (prefixBox_contains hzlo hzhi terms).2
        (termBox_contains hzlo hzhi terms).1
        (termBox_contains hzlo hzhi terms).2

theorem qabs_re_le_normBound (z : QComplex) :
    qabs z.re <= QComplex.normBound z := by
  unfold QComplex.normBound
  have h := qabs_nonneg z.im
  grind

theorem qabs_im_le_normBound (z : QComplex) :
    qabs z.im <= QComplex.normBound z := by
  unfold QComplex.normBound
  have h := qabs_nonneg z.re
  grind

theorem point_add_error_nested_expand_box
    {box : QBox} {center error : QComplex} {radius : Rat}
    (hcenterLo : box.lo <= center) (hcenterHi : center <= box.hi)
    (herror : QComplex.normBound error <= radius) :
    (QBox.point (QComplex.add center error)).NestedIn
      (QBox.expand box radius) := by
  have hre := Rat.le_trans (qabs_re_le_normBound error) herror
  have him := Rat.le_trans (qabs_im_le_normBound error) herror
  have hrelo := neg_qabs_le_self error.re
  have hrehi := self_le_qabs error.re
  have himlo := neg_qabs_le_self error.im
  have himhi := self_le_qabs error.im
  unfold QBox.NestedIn QBox.expand QBox.point QComplex.add
  simp only [QComplex.le_def] at hcenterLo hcenterHi ⊢
  constructor <;> constructor <;>
    grind [Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]

theorem term_normBound_le {z : QComplex} {C : Rat}
    (hC : 0 <= C) (hz : QComplex.normBound z <= C) (n : Nat) :
    QComplex.normBound (term z n) <=
      RationalMajorant.factorialTailTerm C n := by
  unfold term ComplexSeries.expTerm RationalMajorant.factorialTailTerm
  have hfactorial := RationalMajorant.factorialRat_pos n
  rw [QComplex.normBound_divRat_eq _ hfactorial]
  rw [Rat.div_def]
  exact Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (QComplex.normBound_pow_le hC hz n)
    (Rat.le_of_lt ((Rat.inv_pos).2 hfactorial))

theorem tailPartial_normBound_le {z : QComplex} {C : Rat}
    (hC : 0 <= C) (hz : QComplex.normBound z <= C)
    (start terms : Nat) :
    QComplex.normBound (tailPartial z start terms) <=
      RationalMajorant.factorialTailPartial C start terms := by
  induction terms with
  | zero =>
      rw [tailPartial, RationalMajorant.factorialTailPartial,
        QComplex.normBound_zero]
      exact Rat.le_refl
  | succ terms ih =>
      rw [tailPartial, RationalMajorant.factorialTailPartial]
      exact Rat.le_trans (QComplex.normBound_add_le _ _)
        (rat_add_le_add ih (term_normBound_le hC hz (start + terms)))

theorem tailPartial_add (z : QComplex) (start first second : Nat) :
    tailPartial z start (first + second) =
      QComplex.add (tailPartial z start first)
        (tailPartial z (start + first) second) := by
  induction second with
  | zero =>
      rw [Nat.add_zero, tailPartial, QComplex.add_zero_cert]
  | succ second ih =>
      rw [show first + (second + 1) = (first + second) + 1 by omega,
        tailPartial, ih, tailPartial]
      have hindex : start + (first + second) = start + first + second := by
        omega
      rw [hindex, QComplex.add_assoc_cert]

theorem expPrefix_add (z : QComplex) (terms extra : Nat) :
    expPrefix z (terms + extra) =
      QComplex.add (expPrefix z terms) (tailPartial z terms extra) := by
  unfold expPrefix
  simpa using tailPartial_add z 0 terms extra

/-- Widening radius that contains every future prefix after a geometric
stage. -/
def stageRadius (C : Rat) (stage : Nat) : Rat :=
  2 * RationalMajorant.factorialTailTerm C
    (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + stage)

/-- Uniform exponential enclosure over an input box at one geometric stage. -/
def uniformBox (input : QBox) (C : Rat) (stage : Nat) : QBox :=
  QBox.expand
    (prefixBox input (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + stage))
    (stageRadius C stage)

/-- Every later exact prefix at every enclosed norm-bounded rational input is
contained in the uniform stage box. -/
theorem uniformBox_contains_future_prefix
    {input : QBox} {z : QComplex} {C : Rat}
    (hC : 0 <= C) (hzlo : input.lo <= z) (hzhi : z <= input.hi)
    (hzNorm : QComplex.normBound z <= C)
    {stage later : Nat} (hstage : stage <= later) :
    (QBox.point (expPrefix z
      (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + later))).NestedIn
        (uniformBox input C stage) := by
  let extra := later - stage
  have hlater :
      RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + later =
        (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + stage) + extra := by
    dsimp [extra]
    omega
  have hprefix := expPrefix_add z
    (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + stage) extra
  rw [← hlater] at hprefix
  have hcenter := prefixBox_contains hzlo hzhi
    (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + stage)
  have htail := tailPartial_normBound_le hC hzNorm
    (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + stage) extra
  have hmajorant := RationalMajorant.factorialTailPartial_bound hC
    (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart_mono C
      (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C) stage
      (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart_satisfies C)) extra
  have herror :
      QComplex.normBound
          (tailPartial z
            (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + stage) extra) <=
        stageRadius C stage :=
    Rat.le_trans htail (by simpa [stageRadius] using hmajorant)
  unfold uniformBox
  rw [hprefix]
  exact point_add_error_nested_expand_box
    hcenter.1 hcenter.2 herror

/-- Paired uniform boxes for the adjacent-prefix exponential first jet. -/
def uniformJetBox (input : QBox) (C : Rat) (stage : Nat) :
    QBox.FirstJetBox where
  value := uniformBox input C (stage + 1)
  derivative := uniformBox input C stage

/-- Both components of the uniform jet box contain the same sufficiently
late exponential prefix, expressing the finite enclosure form of
`exp' = exp`. -/
theorem uniformJetBox_contains_future_selfDerivative
    {input : QBox} {z : QComplex} {C : Rat}
    (hC : 0 <= C) (hzlo : input.lo <= z) (hzhi : z <= input.hi)
    (hzNorm : QComplex.normBound z <= C)
    {stage later : Nat} (hstage : stage + 1 <= later) :
    QBox.FirstJetBox.Contains (uniformJetBox input C stage)
      { value := expPrefix z
          (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + later)
        derivative := expPrefix z
          (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + later) } := by
  have hvalue := uniformBox_contains_future_prefix hC hzlo hzhi hzNorm hstage
  have hderivative := uniformBox_contains_future_prefix hC hzlo hzhi hzNorm
    (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ stage) hstage)
  exact ⟨hvalue.1, hvalue.2, hderivative.1, hderivative.2⟩

/-- The common scheduled term count on the norm ball `normBound z <= C`. -/
def scheduledTerms (C : Rat) (eps : QPos) : Nat :=
  FiniteExponentialTaylor.scheduledTailStart C eps

/-- Every later finite prefix is the scheduled prefix plus a computably
bounded complex error. -/
theorem scheduled_prefix_extension
    {z : QComplex} {C : Rat} (hC : 0 <= C)
    (hz : QComplex.normBound z <= C) (eps : QPos) (extra : Nat) :
    Exists fun error : QComplex =>
      expPrefix z (scheduledTerms C eps + extra) =
          QComplex.add (expPrefix z (scheduledTerms C eps)) error /\
        QComplex.normBound error <= eps.val := by
  refine ⟨tailPartial z (scheduledTerms C eps) extra,
    expPrefix_add z (scheduledTerms C eps) extra, ?_⟩
  exact Rat.le_trans (tailPartial_normBound_le hC hz _ _)
    (by
      simpa [scheduledTerms, FiniteExponentialTaylor.scheduledTailStart] using
        RationalMajorant.factorialTailPartial_shifted_le_eps hC eps extra)

/-- The formal first jet of an exponential prefix.  The value uses one more
term than the derivative, exactly as termwise polynomial differentiation
requires when the exponential coefficient stream shifts to itself. -/
def finiteJet (z : QComplex) (terms : Nat) : HolomorphicJet.FirstJet where
  value := expPrefix z (terms + 1)
  derivative := expPrefix z terms

theorem finiteJet_value_eq_derivative_add_term (z : QComplex) (terms : Nat) :
    (finiteJet z terms).value =
      QComplex.add (finiteJet z terms).derivative (term z terms) := by
  change expPrefix z (terms + 1) =
    QComplex.add (expPrefix z terms) (term z terms)
  rw [expPrefix_add]
  simp only [tailPartial, Nat.add_zero, QComplex.zero_add_cert]

theorem formal_exponential_coefficient_derivative :
    FormalPowerSeries.derivative FormalPowerSeries.expCoeff =
      FormalPowerSeries.expCoeff :=
  FormalPowerSeries.expCoeff_derivative

/-- At the scheduled stage, the finite value/derivative discrepancy is within
the requested norm budget. -/
theorem scheduled_finiteJet_gap_le
    {z : QComplex} {C : Rat} (hC : 0 <= C)
    (hz : QComplex.normBound z <= C) (eps : QPos) :
    QComplex.normBound
      (term z (scheduledTerms C eps)) <= eps.val := by
  have hterm := term_normBound_le hC hz (scheduledTerms C eps)
  have htail := RationalMajorant.factorialTailPartial_shifted_le_eps
    hC eps 1
  simp only [RationalMajorant.factorialTailPartial, Nat.add_zero,
    Rat.zero_add] at htail
  exact Rat.le_trans hterm (by
    simpa [scheduledTerms, FiniteExponentialTaylor.scheduledTailStart] using
      htail)

/-- Precision-indexed exponential first-jet approximant on the norm ball of
radius `C`. -/
def scheduledJet (z : QComplex) (C : Rat) (eps : QPos) :
    HolomorphicJet.FirstJet :=
  finiteJet z (scheduledTerms C eps)

theorem scheduledJet_value_eq_derivative_add_error
    (z : QComplex) (C : Rat) (eps : QPos) :
    (scheduledJet z C eps).value =
      QComplex.add (scheduledJet z C eps).derivative
        (term z (scheduledTerms C eps)) :=
  finiteJet_value_eq_derivative_add_term z (scheduledTerms C eps)

/-- The exact value/derivative relation and the requested error bound packaged
together at one precision. -/
structure ScheduledJetCertificate
    (z : QComplex) (C : Rat) (eps : QPos) : Prop where
  relation :
    (scheduledJet z C eps).value =
      QComplex.add (scheduledJet z C eps).derivative
        (term z (scheduledTerms C eps))
  errorBound :
    QComplex.normBound (term z (scheduledTerms C eps)) <= eps.val

theorem scheduledJet_certificate
    {z : QComplex} {C : Rat} (hC : 0 <= C)
    (hz : QComplex.normBound z <= C) (eps : QPos) :
    ScheduledJetCertificate z C eps where
  relation := scheduledJet_value_eq_derivative_add_error z C eps
  errorBound := scheduled_finiteJet_gap_le hC hz eps

/-! ## A valid raw complex exponential at a rational point -/

theorem point_add_error_nested_expand
    (center error : QComplex) {radius : Rat}
    (herror : QComplex.normBound error <= radius) :
    (QBox.point (QComplex.add center error)).NestedIn
      (QBox.expand (QBox.point center) radius) := by
  have hre := Rat.le_trans (qabs_re_le_normBound error) herror
  have him := Rat.le_trans (qabs_im_le_normBound error) herror
  have hrelo := neg_qabs_le_self error.re
  have hrehi := self_le_qabs error.re
  have himlo := neg_qabs_le_self error.im
  have himhi := self_le_qabs error.im
  unfold QBox.NestedIn QBox.expand QBox.point QComplex.add
  simp only [QComplex.le_def]
  constructor <;> constructor <;>
    grind [Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]

private theorem half_pow_nonneg (n : Nat) :
    0 <= ((1 : Rat) / 2) ^ n :=
  Rat.pow_nonneg (by decide +kernel)

private theorem half_pow_le_one (n : Nat) :
    ((1 : Rat) / 2) ^ n <= 1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => decide +kernel
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Rat.pow_succ]
      calc
        ((1 : Rat) / 2) ^ n * ((1 : Rat) / 2) <=
            1 * ((1 : Rat) / 2) :=
          Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ih (by decide +kernel)
        _ <= 1 := by decide +kernel

private theorem half_pow_antitone {n m : Nat} (hnm : n <= m) :
    ((1 : Rat) / 2) ^ m <= ((1 : Rat) / 2) ^ n := by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hnm
  clear hnm
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      rw [Nat.add_zero]
      exact Rat.le_refl
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [show n + (k + 1) = (n + k) + 1 by omega, Rat.pow_succ]
      have hstep :
          ((1 : Rat) / 2) ^ (n + k) * ((1 : Rat) / 2) <=
            ((1 : Rat) / 2) ^ (n + k) := by
        calc
          ((1 : Rat) / 2) ^ (n + k) * ((1 : Rat) / 2) <=
              ((1 : Rat) / 2) ^ (n + k) * 1 :=
            Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by decide +kernel)
              (half_pow_nonneg (n + k))
          _ = ((1 : Rat) / 2) ^ (n + k) := Rat.mul_one _
      exact Rat.le_trans hstep ih

/-- Direct point candidates before finite-prefix stabilization. -/
def directCandidate (z : QComplex) (C : Rat) : ComplexRaw where
  compute := fun stage =>
    QBox.point (expPrefix z
      (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + stage))

/-- The nested raw exponential computation obtained by finite intersections
of widened Taylor-prefix point boxes. -/
def exponentialRawAt (z : QComplex) (C : Rat) : ComplexRaw :=
  ComplexRaw.cauchyStabilize (directCandidate z C) (stageRadius C)

private theorem exponentialRawAt_contained_current_expand
    (z : QComplex) (C : Rat) (stage : Nat) :
    ((exponentialRawAt z C).compute stage).NestedIn
      (QBox.expand ((directCandidate z C).compute stage)
        (stageRadius C stage)) := by
  cases stage with
  | zero =>
      exact ⟨QComplex.le_refl _, QComplex.le_refl _⟩
  | succ stage =>
      change (QBox.intersection
        (ComplexRaw.cauchyStabilizeCompute
          (directCandidate z C).compute (stageRadius C) stage)
        (QBox.expand ((directCandidate z C).compute (stage + 1))
          (stageRadius C (stage + 1)))).NestedIn
        (QBox.expand ((directCandidate z C).compute (stage + 1))
          (stageRadius C (stage + 1)))
      exact QBox.intersection_contained_right _ _

private theorem directCandidate_ordered (z : QComplex) (C : Rat) :
    forall stage, ((directCandidate z C).compute stage).Ordered := by
  intro stage
  exact QComplex.le_refl _

private theorem directCandidate_shrinks (z : QComplex) (C : Rat) :
    ComplexRaw.WidthsShrinkToZero (directCandidate z C).compute := by
  intro eps
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  intro stage _
  constructor
  · simpa [directCandidate, QBox.point, QBox.width, Rat.sub_self] using
      (Rat.le_of_lt eps.property)
  · simpa [directCandidate, QBox.point, QBox.height, Rat.sub_self] using
      (Rat.le_of_lt eps.property)

private theorem directCandidate_future
    {z : QComplex} {C : Rat} (hC : 0 <= C)
    (hz : QComplex.normBound z <= C) :
    forall first later, first <= later ->
      ((directCandidate z C).compute later).NestedIn
        (QBox.expand ((directCandidate z C).compute first)
          (stageRadius C first)) := by
  intro first later hfl
  let extra := later - first
  have hlater :
      RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + later =
        (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + first) + extra := by
    dsimp [extra]
    omega
  have hprefix := expPrefix_add z
    (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + first) extra
  rw [← hlater] at hprefix
  have htail := tailPartial_normBound_le hC hz
    (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + first) extra
  have hmajorant := RationalMajorant.factorialTailPartial_bound hC
    (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart_mono C
      (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C) first
      (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart_satisfies C)) extra
  have herror :
      QComplex.normBound
          (tailPartial z
            (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + first) extra) <=
        stageRadius C first :=
    Rat.le_trans htail (by simpa [stageRadius] using hmajorant)
  change (QBox.point
      (expPrefix z (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + later))).NestedIn
    (QBox.expand
      (QBox.point
        (expPrefix z (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + first)))
      (stageRadius C first))
  rw [hprefix]
  exact point_add_error_nested_expand _ _ herror

/-- The stabilized stage contains its current exact Taylor prefix. -/
theorem exponentialRawAt_contains_prefix
    {z : QComplex} {C : Rat} (hC : 0 <= C)
    (hz : QComplex.normBound z <= C) (stage : Nat) :
    (QBox.point (expPrefix z
      (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + stage))).NestedIn
        ((exponentialRawAt z C).compute stage) := by
  exact ComplexRaw.cauchyStabilize_contains_current
    (directCandidate_future hC hz) stage

private theorem exponentialRawAt_width_height_le_radius
    (z : QComplex) (C : Rat) (stage : Nat) :
    ((exponentialRawAt z C).compute stage).width <=
        2 * stageRadius C stage /\
      ((exponentialRawAt z C).compute stage).height <=
        2 * stageRadius C stage := by
  have hnested := exponentialRawAt_contained_current_expand z C stage
  have hwidthHeight := QBox.width_height_le_of_nested hnested
  rw [QBox.expand_width, QBox.expand_height] at hwidthHeight
  simpa [directCandidate, QBox.point, QBox.width, QBox.height,
    Rat.sub_self, Rat.zero_add] using hwidthHeight

/-- Explicit geometric width bound for the valid stabilized exponential
boxes. -/
theorem exponentialRawAt_width_height_geometric
    {z : QComplex} {C : Rat} (hC : 0 <= C) (stage : Nat) :
    let bound := 4 * RationalMajorant.factorialTailTerm C
      (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C)
    ((exponentialRawAt z C).compute stage).width <=
        bound * ((1 : Rat) / 2) ^ stage /\
      ((exponentialRawAt z C).compute stage).height <=
        bound * ((1 : Rat) / 2) ^ stage := by
  dsimp
  have hbox := exponentialRawAt_width_height_le_radius z C stage
  have hterm := RationalMajorant.factorialTailTerm_le_geometric_from_start
    hC (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart_satisfies C) stage
  have hscaled :
      2 * stageRadius C stage <=
        4 * RationalMajorant.factorialTailTerm C
          (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C) *
            ((1 : Rat) / 2) ^ stage := by
    unfold stageRadius
    calc
      2 * (2 * RationalMajorant.factorialTailTerm C
          (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + stage)) <=
          2 * (2 * (RationalMajorant.factorialTailTerm C
            (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C) *
              ((1 : Rat) / 2) ^ stage)) :=
        Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hterm
            (by decide +kernel : (0 : Rat) <= 2))
          (by decide +kernel : (0 : Rat) <= 2)
      _ = 4 * RationalMajorant.factorialTailTerm C
          (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C) *
            ((1 : Rat) / 2) ^ stage := by
        grind [Rat.mul_assoc]
  exact ⟨Rat.le_trans hbox.1 hscaled, Rat.le_trans hbox.2 hscaled⟩

theorem stageRadius_shrinks {C : Rat} (hC : 0 <= C) :
    ShrinksToZero (stageRadius C) := by
  intro eps
  let bound : Rat :=
    2 * RationalMajorant.factorialTailTerm C
      (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C)
  have hbound : 0 <= bound := by
    dsimp [bound]
    exact Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide +kernel)
      (RationalMajorant.factorialTailTerm_nonneg hC _)
  let start := RationalMajorant.halfDecayShift bound eps
  refine ⟨start, ?_⟩
  intro stage hstage
  have hterm := RationalMajorant.factorialTailTerm_le_geometric_from_start
    hC (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart_satisfies C) stage
  have hradius :
      stageRadius C stage <= bound * ((1 : Rat) / 2) ^ stage := by
    dsimp [stageRadius, bound]
    calc
      2 * RationalMajorant.factorialTailTerm C
          (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + stage) <=
          2 * (RationalMajorant.factorialTailTerm C
            (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C) *
              ((1 : Rat) / 2) ^ stage) :=
        Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hterm
          (by decide +kernel : (0 : Rat) <= 2)
      _ = 2 * RationalMajorant.factorialTailTerm C
          (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C) *
            ((1 : Rat) / 2) ^ stage := by
        grind [Rat.mul_assoc]
  have hmono := half_pow_antitone hstage
  calc
    stageRadius C stage <= bound * ((1 : Rat) / 2) ^ stage := hradius
    _ <= bound * ((1 : Rat) / 2) ^ start :=
      Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono hbound
    _ <= eps.val := RationalMajorant.halfDecayShift_spec hbound eps

/-- The stabilized exponential Taylor computation is a valid raw complex
number for every supplied rational norm bound on its input. -/
theorem exponentialRawAt_valid
    {z : QComplex} {C : Rat} (hC : 0 <= C)
    (hz : QComplex.normBound z <= C) :
    (exponentialRawAt z C).Valid := by
  apply ComplexRaw.cauchyStabilize_valid
  · exact directCandidate_ordered z C
  · exact directCandidate_shrinks z C
  · exact directCandidate_future hC hz
  · exact stageRadius_shrinks hC

end ComplexExponentialApproximation

end ComputableAnalysis

ComputableAnalysis.AlgebraicFunctions.text:
import ComputableAnalysis.ComplexInterval
import ComputableAnalysis.FTC
import ComputableAnalysis.Polynomial

namespace ComputableAnalysis

/-!
# Algebraic functions

This file collects algebraic-function algorithms.  In particular, square root
is treated here as the algebraic function cut out by `w^2 = z`; the rational
input algorithm below is the real branch on nonnegative rational inputs.
-/

namespace Polynomial

/-- One Newton step for a rational polynomial at a rational point.

The step is partial: if `p' x = 0`, Newton's method is not defined at `x`, so
the algorithm returns `none`. -/
def newtonStep? (coeffs : List Rat) (x : Rat) : Option Rat :=
  let slope := eval (derivative coeffs) x
  if slope = 0 then none else some (x - eval coeffs x / slope)

/-- The `n`th rational Newton iterate from `seed`, stopping if a derivative
vanishes along the way. -/
def newtonIterate? (coeffs : List Rat) : Nat -> Rat -> Option Rat
  | 0, seed => some seed
  | n + 1, seed =>
      match newtonIterate? coeffs n seed with
