/-! Uniform estimates for deriving the three Eisenstein Lambert sums from
rational chart samples. Existing represented sums occur only in proofs. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.RationalLambert
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000

private theorem sub_zero_equiv (z : ComplexRaw) (hz : z.Valid) : (sub z zero).Equiv z := by
  apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq (hleft := sub_valid hz (ofQComplex_valid _)) (hright := hz)
  change ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw z hz-0=ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw z hz
  grind only

def comparison (q : Scalar) (hq : Small q.val ((1:Rat)/64)) (k : Nat) : Scalar :=
  if k=1 then wideLambertFirstValue q hq else if k=3 then wideLambertThirdValue q hq else wideLambertFifthValue q hq

def slope (q : Scalar) (hq : Small q.val ((1:Rat)/64)) (k : Nat) : Scalar :=
  if k=1 then wideLambertFirstSlopeValue q hq else if k=3 then wideLambertThirdSlopeValue q hq else wideLambertFifthSlopeValue q hq

theorem slope_bound (q : Scalar) (hq : Small q.val ((1:Rat)/64)) (k : Nat) : Small (slope q hq k).val 2048 := by
  unfold slope
  split
  · have h := wideLambertFirstSlopeValue_close_prefix q hq 0
    have he := sub_zero_equiv _ (wideLambertFirstSlopeValue q hq).property
    exact (Small.congr (sub_valid (wideLambertFirstSlopeValue q hq).property (ofQComplex_valid _))
      (wideLambertFirstSlopeValue q hq).property he h).mono (by decide +kernel)
  · split
    · have h := wideLambertThirdSlopeValue_close_prefix q hq 0
      have he := sub_zero_equiv _ (wideLambertThirdSlopeValue q hq).property
      exact (Small.congr (sub_valid (wideLambertThirdSlopeValue q hq).property (ofQComplex_valid _))
        (wideLambertThirdSlopeValue q hq).property he h).mono (by decide +kernel)
    · have h := wideLambertFifthSlopeValue_close_prefix q hq 0
      have h' : Small (sub (wideLambertFifthSlopeValue q hq).val zero) 2048 := by
        simpa only [ScalarSeries.block,Rat.pow_zero,Rat.mul_one] using h
      exact Small.congr (sub_valid (wideLambertFifthSlopeValue q hq).property (ofQComplex_valid _))
        (wideLambertFifthSlopeValue q hq).property (sub_zero_equiv _ (wideLambertFifthSlopeValue q hq).property) h'

theorem remainder_bound (a z : Scalar) (ha : Small a.val ((1:Rat)/64)) (hz : Small z.val ((1:Rat)/64))
    (k : Nat) (H : Rat) (hH : 0≤H) (hd : Small (sub z.val a.val) H) :
    Small (SeriesLimitLaws.remainder (comparison z hz k).val (comparison a ha k).val
      (slope a ha k).val (sub z.val a.val)) (135168*H^2) := by
  unfold comparison slope
  split
  · exact wideLambertFirstValue_remainder_bound a z ha hz H hH hd
  · split
    · exact wideLambertThirdValue_remainder_bound a z ha hz H hH hd
    · exact wideLambertFifthValue_remainder_bound a z ha hz H hH hd

theorem difference_bound (a z : Scalar) (ha : Small a.val ((1:Rat)/64)) (hz : Small z.val ((1:Rat)/64))
    (k : Nat) (H : Rat) (hH : 0≤H) (hH1 : H≤1) (hd : Small (sub z.val a.val) H) :
    Small (sub (comparison z hz k).val (comparison a ha k).val) (139264*H) := by
  let v := sub z.val a.val
  let f := (comparison z hz k).val
  let g := (comparison a ha k).val
  let d := (slope a ha k).val
  have hr := remainder_bound a z ha hz k H hH hd
  have hp := Small.mul (slope a ha k).property (sub_valid z.property a.property) (by decide +kernel : (0:Rat)≤2048)
    hH (slope_bound a ha k) hd
  have hs := LocalODE.small_add hp hr
  have he := SeriesLimitLaws.add_difference (sub f g) (mul d v)
    (sub_valid (comparison z hz k).property (comparison a ha k).property)
    (mul_valid (slope a ha k).property (sub_valid z.property a.property))
  have hb := Small.congr (add_valid (mul_valid (slope a ha k).property (sub_valid z.property a.property))
    (SeriesLimitLaws.remainder_valid f g d v (comparison z hz k).property (comparison a ha k).property
      (slope a ha k).property (sub_valid z.property a.property)))
    (sub_valid (comparison z hz k).property (comparison a ha k).property) he hs
  apply hb.mono
  rw [Rat.pow_succ H 1,Rat.pow_one]
  have hsq := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hH1 hH
  have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (by decide +kernel : (0:Rat)≤135168)
  grind only

theorem triangle (a b c : ComplexRaw) (ha : a.Valid) (hb : b.Valid) (hc : c.Valid)
    (E F : Rat) (hab : Small (sub a b) E) (hbc : Small (sub b c) F) : Small (sub a c) (E+F) := by
  have he : (add (sub a b) (sub b c)).Equiv (sub a c) := by
    apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
      (hleft := add_valid (sub_valid ha hb) (sub_valid hb hc)) (hright := sub_valid ha hc)
    change (ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw a ha-ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw b hb)+
      (ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw b hb-ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw c hc)=
      ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw a ha-ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw c hc
    grind only
  exact Small.congr (add_valid (sub_valid ha hb) (sub_valid hb hc)) (sub_valid ha hc) he
    (LocalODE.small_add hab hbc)

theorem pow_mono (a b : Rat) (ha : 0≤a) (hab : a≤b) (n : Nat) : a^n≤b^n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [Rat.pow_zero]; exact Rat.le_refl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Rat.pow_succ,Rat.pow_succ]
    exact Rat.le_trans (Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ih ha)
      (Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hab (Rat.pow_nonneg (Rat.le_trans ha hab)))

theorem comparison_tail (q : Scalar) (hq : Small q.val ((1:Rat)/64)) (k : Nat) (hk : k=1 ∨ k=3 ∨ k=5) (N : Nat) :
    Small (sub (comparison q hq k).val (ScalarSeries.block (weightedLambertTerm q (1/64) k) 0 N))
      (8*((1:Rat)/2)^N) := by
  rcases hk with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · have ht := wideLambertFirstValue_close_prefix q hq N
    apply ht.mono
    have hp := pow_mono (1/16) (1/2) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) N
    have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (by decide +kernel : (0:Rat)≤1/2)
    have hm2 := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by decide +kernel : (1/2:Rat)≤8)
      (Rat.pow_nonneg (n := N) (by decide +kernel : (0:Rat)≤1/2))
    exact Rat.le_trans hm hm2
  · have ht := wideLambertThirdValue_close_prefix q hq N
    apply ht.mono
    have hp := pow_mono (1/4) (1/2) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) N
    have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (by decide +kernel : (0:Rat)≤1/2)
    have hm2 := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by decide +kernel : (1/2:Rat)≤8)
      (Rat.pow_nonneg (n := N) (by decide +kernel : (0:Rat)≤1/2))
    exact Rat.le_trans hm hm2
  · have ht := wideLambertFifthValue_close_prefix q hq N
    exact ht.mono (Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_mono (1/8) (1/2) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) N) (by decide +kernel))

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.RationalLambert

/-! Irrational nome-chart evaluations derived from exact rational Lambert
prefixes. The schedule depends only on rational input boxes and fixed bounds. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.RationalLambert
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert DomainFunctions
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000

def inputRadius (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) (n : Nat) : QPos :=
  minRadius (LocalODE.interiorRadius (1/64) q hq)
    (minRadius ⟨1,by decide +kernel⟩ (divideRadius (RepresentedCauchySum.error n) ⟨139264,by decide +kernel⟩))

def sampleStage (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  PrecisionSearch.stage q.val q.property (inputRadius q hq n)
def samplePoint (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) (n : Nat) : QComplex :=
  (q.val.compute (sampleStage q hq n)).center

theorem sample_close (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) (n : Nat) :
    Small (sub (ofQComplex (samplePoint q hq n)) q.val) (inputRadius q hq n).val := by
  have h := PrecisionSearch.stage_spec q.val q.property (inputRadius q hq n)
  exact RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ (BoxApproximation.center_error q (sampleStage q hq n)
    (inputRadius q hq n).val (Rat.le_of_lt (inputRadius q hq n).property) h.1 h.2)

theorem sample_inside (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) (n : Nat) :
    wideLambertFifthDomain (point (samplePoint q hq n)) :=
  LocalODE.interiorRadius_inside (1/64) q hq _ ((sample_close q hq n).mono (minRadius_left _ _))

def sampledPrefix (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) (k n : Nat) : ComplexRaw :=
  ofQComplex (finitePrefix (samplePoint q hq n) k n)

theorem input_error (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) (k n : Nat) :
    Small (sub (comparison (point (samplePoint q hq n)) (LocalODE.interior_bound _ _ (sample_inside q hq n)) k).val
      (comparison q (LocalODE.interior_bound _ _ hq) k).val) (RepresentedCauchySum.error n).val := by
  have hr := minRadius_right (LocalODE.interiorRadius (1/64) q hq)
    (minRadius (⟨1,by decide +kernel⟩ : QPos) (divideRadius (RepresentedCauchySum.error n) ⟨139264,by decide +kernel⟩))
  have h1 := Rat.le_trans hr (minRadius_left (⟨1,by decide +kernel⟩ : QPos) _)
  have hd := Rat.le_trans hr (minRadius_right (⟨1,by decide +kernel⟩ : QPos) _)
  have hb := difference_bound q (point (samplePoint q hq n)) (LocalODE.interior_bound _ _ hq)
    (LocalODE.interior_bound _ _ (sample_inside q hq n)) k (inputRadius q hq n).val
    (Rat.le_of_lt (inputRadius q hq n).property) h1 (sample_close q hq n)
  apply hb.mono
  have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (by decide +kernel : (0:Rat)≤139264)
  rw [divideRadius_identity (RepresentedCauchySum.error n) (⟨139264,by decide +kernel⟩ : QPos)] at hm
  exact hm

def error (n : Nat) : Rat := 8*((1:Rat)/2)^n+(RepresentedCauchySum.error n).val

theorem error_shrinks : ShrinksToZero error :=
  RepresentedCauchySum.sum_shrinks _ _
    (by simpa only [show (4:Rat)*2=8 by decide +kernel] using
      LocalODE.tail_bound_shrinks 2 (1/2) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel))
    RepresentedCauchySum.error_shrinks

theorem error_antitone (m n : Nat) (hmn : m≤n) : error n≤error m := by
  have hp : ∀ d : Nat, ((1:Rat)/2)^(m+d)≤((1:Rat)/2)^m := by
    intro d
    induction d with
    | zero => simp only [Nat.add_zero]; exact Rat.le_refl
    | succ d ih =>
      rw [Nat.add_succ,Rat.pow_succ]
      have hb := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by decide +kernel : (1/2:Rat)≤1)
        (Rat.pow_nonneg (n := m+d) (by decide +kernel : (0:Rat)≤1/2))
      exact Rat.le_trans (by simpa only [Rat.mul_one] using hb) ih
  have hb := hp (n-m)
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' hmn] at hb
  exact rat_add_le_add (Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (by decide +kernel))
    (RepresentedCauchySum.error_antitone m n hmn)

theorem comparison_close (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) (k : Nat)
    (hk : k=1 ∨ k=3 ∨ k=5) (n : Nat) :
    Small (sub (comparison q (LocalODE.interior_bound _ _ hq) k).val (sampledPrefix q hq k n)) (error n) := by
  let p := point (samplePoint q hq n)
  let hp := LocalODE.interior_bound (1/64) p (sample_inside q hq n)
  have ht := comparison_tail p hp k hk n
  have he := FunctionTheory.sub_congr (equiv_refl _ (comparison p hp k).property)
    (prefix_agrees (samplePoint q hq n) hp k n)
  have ht' := Small.congr (sub_valid (comparison p hp k).property
    (ScalarSeries.block_valid _ (weightedLambertTerm_valid p (1/64) k (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) hp) 0 n))
    (sub_valid (comparison p hp k).property (ofQComplex_valid _)) he ht
  have hb := triangle _ _ _ (comparison q (LocalODE.interior_bound _ _ hq) k).property (comparison p hp k).property
    (ofQComplex_valid _) _ _ (RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ (input_error q hq k n)) ht'
  apply hb.mono
  dsimp [error]
  grind only

def value (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) (k : Nat) : ComplexRaw :=
  RepresentedCauchySum.value (sampledPrefix q hq k) (fun _ => ofQComplex_valid _) (fun n => 2*error n)

theorem prefix_cauchy (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) (k : Nat) (hk : k=1 ∨ k=3 ∨ k=5)
    (m n : Nat) (hmn : m≤n) : Small (sub (sampledPrefix q hq k n) (sampledPrefix q hq k m)) (2*error m) := by
  have hb := triangle _ _ _ (ofQComplex_valid _) (comparison q (LocalODE.interior_bound _ _ hq) k).property
    (ofQComplex_valid _) _ _ (RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ (comparison_close q hq k hk n))
    (comparison_close q hq k hk m)
  exact hb.mono (by have := error_antitone m n hmn; grind only)

theorem value_valid (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) (k : Nat) (hk : k=1 ∨ k=3 ∨ k=5) :
    (value q hq k).Valid := RepresentedCauchySum.value_valid _ _ _
      (RepresentedCauchySum.twice_shrinks _ error_shrinks) (prefix_cauchy q hq k hk)

theorem value_agrees (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) (k : Nat) (hk : k=1 ∨ k=3 ∨ k=5) :
    (value q hq k).Equiv (comparison q (LocalODE.interior_bound _ _ hq) k).val := by
  apply SeriesLimitLaws.equiv_of_small_sub_zero
  apply SeriesLimitLaws.small_closed _ 0 (fun n => 3*error n)
    (SeriesLimitLaws.shrinks_scale _ error_shrinks 3 (by decide +kernel))
  intro n
  have hv := RepresentedCauchySum.value_close_prefix (sampledPrefix q hq k) (fun _ => ofQComplex_valid _)
    (fun n => 2*error n) (prefix_cauchy q hq k hk) n
  have hb := triangle _ _ _ (value_valid q hq k hk) (ofQComplex_valid _)
    (comparison q (LocalODE.interior_bound _ _ hq) k).property _ _ hv
    (RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ (comparison_close q hq k hk n))
  exact hb.mono (by grind only)

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.RationalLambert

/-! Primary rational Lambert-series samplers. Their runtime sees only one
rational chart point and exact finite rational sums with certified tails. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.RationalLambert
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert

private def rationalTail (n : Nat) : Rat := 8*((1:Rat)/2)^n

private theorem rationalTail_shrinks : ShrinksToZero rationalTail := by
  change ShrinksToZero (fun n => 8*((1:Rat)/2)^n)
  simpa only [show (4:Rat)*2=8 by decide +kernel] using
    LocalODE.tail_bound_shrinks 2 (1/2) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel)

private theorem rationalTail_antitone (m n : Nat) (hmn : m≤n) : rationalTail n≤rationalTail m := by
  have hp : ∀ d : Nat, ((1:Rat)/2)^(m+d)≤((1:Rat)/2)^m := by
    intro d
    induction d with
    | zero => simp only [Nat.add_zero]; exact Rat.le_refl
    | succ d ih =>
      rw [Nat.add_succ,Rat.pow_succ]
      exact Rat.le_trans (by
        have h := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by decide +kernel : (1/2:Rat)≤1)
          (Rat.pow_nonneg (n := m+d) (by decide +kernel : (0:Rat)≤1/2))
        simpa only [Rat.mul_one] using h) ih
  have h := hp (n-m)
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' hmn] at h
  exact Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (by decide +kernel)

private theorem rational_close (q : QComplex) (hq : Small (ofQComplex q) ((1:Rat)/64))
    (k : Nat) (hk : k=1 ∨ k=3 ∨ k=5) (n : Nat) :
    Small (sub (comparison (point q) hq k).val (ofQComplex (finitePrefix q k n))) (rationalTail n) :=
  Small.congr (sub_valid (comparison (point q) hq k).property
    (ScalarSeries.block_valid _ (weightedLambertTerm_valid (point q) (1/64) k (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) hq) 0 n))
    (sub_valid (comparison (point q) hq k).property (ofQComplex_valid _))
    (FunctionTheory.sub_congr (equiv_refl _ (comparison (point q) hq k).property) (prefix_agrees q hq k n))
    (comparison_tail (point q) hq k hk n)

private theorem rational_cauchy (q : QComplex) (hq : Small (ofQComplex q) ((1:Rat)/64))
    (k : Nat) (hk : k=1 ∨ k=3 ∨ k=5) (m n : Nat) (hmn : m≤n) :
    Small (sub (ofQComplex (finitePrefix q k n)) (ofQComplex (finitePrefix q k m))) (2*rationalTail m) := by
  have h := triangle _ _ _ (ofQComplex_valid _) (comparison (point q) hq k).property (ofQComplex_valid _)
    _ _ (RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ (rational_close q hq k hk n)) (rational_close q hq k hk m)
  exact h.mono (by have := rationalTail_antitone m n hmn; grind only)

def rationalValue (q : QComplex) : Nat → ComplexRaw := fun k =>
  RepresentedCauchySum.value (fun n => ofQComplex (finitePrefix q k n)) (fun _ => ofQComplex_valid _)
    (fun n => 2*rationalTail n)

theorem rationalValue_valid (q : QComplex) (hq : Small (ofQComplex q) ((1:Rat)/64))
    (k : Nat) (hk : k=1 ∨ k=3 ∨ k=5) : (rationalValue q k).Valid :=
  RepresentedCauchySum.value_valid _ _ _ (RepresentedCauchySum.twice_shrinks _ rationalTail_shrinks)
    (rational_cauchy q hq k hk)

theorem rationalValue_agrees (q : QComplex) (hq : Small (ofQComplex q) ((1:Rat)/64))
    (k : Nat) (hk : k=1 ∨ k=3 ∨ k=5) : (rationalValue q k).Equiv (comparison (point q) hq k).val := by
  apply SeriesLimitLaws.equiv_of_small_sub_zero
  apply SeriesLimitLaws.small_closed _ 0 (fun n => 3*rationalTail n)
    (SeriesLimitLaws.shrinks_scale _ rationalTail_shrinks 3 (by decide +kernel))
  intro n
  have hv := RepresentedCauchySum.value_close_prefix (fun n => ofQComplex (finitePrefix q k n))
    (fun _ => ofQComplex_valid _) (fun n => 2*rationalTail n) (rational_cauchy q hq k hk) n
  have hb := triangle _ _ _ (rationalValue_valid q hq k hk) (ofQComplex_valid _) (comparison (point q) hq k).property
    _ _ hv (RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ (rational_close q hq k hk n))
  exact hb.mono (by grind only)

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.RationalLambert

/-! Exact finite rational arithmetic beneath the rational-first lattice lift. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open ComplexRaw RiemannHilbert QuadraticOrder163

private theorem common_points {a b : ComplexRaw} (p : Nat → QComplex)
    (ha : ∀ n, (a.compute n).lo≤p n ∧ p n≤(a.compute n).hi)
    (hb : ∀ n, (b.compute n).lo≤p n ∧ p n≤(b.compute n).hi) : a.Equiv b := by
  intro n
  exact (compareAt_overlap_iff a b n n).mpr (QBox.overlaps_of_common_point (ha n) (hb n))

private theorem rational_product (q r : QComplex) :
    (mul (ofQComplex q) (ofQComplex r)).Equiv (ofQComplex (QComplex.mul q r)) := by
  apply common_points (fun _ => QComplex.mul q r)
  · intro n
    exact QBox.mul_contains (QComplex.le_refl q) (QComplex.le_refl q)
      (QComplex.le_refl r) (QComplex.le_refl r)
  · intro n; exact ⟨QComplex.le_refl _, QComplex.le_refl _⟩

private theorem rational_addition (q r : QComplex) :
    (add (ofQComplex q) (ofQComplex r)).Equiv (ofQComplex (QComplex.add q r)) := by
  apply common_points (fun _ => QComplex.add q r)
  · intro n
    exact QBox.add_contains (QComplex.le_refl q) (QComplex.le_refl q)
      (QComplex.le_refl r) (QComplex.le_refl r)
  · intro n; exact ⟨QComplex.le_refl _, QComplex.le_refl _⟩

private theorem rational_vector (q : QComplex) (u : QuadraticOrder163) :
    (latticeVector (rationalUpperPoint q) u).val.Equiv (ofQComplex (SL2Z.affine u.y u.x q)) := by
  apply common_points (fun _ => SL2Z.affine u.y u.x q)
  · intro n
    exact integerAffine_contains u.y u.x (ofQComplex q) n q
      ⟨QComplex.le_refl _, QComplex.le_refl _⟩
  · intro n; exact ⟨QComplex.le_refl _, QComplex.le_refl _⟩

def rationalIndexInverse (q : QComplex) (u : QuadraticOrder163) : QComplex :=
  (QComplex.inv? (SL2Z.affine u.y u.x q)).getD QComplex.zero

theorem rationalIndexInverse_product (q : QComplex) (hq : 0<q.im)
    (u : QuadraticOrder163) (hu : u≠QuadraticOrder163.zero) :
    QComplex.mul (SL2Z.affine u.y u.x q) (rationalIndexInverse q u)=QComplex.one := by
  have hn : QComplex.normSq (SL2Z.affine u.y u.x q)≠0 := by
    intro hn
    have he := QComplex.normSq_eq_zero_iff.mp hn
    apply latticeVector_nonzero (rationalUpperPoint q) (rationalUpperPoint_upper q hq) u hu
    simpa only [he, ComplexRaw.zero] using rational_vector q u
  have hp := QComplex.mul_inv?_eq_one hn
  cases h : QComplex.inv? (SL2Z.affine u.y u.x q) with
  | none => simp only [h, Option.map_none] at hp; contradiction
  | some r => simpa only [rationalIndexInverse, h, Option.getD_some, Option.map_some,
      Option.some.injEq] using hp

theorem rationalIndexInverse_agrees (q : QComplex) (hq : 0<q.im)
    (u : QuadraticOrder163) (hu : u≠QuadraticOrder163.zero) :
    (latticeInverse (rationalUpperPoint q) (rationalUpperPoint_upper q hq) u hu).val.Equiv
      (ofQComplex (rationalIndexInverse q u)) := by
  apply RepresentedReciprocal.inverse_unique _ _ ⟨ofQComplex _,ofQComplex_valid _⟩
  have hp := rational_product (SL2Z.affine u.y u.x q) (rationalIndexInverse q u)
  rw [rationalIndexInverse_product q hq u hu] at hp
  exact equiv_trans (mul_valid (latticeVector (rationalUpperPoint q) u).property (ofQComplex_valid _))
    (mul_valid (ofQComplex_valid _) (ofQComplex_valid _)) (ofQComplex_valid _)
    (mul_equiv (latticeVector (rationalUpperPoint q) u).property (ofQComplex_valid _)
      (ofQComplex_valid _) (ofQComplex_valid _) (rational_vector q u) (equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid _))) hp

private theorem rational_power (q : QComplex) (k : Nat) :
    (LocalODE.power (ofQComplex q) k).Equiv (ofQComplex (QComplex.natPow q k)) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid _)
  | succ k ih =>
    exact equiv_trans (LocalODE.power_valid _ (ofQComplex_valid _) (k+1))
      (mul_valid (ofQComplex_valid _) (ofQComplex_valid _)) (ofQComplex_valid _)
      (mul_equiv (LocalODE.power_valid _ (ofQComplex_valid _) k) (ofQComplex_valid _)
        (ofQComplex_valid _) (ofQComplex_valid _) ih (equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid _)))
      (rational_product _ _)

def rationalShellTerm (q : QComplex) (r k i : Nat) : QComplex :=
  if hi : i<8*r then QComplex.natPow (rationalIndexInverse q (shellPoint r ⟨i,hi⟩)) k
  else QComplex.zero

private theorem rationalShellTerm_agrees (q : QComplex) (hq : 0<q.im) (r : Nat) (hr : 0<r) (k i : Nat) :
    (upperShellTerm (rationalUpperPoint q) (rationalUpperPoint_upper q hq) r hr k i).Equiv
      (ofQComplex (rationalShellTerm q r k i)) := by
  unfold upperShellTerm rationalShellTerm
  split
  · rename_i hi
    exact equiv_trans (LocalODE.power_valid _ (latticeInverse _ _ _ _).property k)
      (LocalODE.power_valid _ (ofQComplex_valid _) k) (ofQComplex_valid _)
      (LocalODE.power_congr _ _ (latticeInverse _ _ _ _).property (ofQComplex_valid _)
        (rationalIndexInverse_agrees q hq _ (shellPoint_nonzero r hr ⟨i,hi⟩)) k)
      (rational_power _ k)
  · exact equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid _)

def rationalShellPrefix (q : QComplex) (r k : Nat) : Nat → QComplex
  | 0 => QComplex.zero
  | n+1 => QComplex.add (rationalShellPrefix q r k n) (rationalShellTerm q r k n)

private theorem rationalShellPrefix_agrees (q : QComplex) (hq : 0<q.im) (r : Nat) (hr : 0<r) (k n : Nat) :
    (upperShellPrefix (rationalUpperPoint q) (rationalUpperPoint_upper q hq) r hr k n).Equiv
      (ofQComplex (rationalShellPrefix q r k n)) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid _)
  | succ n ih =>
    exact equiv_trans (upperShellPrefix_valid _ _ _ _ _ (n+1))
      (add_valid (ofQComplex_valid _) (ofQComplex_valid _)) (ofQComplex_valid _)
      (add_equiv ih (rationalShellTerm_agrees q hq r hr k n)) (rational_addition _ _)

/-- Literal finite rational lattice sum: no represented reciprocal or infinite
function evaluation is performed. -/
def rationalLatticePrefix (q : QComplex) (k : Nat) : Nat → QComplex
  | 0 => QComplex.zero
  | n+1 => QComplex.add (rationalLatticePrefix q k n)
      (rationalShellPrefix q (n+1) k (8*(n+1)))

theorem rationalLatticePrefix_agrees (q : QComplex) (hq : 0<q.im) (k n : Nat) :
    (rationalLatticeSample q hq k n).Equiv (ofQComplex (rationalLatticePrefix q k n)) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid _)
  | succ n ih =>
    exact equiv_trans (rationalLatticeSample_valid q hq k (n+1))
      (add_valid (ofQComplex_valid _) (ofQComplex_valid _)) (ofQComplex_valid _)
      (add_equiv ih (rationalShellPrefix_agrees q hq (n+1) (by omega) k (8*(n+1))))
      (rational_addition _ _)

def rationalLatticeExactSample (q : QComplex) (k n : Nat) : ComplexRaw :=
  ofQComplex (rationalLatticePrefix q k n)

theorem rationalLatticeExactSample_valid (q : QComplex) (k n : Nat) :
    (rationalLatticeExactSample q k n).Valid := ofQComplex_valid _

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.RationalLatticeArithmetic
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.RationalCenterApproximation
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.UpperRegionalRemainders
import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.DomainDerivativeBounds

/-! Deriving the full upper-plane lattice sums from finite `Q(i)` samples. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open ComplexRaw RiemannHilbert FunctionTheory DomainFunctions
namespace RationalLattice

def regionBound (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) : Rat :=
  latticeRegionReciprocalConstant (neighborhoodRegionWidth z hz)
    (neighborhoodRegionWidth z hz) (neighborhoodRegionMargin z hz)

theorem regionBound_nonnegative (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) : 0≤regionBound z hz :=
  latticeRegionReciprocalConstant_nonnegative _ _ _
    (neighborhoodRegionWidth_nonnegative z hz) (neighborhoodRegionWidth_nonnegative z hz)
    (neighborhoodRegionMargin_positive z hz)

def inputRadius (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (k n : Nat) : QPos :=
  minRadius (upperRadius z hz)
    (divideRadius (RepresentedCauchySum.error n)
      ⟨finiteLatticeDifferenceCoefficient (regionBound z hz) k (n+1)+1, by
        have := finiteLatticeDifferenceCoefficient_nonnegative _ (regionBound_nonnegative z hz) k (n+1)
        grind only⟩)

def sampleStage (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (k n : Nat) : Nat :=
  PrecisionSearch.stage z.val z.property
    ⟨(inputRadius z hz k n).val/2, by
      exact Rat.mul_pos (inputRadius z hz k n).property (Rat.inv_pos.mpr (by decide : (0:Rat)<2))⟩

def samplePoint (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (k n : Nat) : QComplex :=
  (z.val.compute (sampleStage z hz k n)).center

theorem samplePoint_close (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (k n : Nat) :
    Small (sub (ofQComplex (samplePoint z hz k n)) z.val) (inputRadius z hz k n).val := by
  have h := PrecisionSearch.stage_spec z.val z.property
    (⟨(inputRadius z hz k n).val/2, by
      exact Rat.mul_pos (inputRadius z hz k n).property (Rat.inv_pos.mpr (by decide : (0:Rat)<2))⟩ : QPos)
  have hc := rational_center_error z.val z.property (sampleStage z hz k n)
  apply RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ (hc.mono ?_)
  unfold centerError
  change (z.val.compute (sampleStage z hz k n)).width≤(inputRadius z hz k n).val/2 ∧
    (z.val.compute (sampleStage z hz k n)).height≤(inputRadius z hz k n).val/2 at h
  grind only

theorem samplePoint_upper (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (k n : Nat) :
    0 < (samplePoint z hz k n).im := by
  have hc := (samplePoint_close z hz k n).mono
    (minRadius_left (upperRadius z hz) _)
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := upperRadius_inside z hz (rationalUpperPoint (samplePoint z hz k n)) hc
  exact hN

/-- The only function computation at stage `n` is a finite rational-input sample. -/
def sampledPrefix (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (k n : Nat) : ComplexRaw :=
  rationalLatticeExactSample (samplePoint z hz k n) k (n+1)

theorem prefix_valid (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (k n : Nat) :
    (sampledPrefix z hz k n).Valid := rationalLatticeExactSample_valid _ _ _

private theorem self_small (z : Scalar) (H : Rat) (hH : 0≤H) : Small (sub z.val z.val) H := by
  have he : (sub z.val z.val).Equiv zero := by
    apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
      (hleft := sub_valid z.property z.property) (hright := ofQComplex_valid _)
    change ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw z.val z.property-ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw z.val z.property=0
    grind only
  exact Small.congr (ofQComplex_valid _) (sub_valid z.property z.property)
    (equiv_symm he) (Small.zero hH)

private theorem triangle (a b c : ComplexRaw) (ha : a.Valid) (hb : b.Valid) (hc : c.Valid)
    (E F : Rat) (hab : Small (sub a b) E) (hbc : Small (sub b c) F) :
    Small (sub a c) (E+F) := by
  have he : (add (sub a b) (sub b c)).Equiv (sub a c) := by
    apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
      (hleft := add_valid (sub_valid ha hb) (sub_valid hb hc)) (hright := sub_valid ha hc)
    change (ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw a ha-ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw b hb)+
      (ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw b hb-ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw c hc)=
      ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw a ha-ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw c hc
    grind only
  exact Small.congr (add_valid (sub_valid ha hb) (sub_valid hb hc))
    (sub_valid ha hc) he (LocalODE.small_add hab hbc)

theorem prefix_input_error (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (k n : Nat) :
    Small (sub (sampledPrefix z hz k n) (finiteLatticePrefix z hz k (n+1)))
      (RepresentedCauchySum.error n).val := by
  let q := rationalUpperPoint (samplePoint z hz k n)
  let hq := rationalUpperPoint_upper _ (samplePoint_upper z hz k n)
  have hc := samplePoint_close z hz k n
  obtain ⟨A,hA,hAh⟩ := upperCommonRegion z hz z
    (self_small z _ (Rat.le_of_lt (upperRadius z hz).property))
  obtain ⟨Z,hZ,hZh⟩ := upperCommonRegion z hz q (hc.mono (minRadius_left _ _))
  have hb := finiteLatticePrefix_difference_bound z q hz hq
    (neighborhoodRegionWidth z hz) (neighborhoodRegionWidth z hz) (neighborhoodRegionMargin z hz)
    (inputRadius z hz k n).val A Z
    (neighborhoodRegionWidth_nonnegative z hz) (neighborhoodRegionWidth_nonnegative z hz)
    (neighborhoodRegionMargin_positive z hz) (Rat.le_of_lt (inputRadius z hz k n).property)
    hA hZ hAh hZh hc k (n+1)
  have heq := FunctionTheory.sub_congr
    (rationalLatticePrefix_agrees (samplePoint z hz k n) (samplePoint_upper z hz k n) k (n+1))
    (equiv_refl _ (finiteLatticePrefix_valid z hz k (n+1)))
  apply Small.congr (sub_valid (finiteLatticePrefix_valid q hq k (n+1))
    (finiteLatticePrefix_valid z hz k (n+1)))
    (sub_valid (prefix_valid z hz k n) (finiteLatticePrefix_valid z hz k (n+1))) heq
  apply hb.mono
  let C := finiteLatticeDifferenceCoefficient (regionBound z hz) k (n+1)
  have hC : 0≤C := finiteLatticeDifferenceCoefficient_nonnegative _ (regionBound_nonnegative z hz) k (n+1)
  have hrad := minRadius_right (upperRadius z hz)
    (divideRadius (RepresentedCauchySum.error n) (⟨C+1,by grind only⟩ : QPos))
  have he := divideRadius_identity (RepresentedCauchySum.error n) (⟨C+1,by grind only⟩ : QPos)
  have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrad (show 0≤C+1 by grind only)
  have hp := (inputRadius z hz k n).property
  change C*(inputRadius z hz k n).val≤_
  change (C+1)*(inputRadius z hz k n).val≤_ at hm
  grind only

def tailConstant (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) : Rat :=
  regionalWeightFourTailConstant (neighborhoodRegionWidth z hz) (neighborhoodRegionWidth z hz)
    (neighborhoodRegionMargin z hz) +
  regionalWeightSixTailConstant (neighborhoodRegionWidth z hz) (neighborhoodRegionWidth z hz)
    (neighborhoodRegionMargin z hz)

theorem tailConstant_nonnegative (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) : 0≤tailConstant z hz :=
  Rat.add_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide) (Rat.pow_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide) (regionBound_nonnegative z hz))))
    (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide) (Rat.pow_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide) (regionBound_nonnegative z hz))))

def error (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (n : Nat) : Rat :=
  (tailConstant z hz+1)*(RepresentedCauchySum.error n).val

theorem error_shrinks (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) : ShrinksToZero (error z hz) :=
  SeriesLimitLaws.shrinks_scale _ RepresentedCauchySum.error_shrinks _
    (by have := tailConstant_nonnegative z hz; grind only)

theorem error_antitone (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (k n : Nat) (hkn : k≤n) :
    error z hz n≤error z hz k :=
  Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (RepresentedCauchySum.error_antitone k n hkn)
    (by have := tailConstant_nonnegative z hz; grind only)

def comparisonValue (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (k : Nat) : ComplexRaw :=
  if k=4 then upperWeightFourLatticeSum z hz else upperWeightSixLatticeSum z hz

theorem comparisonValue_valid (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (k : Nat) :
    (comparisonValue z hz k).Valid := by
  unfold comparisonValue; split
  · exact upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid z hz
  · exact upperWeightSixLatticeSum_valid z hz

theorem comparison_close (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (k : Nat) (hk : k=4 ∨ k=6) (n : Nat) :
    Small (sub (comparisonValue z hz k) (sampledPrefix z hz k n)) (error z hz n) := by
  obtain ⟨A,hA,hAh⟩ := upperCommonRegion z hz z
    (self_small z _ (Rat.le_of_lt (upperRadius z hz).property))
  let C4 := regionalWeightFourTailConstant (neighborhoodRegionWidth z hz)
    (neighborhoodRegionWidth z hz) (neighborhoodRegionMargin z hz)
  let C6 := regionalWeightSixTailConstant (neighborhoodRegionWidth z hz)
    (neighborhoodRegionWidth z hz) (neighborhoodRegionMargin z hz)
  have h4 : 0≤C4 := Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide)
    (Rat.pow_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide) (regionBound_nonnegative z hz)))
  have h6 : 0≤C6 := Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide)
    (Rat.pow_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide) (regionBound_nonnegative z hz)))
  have he := reciprocalSquare_le_reciprocal (n+1) (by omega)
  have hp := (RepresentedCauchySum.error n).property
  have hi := RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ (prefix_input_error z hz k n)
  rcases hk with rfl | rfl
  · have ht := upperWeightFourLatticeSum_region_remainder z hz
      (neighborhoodRegionWidth z hz) (neighborhoodRegionWidth z hz) (neighborhoodRegionMargin z hz)
      A (neighborhoodRegionWidth_nonnegative z hz) (neighborhoodRegionWidth_nonnegative z hz)
      (neighborhoodRegionMargin_positive z hz) hA hAh n
    have hf : finiteLatticePrefix z hz 4 (n+1)=upperWeightFourPrefix z hz n :=
      finiteLatticePrefix_four z hz (n+1)
    rw [hf] at hi
    have hb := triangle _ _ _ (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid z hz)
      (upperWeightFourPrefix_valid z hz n) (prefix_valid z hz 4 n) _ _ ht hi
    change Small (sub (upperWeightFourLatticeSum z hz) (sampledPrefix z hz 4 n)) _
    apply hb.mono
    have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he h4
    change C4*reciprocalSquare (n+1)≤C4*(RepresentedCauchySum.error n).val at hm
    have hm2 := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (show C4≤C4+C6 by grind only) (Rat.le_of_lt hp)
    change C4*reciprocalSquare (n+1)+(RepresentedCauchySum.error n).val≤
      (C4+C6+1)*(RepresentedCauchySum.error n).val
    grind only
  · have ht := upperWeightSixLatticeSum_region_remainder z hz
      (neighborhoodRegionWidth z hz) (neighborhoodRegionWidth z hz) (neighborhoodRegionMargin z hz)
      A (neighborhoodRegionWidth_nonnegative z hz) (neighborhoodRegionWidth_nonnegative z hz)
      (neighborhoodRegionMargin_positive z hz) hA hAh n
    have hf : finiteLatticePrefix z hz 6 (n+1)=upperWeightSixPrefix z hz n :=
      finiteLatticePrefix_six z hz (n+1)
    rw [hf] at hi
    have hb := triangle _ _ _ (upperWeightSixLatticeSum_valid z hz)
      (upperWeightSixPrefix_valid z hz n) (prefix_valid z hz 6 n) _ _ ht hi
    change Small (sub (upperWeightSixLatticeSum z hz) (sampledPrefix z hz 6 n)) _
    apply hb.mono
    have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he h6
    change C6*reciprocalSquare (n+1)≤C6*(RepresentedCauchySum.error n).val at hm
    have hm2 := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (show C6≤C4+C6 by grind only) (Rat.le_of_lt hp)
    change C6*reciprocalSquare (n+1)+(RepresentedCauchySum.error n).val≤
      (C4+C6+1)*(RepresentedCauchySum.error n).val
    grind only

def value (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (k : Nat) : ComplexRaw :=
  RepresentedCauchySum.value (sampledPrefix z hz k) (prefix_valid z hz k) (fun n => 2*error z hz n)

theorem prefix_cauchy (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (k : Nat) (hk : k=4 ∨ k=6)
    (m n : Nat) (hmn : m≤n) :
    Small (sub (sampledPrefix z hz k n) (sampledPrefix z hz k m)) (2*error z hz m) := by
  have hb := triangle _ _ _ (prefix_valid z hz k n) (comparisonValue_valid z hz k)
    (prefix_valid z hz k m) _ _
    (RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ (comparison_close z hz k hk n))
    (comparison_close z hz k hk m)
  apply hb.mono
  have := error_antitone z hz m n hmn
  grind only

theorem value_valid (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (k : Nat) (hk : k=4 ∨ k=6) :
    (value z hz k).Valid :=
  RepresentedCauchySum.value_valid _ _ _
    (RepresentedCauchySum.twice_shrinks _ (error_shrinks z hz)) (prefix_cauchy z hz k hk)

theorem value_agrees (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (k : Nat) (hk : k=4 ∨ k=6) :
    (value z hz k).Equiv (comparisonValue z hz k) := by
  apply SeriesLimitLaws.equiv_of_small_sub_zero
  apply SeriesLimitLaws.small_closed _ 0 (fun n => 3*error z hz n)
    (SeriesLimitLaws.shrinks_scale _ (error_shrinks z hz) 3 (by decide))
  intro n
  have hv := RepresentedCauchySum.value_close_prefix (sampledPrefix z hz k) (prefix_valid z hz k)
    (fun n => 2*error z hz n) (prefix_cauchy z hz k hk) n
  have hb := triangle _ _ _ (value_valid z hz k hk) (prefix_valid z hz k n)
    (comparisonValue_valid z hz k) _ _ hv
    (RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ (comparison_close z hz k hk n))
  have he : 2*error z hz n+error z hz n=0+3*error z hz n := by grind only
  rw [he] at hb
  exact hb

end RationalLattice

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.UpperPowerDifferenceBounds
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.UpperCommonRegion
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.UpperWeightFourSum
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.UpperWeightSixSum

/-! Finite lattice samples on rational complex inputs, and input-only stability bounds. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open ComplexRaw RiemannHilbert FunctionTheory QuadraticOrder163

/-- Sum over the nonzero lattice points in the square of radius `n`. -/
def finiteLatticePrefix (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (k : Nat) : Nat → ComplexRaw
  | 0 => zero
  | n+1 => add (finiteLatticePrefix z hz k n) (upperShellSum z hz (n+1) (by omega) k)

theorem finiteLatticePrefix_valid (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (k n : Nat) :
    (finiteLatticePrefix z hz k n).Valid := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ofQComplex_valid _
  | succ n ih => exact add_valid ih (upperShellSum_valid z hz _ _ _)

def rationalUpperPoint (q : QComplex) : Scalar := ⟨ofQComplex q, ofQComplex_valid q⟩

theorem rationalUpperPoint_upper (q : QComplex) (hq : 0 < q.im) :
    InUpperHalfPlane (rationalUpperPoint q).val := ⟨0, hq⟩

/-- Primary finite computation: the input is in `Q(i)`, every output box is rational,
and only finitely many lattice reciprocals are computed. -/
def rationalLatticeSample (q : QComplex) (hq : 0 < q.im) (k n : Nat) : ComplexRaw :=
  finiteLatticePrefix (rationalUpperPoint q) (rationalUpperPoint_upper q hq) k n

theorem rationalLatticeSample_valid (q : QComplex) (hq : 0 < q.im) (k n : Nat) :
    (rationalLatticeSample q hq k n).Valid := finiteLatticePrefix_valid _ _ _ _

theorem finiteLatticePrefix_four (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (n : Nat) :
    finiteLatticePrefix z hz 4 n = upperWeightFourTailBlock z hz 0 n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [finiteLatticePrefix, upperWeightFourTailBlock, ih, Nat.zero_add]

theorem finiteLatticePrefix_six (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (n : Nat) :
    finiteLatticePrefix z hz 6 n = upperWeightSixTailBlock z hz 0 n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [finiteLatticePrefix, upperWeightSixTailBlock, ih, Nat.zero_add]

/-- A deliberately coarse finite-prefix Lipschitz coefficient. It depends on
the input region and degree, never on an irrational function value. -/
def finiteLatticeDifferenceCoefficient (B : Rat) (k : Nat) : Nat → Rat
  | 0 => 0
  | n+1 => finiteLatticeDifferenceCoefficient B k n +
      ((8*(n+1):Nat):Rat)*powerDifferenceCoefficient B k*((n+1:Nat):Rat)

theorem finiteLatticeDifferenceCoefficient_nonnegative (B : Rat) (hB : 0≤B) (k n : Nat) :
    0≤finiteLatticeDifferenceCoefficient B k n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Rat.le_refl
  | succ n ih =>
    exact Rat.add_nonneg ih (Rat.mul_nonneg
      (Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.natCast_nonneg) (powerDifferenceCoefficient_nonnegative B hB k))
      (Rat.natCast_nonneg))

private theorem inverse_bound (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val)
    (R U eta : Rat) (N : Nat) (hR : 0≤R) (hU : 0≤U) (heta : 0<eta)
    (hreg : LatticeRegionBox z R eta N) (hheight : (z.val.compute N).hi.im≤U)
    (r : Nat) (hr : 0<r) (i : Fin (8*r)) :
    Small (latticeInverse z hz (shellPoint r i) (shellPoint_nonzero r hr i)).val
      (latticeRegionReciprocalConstant R U eta) := by
  have hb := latticeInverse_region_radius_bound z hz R U eta N hR hU heta hreg hheight
    (shellPoint r i) (shellPoint_nonzero r hr i)
  rw [shellRadius_shellPoint] at hb
  apply hb.mono
  have hB := latticeRegionReciprocalConstant_nonnegative R U eta hR hU heta
  have hrq : (1:Rat)≤(r:Rat) := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hi : (r:Rat)⁻¹≤1 := by
    have hp : 0<(r:Rat) := by exact_mod_cast hr
    have hn := Rat.inv_pos.mpr hp
    have he := Rat.mul_inv_cancel (r:Rat) (Rat.ne_of_gt hp)
    have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrq (Rat.le_of_lt hn)
    grind only
  change latticeRegionReciprocalConstant R U eta*(r:Rat)⁻¹≤_
  have := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi hB
  simpa using this

theorem finiteLatticePrefix_difference_bound (a z : Scalar)
    (ha : InUpperHalfPlane a.val) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val)
    (R U eta H : Rat) (A Z : Nat) (hR : 0≤R) (hU : 0≤U) (heta : 0<eta) (hH : 0≤H)
    (hA : LatticeRegionBox a R eta A) (hZ : LatticeRegionBox z R eta Z)
    (hAh : (a.val.compute A).hi.im≤U) (hZh : (z.val.compute Z).hi.im≤U)
    (hza : Small (sub z.val a.val) H) (k n : Nat) :
    Small (sub (finiteLatticePrefix z hz k n) (finiteLatticePrefix a ha k n))
      (finiteLatticeDifferenceCoefficient (latticeRegionReciprocalConstant R U eta) k n*H) := by
  let B := latticeRegionReciprocalConstant R U eta
  have hB : 0≤B := latticeRegionReciprocalConstant_nonnegative R U eta hR hU heta
  have hshell (r : Nat) (hr : 0<r) (m : Nat) :
      Small (sub (upperShellPrefix z hz r hr k m) (upperShellPrefix a ha r hr k m))
        ((m:Rat)*powerDifferenceCoefficient B k*(r:Rat)*H) := by
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      simp only [upperShellPrefix, show ((0:Nat):Rat)=0 from by decide, Rat.zero_mul]
      simpa only [Rat.zero_add] using SeriesLimitLaws.small_sub (Small.zero (by decide : (0:Rat)≤0)) (Small.zero (by decide : (0:Rat)≤0))
    | succ m ih =>
      have ht : Small (sub (upperShellTerm z hz r hr k m) (upperShellTerm a ha r hr k m))
          (powerDifferenceCoefficient B k*(r:Rat)*H) := by
        unfold upperShellTerm
        split
        · rename_i hm
          have hy := shellRadius_bounds (shellPoint r ⟨m,hm⟩)
          rw [shellRadius_shellPoint] at hy
          have hyl : -(r:Rat)≤((shellPoint r ⟨m,hm⟩).y:Rat) := by
            simpa only [Rat.intCast_neg, Rat.intCast_natCast] using Rat.intCast_le_intCast.mpr hy.2.2.1
          have hyu : ((shellPoint r ⟨m,hm⟩).y:Rat)≤(r:Rat) := by
            simpa only [Rat.intCast_natCast] using Rat.intCast_le_intCast.mpr hy.2.2.2.1
          exact latticePower_difference_bound _ _ a z ha hz B (r:Rat) H hB (Rat.natCast_nonneg) hH
            (inverse_bound a ha R U eta A hR hU heta hA hAh r hr _)
            (inverse_bound z hz R U eta Z hR hU heta hZ hZh r hr _)
            (by exact ⟨fun _ _ => hyl, fun _ _ => hyu, fun _ _ => by change -(r:Rat)≤0; have h : (0:Rat)≤(r:Rat) := Rat.natCast_nonneg; grind only,
              fun _ _ => by change (0:Rat)≤(r:Rat); exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_le r)⟩) hza k
        · apply (SeriesLimitLaws.small_sub (Small.zero (by decide : (0:Rat)≤0)) (Small.zero (by decide : (0:Rat)≤0))).mono
          simp only [Rat.zero_add]
          exact Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg (powerDifferenceCoefficient_nonnegative B hB k)
            (Rat.natCast_nonneg)) hH
      have hb := Small.congr
        (add_valid (sub_valid (upperShellPrefix_valid z hz _ _ _ _) (upperShellPrefix_valid a ha _ _ _ _))
          (sub_valid (upperShellTerm_valid z hz _ _ _ _) (upperShellTerm_valid a ha _ _ _ _)))
        (sub_valid (upperShellPrefix_valid z hz r hr k (m+1)) (upperShellPrefix_valid a ha r hr k (m+1)))
        (equiv_symm (SeriesLimitLaws.addition_difference _ _ _ _
          (upperShellPrefix_valid z hz _ _ _ _) (upperShellPrefix_valid a ha _ _ _ _)
          (upperShellTerm_valid z hz _ _ _ _) (upperShellTerm_valid a ha _ _ _ _)))
        (LocalODE.small_add ih ht)
      have he : (m:Rat)*powerDifferenceCoefficient B k*(r:Rat)*H +
          powerDifferenceCoefficient B k*(r:Rat)*H =
          ((m+1:Nat):Rat)*powerDifferenceCoefficient B k*(r:Rat)*H := by
        simp only [Rat.natCast_add]; grind only
      rw [he] at hb
      exact hb
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [finiteLatticePrefix, finiteLatticeDifferenceCoefficient, Rat.zero_mul]
    simpa only [Rat.zero_add] using SeriesLimitLaws.small_sub (Small.zero (by decide : (0:Rat)≤0)) (Small.zero (by decide : (0:Rat)≤0))
  | succ n ih =>
    have hb := LocalODE.small_add ih (hshell (n+1) (by omega) (8*(n+1)))
    have he := SeriesLimitLaws.addition_difference
      (finiteLatticePrefix z hz k n) (finiteLatticePrefix a ha k n)
      (upperShellSum z hz (n+1) (by omega) k) (upperShellSum a ha (n+1) (by omega) k)
      (finiteLatticePrefix_valid z hz k n) (finiteLatticePrefix_valid a ha k n)
      (upperShellSum_valid z hz _ _ _) (upperShellSum_valid a ha _ _ _)
    have hc := Small.congr
      (add_valid (sub_valid (finiteLatticePrefix_valid z hz k n) (finiteLatticePrefix_valid a ha k n))
        (sub_valid (upperShellSum_valid z hz _ _ _) (upperShellSum_valid a ha _ _ _)))
      (sub_valid (finiteLatticePrefix_valid z hz k (n+1)) (finiteLatticePrefix_valid a ha k (n+1)))
      (equiv_symm he) hb
    have heq : finiteLatticeDifferenceCoefficient B k n*H +
        ((8*(n+1):Nat):Rat)*powerDifferenceCoefficient B k*((n+1:Nat):Rat)*H =
        finiteLatticeDifferenceCoefficient B k (n+1)*H := by
      rw [finiteLatticeDifferenceCoefficient]; grind only
    rw [heq] at hc
    exact hc

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

/-! Exact CM evaluations through the rational nome and Eisenstein charts.
These bridges preserve both irrational names and previously checked identities. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert DomainFunctions

/-- The sampled nome lies in exactly the same certified Eisenstein chart. -/
theorem sampledNome_eisenstein_mem (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val)
    (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain (nome.eval z hz)) : wideLambertFifthDomain (sampledNomeValue z hz) :=
  (wideLambertFifthDomain_openData.invariant _ _ (equiv_symm (sampledNomeValue_agrees z hz))).mp hq

theorem sampledNome_eisenstein_agrees (w : RationalEisenstein.Weight) (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val)
    (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain (nome.eval z hz)) :
    ((RationalEisenstein.derivedMap w).eval (sampledNomeValue z hz) (sampledNome_eisenstein_mem z hz hq)).val.Equiv
      ((RationalEisenstein.legacyMap w).eval (nome.eval z hz) (RationalEisenstein.legacyDomain w _ hq)).val :=
  equiv_trans (RationalEisenstein.derivedValue w _ _).property
    ((RationalEisenstein.legacyMap w).eval (sampledNomeValue z hz)
      (RationalEisenstein.legacyDomain w _ (sampledNome_eisenstein_mem z hz hq))).property
    ((RationalEisenstein.legacyMap w).eval (nome.eval z hz) (RationalEisenstein.legacyDomain w _ hq)).property
    (RationalEisenstein.derivedValue_agrees w _ _)
    ((RationalEisenstein.legacyMap w).eval_congr _ _ _ _ (sampledNomeValue_agrees z hz))

theorem sampledNome_cm163_exact :
    (sampledNomeValue cmScalar163 cmPoint163_upper).val.Equiv
      (neg (sampledNomeChartValue cmDecayExponent163).val) :=
  equiv_trans (sampledNomeValue _ _).property (nome.eval cmScalar163 cmPoint163_upper).property
    (neg_valid (sampledNomeChartValue _).property) (sampledNomeValue_agrees _ _)
    (equiv_trans (nome.eval cmScalar163 cmPoint163_upper).property
      (neg_valid (entireExponentialValue _).property) (neg_valid (sampledNomeChartValue _).property)
      nome_cm163_negative_exponential (neg_equiv (equiv_symm (sampledNomeChartValue_agrees _))))

theorem sampledNome_cm43_exact :
    (sampledNomeValue cmScalar43 cmPoint43_upper).val.Equiv
      (neg (sampledNomeChartValue cmDecayExponent43).val) :=
  equiv_trans (sampledNomeValue _ _).property (nome.eval cmScalar43 cmPoint43_upper).property
    (neg_valid (sampledNomeChartValue _).property) (sampledNomeValue_agrees _ _)
    (equiv_trans (nome.eval cmScalar43 cmPoint43_upper).property
      (neg_valid (entireExponentialValue _).property) (neg_valid (sampledNomeChartValue _).property)
      nome_cm43_negative_exponential (neg_equiv (equiv_symm (sampledNomeChartValue_agrees _))))

theorem nome_cm163_eisenstein_chart : wideLambertFifthDomain (nome.eval cmScalar163 cmPoint163_upper) :=
  ⟨1/68719476736,by decide +kernel,by decide +kernel,nome_cm163_small_thirtySix_power⟩
theorem nome_cm43_eisenstein_chart : wideLambertFifthDomain (nome.eval cmScalar43 cmPoint43_upper) :=
  ⟨1/750000000,by decide +kernel,by decide +kernel,nome_cm43_small⟩

def sampledCMEisenstein163 (w : RationalEisenstein.Weight) : Scalar :=
  (RationalEisenstein.derivedMap w).eval (sampledNomeValue cmScalar163 cmPoint163_upper)
    (sampledNome_eisenstein_mem _ _ nome_cm163_eisenstein_chart)
def sampledCMEisenstein43 (w : RationalEisenstein.Weight) : Scalar :=
  (RationalEisenstein.derivedMap w).eval (sampledNomeValue cmScalar43 cmPoint43_upper)
    (sampledNome_eisenstein_mem _ _ nome_cm43_eisenstein_chart)

theorem sampledCMEisenstein163_agrees (w : RationalEisenstein.Weight) :
    (sampledCMEisenstein163 w).val.Equiv
      ((RationalEisenstein.legacyMap w).eval (nome.eval cmScalar163 cmPoint163_upper)
        (RationalEisenstein.legacyDomain w _ nome_cm163_eisenstein_chart)).val :=
  sampledNome_eisenstein_agrees w _ _ nome_cm163_eisenstein_chart

theorem sampledCMEisenstein43_agrees (w : RationalEisenstein.Weight) :
    (sampledCMEisenstein43 w).val.Equiv
      ((RationalEisenstein.legacyMap w).eval (nome.eval cmScalar43 cmPoint43_upper)
        (RationalEisenstein.legacyDomain w _ nome_cm43_eisenstein_chart)).val :=
  sampledNome_eisenstein_agrees w _ _ nome_cm43_eisenstein_chart

theorem sampledCMEisensteinFour163_agrees : (sampledCMEisenstein163 .four).val.Equiv cmEisensteinFour163.val := by
  let q := nome.eval cmScalar163 cmPoint163_upper
  have h := weightedLambertSum_congr q q (1/64) (1/68719476736) 3
    (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel)
    (LocalODE.interior_bound _ _ nome_cm163_eisenstein_chart) nome_cm163_small_thirtySix_power
    (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) (equiv_refl _ q.property)
  exact equiv_trans (sampledCMEisenstein163 .four).property
    (wideNomeEisensteinFourMap.eval q nome_cm163_eisenstein_chart).property cmEisensteinFour163.property
    (sampledCMEisenstein163_agrees .four)
    (add_equiv (equiv_refl one (ofQComplex_valid _)) (scaleRat_equiv h))

/-- Exact CM Fourier identity with both j and E4 computed from rational
samples and the nome computed from rational exponent-chart samples. -/
theorem sampledCM163_normalized_fourier_product :
    (mul (sampledJValue cmScalar163 cmPoint163_upper).val cmFourierDiscriminant163.val).Equiv
      (LocalODE.power (sampledCMEisenstein163 .four).val 3) := by
  have hj : (sampledJValue cmScalar163 cmPoint163_upper).val.Equiv cmJValue163.val := sampledJValue_agrees _ _
  exact equiv_trans (mul_valid (sampledJValue _ _).property cmFourierDiscriminant163.property)
    (mul_valid cmJValue163.property cmFourierDiscriminant163.property)
    (LocalODE.power_valid _ (sampledCMEisenstein163 .four).property 3)
    (mul_equiv (sampledJValue _ _).property cmJValue163.property cmFourierDiscriminant163.property
      cmFourierDiscriminant163.property hj (equiv_refl _ cmFourierDiscriminant163.property))
    (equiv_trans (mul_valid cmJValue163.property cmFourierDiscriminant163.property)
      (LocalODE.power_valid _ cmEisensteinFour163.property 3)
      (LocalODE.power_valid _ (sampledCMEisenstein163 .four).property 3)
      cmJValue163_normalized_fourier_product
      (LocalODE.power_congr _ _ cmEisensteinFour163.property (sampledCMEisenstein163 .four).property
        (equiv_symm sampledCMEisensteinFour163_agrees) 3))

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

import ComputableAnalysis.ElementaryRational
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.ExponentialLiftAgreement
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.Nome
import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.BoxApproximation

/-! The nome in the exponent chart `w = 2*pi*i*tau`. Rational chart
samples use the elementary rational power-series exponential. Evaluation at
an arbitrary represented point uses moving rational Taylor centers. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert DomainFunctions

/-- Primary rational exponent-chart sampler. The chart coordinate is `w`,
not `tau` and not the nome `q`. -/
abbrev rationalNomeChart : FunctionRaw := ElementaryRational.exponential

theorem rationalNomeChart_valid : rationalNomeChart.Valid := ElementaryRational.exponential_valid

private def exponentBudget (w : Scalar) : Rat := 2*LocalODE.boxCoordinateBound (w.val.compute 0)

private def exponentInput (w : Scalar) : ComplexExponentialLift.BoundedInput (exponentBudget w) where
  raw := w.val
  valid := w.property
  radius_nonneg := Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide) (LocalODE.boxCoordinateBound_nonneg _)
  center_normBound n := by
    have hb := BoxApproximation.center_bound w n
    change max (qabs (w.val.compute n).center.re) (qabs (w.val.compute n).center.im) ≤
      LocalODE.boxCoordinateBound (w.val.compute 0) at hb
    change qabs (w.val.compute n).center.re+qabs (w.val.compute n).center.im ≤ _
    dsimp [exponentBudget]
    grind

/-- Derived evaluation: finite rational Taylor prefixes at the input-box
centers, with input-motion and series-tail errors, then rational intersection. -/
def sampledNomeChartValue (w : Scalar) : Scalar :=
  ⟨ComplexExponentialLift.BoundedInput.exponential (exponentInput w),
    ComplexExponentialLift.BoundedInput.exponential_valid _⟩

theorem sampledNomeChartValue_agrees (w : Scalar) :
    (sampledNomeChartValue w).val.Equiv (entireExponentialValue w).val :=
  equiv_symm (entireExponential_legacy_lift (exponentInput w))

theorem sampledNomeChart_rational_agreement (w : QComplex) :
    (sampledNomeChartValue ⟨ofQComplex w,ofQComplex_valid w⟩).val.Equiv
      (rationalNomeChart.evalRaw w trivial) := by
  exact equiv_trans (sampledNomeChartValue _).property (entireExponentialValue _).property
    (ElementaryRational.exponentialValue_valid w) (sampledNomeChartValue_agrees _)
    (entireExponential_legacy_rational w (QComplex.normBound w)
      (QComplex.normBound_nonneg w) Rat.le_refl)

def sampledNomeValue (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) : Scalar :=
  sampledNomeChartValue (nomeExponentMap.eval z hz)

theorem sampledNomeValue_agrees (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) :
    (sampledNomeValue z hz).val.Equiv (nome.eval z hz).val := sampledNomeChartValue_agrees _

def sampledNome : DomainFunctions.Map where
  domain z := InUpperHalfPlane z.val
  eval := sampledNomeValue
  domain_congr := upperOpenData.invariant
  eval_congr z w hz hw he := equiv_trans (sampledNomeValue z hz).property
    (nome.eval z hz).property (sampledNomeValue w hw).property (sampledNomeValue_agrees z hz)
    (equiv_trans (nome.eval z hz).property (nome.eval w hw).property (sampledNomeValue w hw).property
      (nome.eval_congr z w hz hw he) (equiv_symm (sampledNomeValue_agrees w hw)))

def sampledNome_holomorphic : Holomorphic sampledNome :=
  nome_holomorphic.transfer sampledNome (fun _ h => h) ⟨upperRadius,upperRadius_inside⟩
    (fun z hz => equiv_symm (sampledNomeValue_agrees z hz))

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

import ComputableAnalysis.HolomorphicJet
import ComputableAnalysis.Series

/-!
# The finite Cauchy kernel expansion on a Euclidean disk

Only rational complex arithmetic is used. `InDisk z r` uses squared Euclidean
modulus, so the radius is not silently reduced to an inscribed coordinate
diamond. The expansion is finite; its error estimate is the input needed by
a certified Cauchy integral formula, not a replacement for that formula.
-/

namespace ComputableAnalysis.CauchyTaylor

open QComplex

def InDisk (z : QComplex) (r : Rat) : Prop := normSq z ≤ r * r

theorem normSq_nonneg (z : QComplex) : 0 ≤ normSq z := by
  exact Rat.add_nonneg (rat_square_nonneg_basic _) (rat_square_nonneg_basic _)

theorem disk_coordinates {z : QComplex} {r : Rat} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hz : InDisk z r) : -r ≤ z.re ∧ z.re ≤ r ∧ -r ≤ z.im ∧ z.im ≤ r := by
  have hre := rat_square_nonneg_basic z.re
  have him := rat_square_nonneg_basic z.im
  unfold InDisk normSq at hz
  constructor
  · by_cases h : -r ≤ z.re
    · exact h
    have hp := Rat.mul_pos (show 0 < -z.re - r by grind)
      (show 0 < -z.re + r by grind); grind
  constructor
  · by_cases h : z.re ≤ r
    · exact h
    have hp := Rat.mul_pos (show 0 < z.re - r by grind)
      (show 0 < z.re + r by grind); grind
  constructor
  · by_cases h : -r ≤ z.im
    · exact h
    have hp := Rat.mul_pos (show 0 < -z.im - r by grind)
      (show 0 < -z.im + r by grind); grind
  · by_cases h : z.im ≤ r
    · exact h
    have hp := Rat.mul_pos (show 0 < z.im - r by grind)
      (show 0 < z.im + r by grind); grind

theorem disk_mul {z w : QComplex} {r s : Rat}
    (hz : InDisk z r) (hw : InDisk w s) : InDisk (mul z w) (r * s) := by
  have h1 := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hz (normSq_nonneg w)
  have h2 := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw (rat_square_nonneg_basic r)
  unfold InDisk at *
  rw [normSq_mul]
  grind

theorem disk_power {z : QComplex} {r : Rat} (hz : InDisk z r) (n : Nat) :
    InDisk (natPow z n) (r ^ n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [InDisk, natPow, normSq, one, Rat.add_zero]
  | succ n ih => simpa only [natPow, Rat.pow_succ] using disk_mul ih hz

theorem denominator_separated {z : QComplex} {r : Rat}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1) (hz : InDisk z r) :
    (1 - r) * (1 - r) ≤ normSq (sub one z) := by
  have hc := disk_coordinates hr hz
  have hp := Rat.mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ r - z.re by grind)
    (show 0 ≤ 2 - r - z.re by grind)
  have hi := rat_square_nonneg_basic z.im
  simp only [normSq, sub, one, add, neg]
  grind

theorem denominator_ne_zero {z : QComplex} {r : Rat}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) (hz : InDisk z r) : normSq (sub one z) ≠ 0 := by
  have h := denominator_separated hr (Rat.le_of_lt hr1) hz
  have hp := Rat.mul_pos (show 0 < 1-r by grind) (show 0 < 1-r by grind)
  grind

def kernel (z : QComplex) : QComplex := inverse (sub one z)

theorem kernel_disk {z : QComplex} {r : Rat}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) (hz : InDisk z r) :
    InDisk (kernel z) (1-r)⁻¹ := by
  have hs := denominator_separated hr (Rat.le_of_lt hr1) hz
  have hn := denominator_ne_zero hr hr1 hz
  have he := congrArg normSq (mul_inverse_of_normSq_ne_zero (sub one z) hn)
  rw [normSq_mul] at he
  have hi := Rat.mul_inv_cancel (1-r) (show 1-r ≠ 0 by grind)
  have hp := Rat.mul_pos (show 0 < 1-r by grind) (show 0 < 1-r by grind)
  have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs (normSq_nonneg (kernel z))
  apply Rat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right (c := (1-r)*(1-r)) ?_ hp
  change normSq (kernel z) * ((1-r)*(1-r)) ≤ ((1-r)⁻¹*(1-r)⁻¹)*((1-r)*(1-r))
  have he' : normSq (sub one z) * normSq (kernel z) = 1 := by
    simpa only [kernel, normSq, one, Rat.one_mul, Rat.zero_mul, Rat.add_zero] using he
  have hi2 : ((1-r)⁻¹*(1-r)⁻¹)*((1-r)*(1-r)) = 1 := by
    calc
      _ = ((1-r)*(1-r)⁻¹)*((1-r)*(1-r)⁻¹) := by grind only
      _ = 1 := by rw [hi, Rat.one_mul]
  rw [hi2]
  grind only

/-- `N` terms, with the empty sum at `N = 0`. -/
def geometric (z : QComplex) : Nat → QComplex
  | 0 => zero
  | n+1 => add one (mul z (geometric z n))

theorem kernel_unfold (z : QComplex) (hz : normSq (sub one z) ≠ 0) :
    kernel z = add one (mul z (kernel z)) := by
  have h := mul_inverse_of_normSq_ne_zero (sub one z) hz
  change mul (sub one z) (kernel z) = one at h
  apply QComplex.le_antisymm <;>
    simp only [QComplex.le_def, add, one, mul] <;>
    simp only [sub, add, neg, one, mul, QComplex.mk.injEq] at h
  all_goals constructor <;> grind

/-- Exact finite geometric identity; no convergence premise. -/
theorem kernel_remainder (z : QComplex) (hz : normSq (sub one z) ≠ 0) (N : Nat) :
    sub (kernel z) (geometric z N) = mul (natPow z N) (kernel z) := by
  induction N with
  | zero =>
      simp only [geometric, natPow, one_mul_cert, sub, add, neg, zero]
      cases kernel z
      simp [Rat.add_zero]
  | succ N ih =>
      have hk := kernel_unfold z hz
      rw [geometric, natPow]
      simp only [sub, add, neg, mul, one, QComplex.mk.injEq] at ih hk ⊢
      constructor <;> grind

/-- Euclidean disk bound for the actual kernel remainder. -/
theorem kernel_remainder_disk {z : QComplex} {r : Rat}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) (hz : InDisk z r) (N : Nat) :
    InDisk (sub (kernel z) (geometric z N)) (r ^ N * (1-r)⁻¹) := by
  rw [kernel_remainder z (denominator_ne_zero hr hr1 hz)]
  exact disk_mul (disk_power hz N) (kernel_disk hr hr1 hz)

theorem kernel_remainder_coordinates {z : QComplex} {r : Rat}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) (hz : InDisk z r) (N : Nat) :
    let error := sub (kernel z) (geometric z N);
    let bound := r ^ N * (1-r)⁻¹;
    -bound ≤ error.re ∧ error.re ≤ bound ∧ -bound ≤ error.im ∧ error.im ≤ bound := by
  exact disk_coordinates
    (Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.pow_nonneg hr)
      (Rat.le_of_lt ((Rat.inv_pos).2 (by grind))))
    (kernel_remainder_disk hr hr1 hz N)

/-- A rate valid for every rational ratio below one, not only `r ≤ 1/2`. -/
theorem power_budget {r : Rat} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (_hr1 : r < 1) (n : Nat) :
    (1 + (n : Rat) * (1-r)) * r ^ n ≤ 1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [Rat.pow_zero, Rat.zero_mul, Rat.add_zero, Rat.mul_one]
  | succ n ih =>
      have hn : 0 ≤ (n : Rat) := Rat.natCast_nonneg
      have hd : 0 ≤ (1-r)*(1-r) := rat_square_nonneg_basic _
      have hnd := Rat.mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ (n : Rat)+1 by grind) hd
      have ha : (1 + ((n : Rat)+1)*(1-r))*r ≤ 1+(n : Rat)*(1-r) := by grind
      have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha (Rat.pow_nonneg hr (n := n))
      simp only [Rat.pow_succ, Rat.natCast_add] at *
      grind only

theorem power_nat_bound {r : Rat} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) (n : Nat) :
    r ^ n ≤ (1-r)⁻¹ / ((n+1 : Nat) : Rat) := by
  have hp := power_budget hr hr1 n
  have hn : (0 : Rat) < ((n+1 : Nat) : Rat) := (Rat.natCast_pos).2 (by omega)
  have hd : 0 < 1-r := by grind
  have hb : (((n+1 : Nat) : Rat)*(1-r)) * r^n ≤ 1 := by
    have h := Rat.mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ r by grind) (Rat.pow_nonneg hr (n := n))
    simp only [Rat.natCast_add] at *
    grind only
  have hi := Rat.mul_inv_cancel (1-r) (Rat.ne_of_gt hd)
  have hj := Rat.mul_inv_cancel (((n+1 : Nat) : Rat)) (Rat.ne_of_gt hn)
  apply Rat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right (c := (1-r)*((n+1 : Nat) : Rat)) ?_
    (Rat.mul_pos hd hn)
  have he : ((1-r)⁻¹ / ((n+1 : Nat) : Rat))*((1-r)*((n+1 : Nat) : Rat)) = 1 := by
    rw [Rat.div_def]
    calc
      _ = ((1-r)*(1-r)⁻¹)*(((n+1 : Nat) : Rat)*(((n+1 : Nat) : Rat))⁻¹) := by grind only
      _ = 1 := by rw [hi, hj, Rat.one_mul]
  rw [he]
  grind only

theorem power_antitone {r : Rat} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1)
    {n m : Nat} (hnm : n ≤ m) : r^m ≤ r^n := by
  induction hnm with
  | refl => exact Rat.le_refl
  | @step m hnm ih =>
      have h := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr1 (Rat.pow_nonneg hr (n := m))
      rw [Rat.pow_succ]
      have hm : r^m*r ≤ r^m := by simpa only [Rat.mul_one] using h
      exact Rat.le_trans hm ih

/-! Rational radius independence, uniform continuity, and the old chart bridge. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambert
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert RationalLambert CauchyTaylor
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000

theorem atRadius_close_later (q : QComplex) (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (hq : InDisk q r)
    (k N L : Nat) (hL : cutoff r k+N≤L) :
    Small (sub (atRadius q r k) (ofQComplex (finitePrefix q k L))) (tail r k N) := by
  have hc := atRadius_close q r hr hr1 hq k (L-cutoff r k)
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' (show cutoff r k≤L by omega)] at hc
  exact hc.mono (tail_antitone r hr hr1 k N (L-cutoff r k) (by omega))

theorem radius_independent (q : QComplex) (r s : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hs : 0≤s) (hr1 : r<1) (hs1 : s<1)
    (hqr : InDisk q r) (hqs : InDisk q s) (k : Nat) : (atRadius q r k).Equiv (atRadius q s k) := by
  apply SeriesLimitLaws.equiv_of_small_sub_zero
  apply SeriesLimitLaws.small_closed _ 0 (fun N => tail r k N+tail s k N)
    (RepresentedCauchySum.sum_shrinks _ _ (tail_shrinks r hr hr1 k) (tail_shrinks s hs hs1 k))
  intro N
  let L := max (cutoff r k) (cutoff s k)+N
  have ha := atRadius_close_later q r hr hr1 hqr k N L (by dsimp [L]; omega)
  have hb := atRadius_close_later q s hs hs1 hqs k N L (by dsimp [L]; omega)
  have h := triangle _ _ _ (atRadius_valid q r hr hr1 hqr k) (ofQComplex_valid _) (atRadius_valid q s hs hs1 hqs k)
    _ _ ha (RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ hb)
  exact h.mono (by grind only)

theorem rational_atRadius (q : QComplex) (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (hq : InDisk q r) (k : Nat) :
    (rationalValue q k).Equiv (atRadius q r k) :=
  radius_independent q (rationalRadius q) r (Rat.le_of_lt (rationalRadius_pos q)) hr
    (rationalRadius_lt_one q (by
      have := rat_square_nonneg_basic (1-r)
      have hh := Rat.mul_pos (show 0<1-r by grind only) (show 0<1+r by grind only)
      change QComplex.normSq q≤r*r at hq
      grind only)) hr1 (rationalRadius_inside q) hq k

theorem atRadius_lipschitz (p q : QComplex) (r : Rat) (hr : 0<r) (hr1 : r<1)
    (hp : InDisk p r) (hq : InDisk q r) (k : Nat) :
    Small (sub (atRadius p r k) (atRadius q r k)) (continuityBound r k*(QComplex.sub p q).normBound) := by
  apply SeriesLimitLaws.small_closed _ _ (fun N => 2*tail r k N)
    (RepresentedCauchySum.twice_shrinks _ (tail_shrinks r (Rat.le_of_lt hr) hr1 k))
  intro N
  let L := cutoff r k+N
  have hc := rational_difference_small _ _ _ (prefix_difference p q r hr hr1 hp hq k L)
  have h1 := triangle _ _ _ (atRadius_valid p r (Rat.le_of_lt hr) hr1 hp k) (ofQComplex_valid _) (ofQComplex_valid _)
    _ _ (atRadius_close p r (Rat.le_of_lt hr) hr1 hp k N) hc
  have h2 := triangle _ _ _ (atRadius_valid p r (Rat.le_of_lt hr) hr1 hp k) (ofQComplex_valid _) (atRadius_valid q r (Rat.le_of_lt hr) hr1 hq k)
    _ _ h1 (RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ (atRadius_close q r (Rat.le_of_lt hr) hr1 hq k N))
  exact h2.mono (by grind only)

theorem rational_lipschitz (p q : QComplex) (r : Rat) (hr : 0<r) (hr1 : r<1)
    (hp : InDisk p r) (hq : InDisk q r) (k : Nat) :
    Small (sub (rationalValue p k) (rationalValue q k)) (continuityBound r k*(QComplex.sub p q).normBound) := by
  have hp1 : QComplex.normSq p<1 := by
    have h := Rat.mul_pos (show 0<1-r by grind only) (show 0<1+r by grind only)
    change QComplex.normSq p≤r*r at hp
    grind only
  have hq1 : QComplex.normSq q<1 := by
    have h := Rat.mul_pos (show 0<1-r by grind only) (show 0<1+r by grind only)
    change QComplex.normSq q≤r*r at hq
    grind only
  exact Small.congr (sub_valid (atRadius_valid p r (Rat.le_of_lt hr) hr1 hp k) (atRadius_valid q r (Rat.le_of_lt hr) hr1 hq k))
    (sub_valid (rationalValue_valid p hp1 k) (rationalValue_valid q hq1 k))
    (FunctionTheory.sub_congr (equiv_symm (rational_atRadius p r (Rat.le_of_lt hr) hr1 hp k))
      (equiv_symm (rational_atRadius q r (Rat.le_of_lt hr) hr1 hq k)))
    (atRadius_lipschitz p q r hr hr1 hp hq k)

theorem rational_legacy_agreement (q : QComplex) (hq : Small (ofQComplex q) ((1:Rat)/64))
    (k : Nat) (hk : k=1 ∨ k=3 ∨ k=5) :
    (rationalValue q k).Equiv (comparison (point q) hq k).val := by
  have coords : -((1:Rat)/64)≤q.re ∧ q.re≤(1:Rat)/64 ∧ -((1:Rat)/64)≤q.im ∧ q.im≤(1:Rat)/64 :=
    ⟨hq.1 0 0,hq.2.1 0 0,hq.2.2.1 0 0,hq.2.2.2 0 0⟩
  have disk : InDisk q (1/32) := by
    have h1 := Rat.mul_nonneg (show 0≤(1:Rat)/64-q.re by grind only) (show 0≤(1:Rat)/64+q.re by grind only)
    have h2 := Rat.mul_nonneg (show 0≤(1:Rat)/64-q.im by grind only) (show 0≤(1:Rat)/64+q.im by grind only)
    dsimp [InDisk,QComplex.normSq]
    grind only
  have hv := atRadius_valid q (1/32) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) disk k
  have he : (atRadius q (1/32) k).Equiv (comparison (point q) hq k).val := by
    apply SeriesLimitLaws.equiv_of_small_sub_zero
    apply SeriesLimitLaws.small_closed _ 0 (fun N => tail (1/32) k N+8*((1:Rat)/2)^N)
      (RepresentedCauchySum.sum_shrinks _ _ (tail_shrinks (1/32) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) k)
        (by simpa only [show (4:Rat)*2=8 by decide +kernel] using
          LocalODE.tail_bound_shrinks 2 (1/2) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel)))
    intro N
    let L := cutoff (1/32) k+N
    have ht := comparison_tail (point q) hq k hk L
    have ht' := Small.congr (sub_valid (comparison (point q) hq k).property
      (ScalarSeries.block_valid _ (weightedLambertTerm_valid (point q) (1/64) k (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) hq) 0 L))
      (sub_valid (comparison (point q) hq k).property (ofQComplex_valid _))
      (FunctionTheory.sub_congr (equiv_refl _ (comparison (point q) hq k).property) (prefix_agrees q hq k L)) ht
    have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (power_antitone (by decide +kernel : (0:Rat)≤1/2)
      (by decide +kernel : (1/2:Rat)≤1) (show N≤L by dsimp [L]; omega)) (by decide +kernel : (0:Rat)≤8)
    have hb := triangle _ _ _ hv (ofQComplex_valid _) (comparison (point q) hq k).property
      _ _ (atRadius_close q (1/32) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) disk k N)
      (RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ (ht'.mono hm))
    exact hb.mono (by grind only)
  have hq1 : QComplex.normSq q<1 := by change QComplex.normSq q≤(1/32:Rat)*(1/32:Rat) at disk; grind only
  exact equiv_trans (rationalValue_valid q hq1 k) hv (comparison (point q) hq k).property
    (rational_atRadius q (1/32) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) disk k) he

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambert
