/-! Uniform finite-prefix continuity on arbitrary compact Euclidean disks. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambert
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert RationalLambert CauchyTaylor EisensteinUnitDisk
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000

theorem disk_add (p q : QComplex) (r s : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hs : 0≤s)
    (hp : InDisk p r) (hq : InDisk q s) : InDisk (QComplex.add p q) (r+s) := by
  have hc := qcomplex_coordinate_cauchy_schwarz p q
  have hmul := Rat.le_trans (Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp (normSq_nonneg q))
    (Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq (rat_square_nonneg_basic r))
  have hdot : p.re*q.re+p.im*q.im≤r*s := by
    by_cases h : p.re*q.re+p.im*q.im≤r*s
    · exact h
    have hpos : 0<(p.re*q.re+p.im*q.im-r*s)*(p.re*q.re+p.im*q.im+r*s) :=
      Rat.mul_pos (by grind only) (by have := Rat.mul_nonneg hr hs; grind only)
    dsimp [InDisk] at *
    simp only [Rat.pow_succ,Rat.pow_zero,Rat.one_mul] at hc
    grind only
  have he := qcomplex_normSq_add_expansion p q
  dsimp [InDisk] at *
  grind only

theorem natPow_eq_pow (q : QComplex) (n : Nat) : QComplex.natPow q n=QComplex.pow q n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [QComplex.natPow,QComplex.pow,ih,QComplex.mul_comm_cert]

theorem power_difference_disk (p q : QComplex) (r D : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hD : 0≤D)
    (hp : InDisk p r) (hq : InDisk q r) (hd : InDisk (QComplex.sub p q) D) (n : Nat) :
    InDisk (QComplex.sub (QComplex.natPow p (n+1)) (QComplex.natPow q (n+1))) (((n+1:Nat):Rat)*r^n*D) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [QComplex.natPow,QComplex.one_mul_cert,Rat.pow_zero,Rat.mul_one]
    simpa only [show ((0+1:Nat):Rat)=1 by decide +kernel,Rat.one_mul] using hd
  | succ n ih =>
    have h1 := disk_mul hp ih
    have h2 := disk_mul hd (disk_power hq (n+1))
    have h := disk_add _ _ _ _ (Rat.mul_nonneg hr (Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg Rat.natCast_nonneg (Rat.pow_nonneg hr)) hD))
      (Rat.mul_nonneg hD (Rat.pow_nonneg hr)) h1 h2
    have he : ∀u:QComplex, QComplex.natPow u (n+1+1)=QComplex.mul u (QComplex.natPow u (n+1)) := by
      intro u; rw [QComplex.natPow,QComplex.mul_comm_cert]
    rw [he,he,QComplex.mul_sub_mul_decompose]
    have hid : r*(((n+1:Nat):Rat)*r^n*D)+D*r^(n+1)=((n+1+1:Nat):Rat)*r^(n+1)*D := by
      rw [Rat.pow_succ]; simp only [Rat.natCast_add]; grind only
    rw [hid] at h
    exact h

def inverseBound (r : Rat) : Rat := 3*((1-r)*(1-r))⁻¹

theorem inverseBound_nonneg (r : Rat) (hr1 : r<1) : 0≤inverseBound r :=
  Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide +kernel) (Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr (Rat.mul_pos (by grind only) (by grind only))))

theorem power_denominator (q : QComplex) (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (hq : InDisk q r) (n : Nat) :
    (1-r)*(1-r)≤QComplex.normSq (denominator q n) ∧ (denominator q n).normBound≤3 := by
  have hpr := power_antitone hr (Rat.le_of_lt hr1) (show 1≤n+1 by omega)
  rw [Rat.pow_one] at hpr
  have hp : InDisk (QComplex.natPow q (n+1)) r := Rat.le_trans (disk_power hq _) (square_mono _ _ (Rat.pow_nonneg hr) hpr)
  have hs := denominator_separated hr (Rat.le_of_lt hr1) hp
  have hn := disk_normBound _ _ hr hp
  have hb := QComplex.normBound_sub_le QComplex.one (QComplex.natPow q (n+1))
  have hOne : QComplex.normBound QComplex.one=1 := by decide +kernel
  rw [hOne] at hb
  exact ⟨hs,by change (QComplex.sub QComplex.one (QComplex.natPow q (n+1))).normBound≤3; grind only⟩

private theorem normBound_disk (q : QComplex) : InDisk q q.normBound := by
  have hre := qabs_nonneg q.re
  have him := qabs_nonneg q.im
  have hs := Rat.mul_nonneg hre him
  have he : ∀x:Rat, qabs x*qabs x=x*x := by intro x; unfold qabs; split <;> grind only
  change q.re*q.re+q.im*q.im≤(qabs q.re+qabs q.im)*(qabs q.re+qabs q.im)
  rw [←he q.re,←he q.im]
  grind only

theorem factor_difference (p q : QComplex) (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1)
    (hp : InDisk p r) (hq : InDisk q r) (n : Nat) :
    (QComplex.sub (factor p n) (factor q n)).normBound≤
      (inverseBound r)^2*(2*((n+1:Nat):Rat)*r^n)*(QComplex.sub p q).normBound := by
  have hpD := power_denominator p r hr hr1 hp n
  have hqD := power_denominator q r hr hr1 hq n
  have hmargin : 0<(1-r)*(1-r) := Rat.mul_pos (by grind only) (by grind only)
  have hd := QComplex.inverse_difference_normBound_le (by decide +kernel : (0:Rat)≤3) hmargin
    hpD.2 hqD.2 hpD.1 hqD.1
  have hid : QComplex.sub (denominator p n) (denominator q n)=
      QComplex.neg (QComplex.sub (QComplex.natPow p (n+1)) (QComplex.natPow q (n+1))) := by
    simp only [denominator,QComplex.sub,QComplex.add,QComplex.neg,QComplex.one,QComplex.mk.injEq]
    constructor <;> grind only
  rw [hid,QComplex.normBound_neg] at hd
  have hpow := disk_normBound _ _ (Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg Rat.natCast_nonneg (Rat.pow_nonneg hr)) (QComplex.normBound_nonneg _))
    (power_difference_disk p q r _ hr (QComplex.normBound_nonneg _) hp hq (normBound_disk _) n)
  have h := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (Rat.pow_nonneg (inverseBound_nonneg r hr1) (n := 2))
  have factorEq : ∀u:QComplex, InDisk u r → factor u n=QComplex.sub (QComplex.inverse (denominator u n)) QComplex.one := by
    intro u hu
    have hp := disk_power hu (n+1)
    have hpr := power_antitone hr (Rat.le_of_lt hr1) (show 1≤n+1 by omega)
    rw [Rat.pow_one] at hpr
    have hk := kernel_unfold (QComplex.natPow u (n+1))
      (denominator_ne_zero hr hr1 (show InDisk (QComplex.natPow u (n+1)) r from Rat.le_trans hp (square_mono _ _ (Rat.pow_nonneg hr) hpr)))
    dsimp [factor,kernel,denominator,RationalReciprocal.inverse,QComplex.inverse,QComplex.sub,QComplex.add,QComplex.neg,QComplex.one,QComplex.mul] at hk ⊢
    simp only [QComplex.mk.injEq] at hk ⊢
    constructor <;> grind only
  have he : QComplex.sub (factor p n) (factor q n)=QComplex.sub (QComplex.inverse (denominator p n)) (QComplex.inverse (denominator q n)) := by
    rw [factorEq p hp,factorEq q hq]
    simp only [QComplex.sub,QComplex.add,QComplex.neg,QComplex.one,QComplex.mk.injEq]
    constructor <;> grind only
  rw [he]
  dsimp [inverseBound] at h ⊢
  exact Rat.le_trans hd (by have := h; grind only)

/-- Finite sums of the rational majorant, used to bound all prefix derivatives. -/
def majorantPrefix (r : Rat) (k : Nat) : Nat → Rat
  | 0 => 0
  | N+1 => majorantPrefix r k N+majorant r k N

theorem majorantPrefix_nonneg (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (k N : Nat) : 0≤majorantPrefix r k N := by
  induction N with
  | zero => exact Rat.le_refl
  | succ N ih => exact Rat.add_nonneg ih (majorant_nonneg r hr hr1 k N)

theorem majorantPrefix_mono (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (k m n : Nat) (hmn : m≤n) : majorantPrefix r k m≤majorantPrefix r k n := by
  induction hmn with
  | refl => exact Rat.le_refl
  | @step n hmn ih =>
    change _≤majorantPrefix r k n+majorant r k n
    have := majorant_nonneg r hr hr1 k n
    grind only

theorem majorantPrefix_bound (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (k N : Nat) :
    majorantPrefix r k N≤majorantPrefix r k (cutoff r k)+tail r k 0 := by
  by_cases hN : N≤cutoff r k
  · have := majorantPrefix_mono r hr hr1 k N (cutoff r k) hN
    have := tail_nonneg r hr hr1 k 0
    grind only
  · have stronger : ∀d, majorantPrefix r k (cutoff r k+d)≤majorantPrefix r k (cutoff r k)+tail r k 0-tail r k d := by
      intro d
      induction d with
      | zero => simp only [Nat.add_zero]; grind only
      | succ d ih =>
        have ht := majorant_geometric r hr hr1 k d
        have hi := Rat.mul_inv_cancel (1-ratio r) (show 1-ratio r≠0 by dsimp [ratio]; grind only)
        have he : tail r k d-tail r k (d+1)=majorant r k (cutoff r k)*(ratio r)^d := by
          dsimp [tail]; rw [Rat.pow_succ]; grind only
        change majorantPrefix r k (cutoff r k+d)+majorant r k (cutoff r k+d)≤_
        grind only
    have := stronger (N-cutoff r k)
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' (show cutoff r k≤N by omega)] at this
    have := tail_nonneg r hr hr1 k (N-cutoff r k)
    grind only

def continuityFactor (r : Rat) : Rat := (inverseBound r)^2*(1-r)*r⁻¹
def continuityBound (r : Rat) (k : Nat) : Rat := continuityFactor r*(majorantPrefix r (k+1) (cutoff r (k+1))+tail r (k+1) 0)

theorem continuityFactor_nonneg (r : Rat) (hr : 0<r) (hr1 : r<1) : 0≤continuityFactor r := by
  unfold continuityFactor
  exact Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.pow_nonneg (inverseBound_nonneg r hr1)) (by grind only)) (Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr hr))

theorem continuityBound_nonneg (r : Rat) (hr : 0<r) (hr1 : r<1) (k : Nat) : 0≤continuityBound r k :=
  Rat.mul_nonneg (continuityFactor_nonneg r hr hr1) (Rat.add_nonneg
    (majorantPrefix_nonneg r (Rat.le_of_lt hr) hr1 _ _) (tail_nonneg r (Rat.le_of_lt hr) hr1 _ _))

theorem term_difference (p q : QComplex) (r : Rat) (hr : 0<r) (hr1 : r<1)
    (hp : InDisk p r) (hq : InDisk q r) (k n : Nat) :
    (QComplex.sub (term p k n) (term q k n)).normBound≤continuityFactor r*majorant r (k+1) n*(QComplex.sub p q).normBound := by
  have h := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (factor_difference p q r (Rat.le_of_lt hr) hr1 hp hq n)
    (Rat.pow_nonneg (n := k) (Rat.natCast_nonneg (a := n+1)))
  dsimp [term]
  rw [QComplex.sub_scaleRat,QComplex.normBound_scaleRat,qabs_eq_self_of_nonneg (Rat.pow_nonneg Rat.natCast_nonneg)]
  have hri := Rat.mul_inv_cancel r (Rat.ne_of_gt hr)
  have hgi := Rat.mul_inv_cancel (1-r) (show 1-r≠0 by grind only)
  have he : continuityFactor r*majorant r (k+1) n=((n+1:Nat):Rat)^k*((inverseBound r)^2*(2*((n+1:Nat):Rat)*r^n)) := by
    dsimp [continuityFactor,majorant]
    rw [Rat.pow_succ (((n+1:Nat):Rat)) k,Rat.pow_succ r n]
    calc
      _ = (((n+1:Nat):Rat)^k*((inverseBound r)^2*(2*((n+1:Nat):Rat)*r^n)))*(r*r⁻¹)*((1-r)*(1-r)⁻¹) := by grind only
      _ = _ := by rw [hri,hgi,Rat.mul_one,Rat.mul_one]
  rw [he]
  grind only

theorem prefix_difference (p q : QComplex) (r : Rat) (hr : 0<r) (hr1 : r<1)
    (hp : InDisk p r) (hq : InDisk q r) (k N : Nat) :
    (QComplex.sub (finitePrefix p k N) (finitePrefix q k N)).normBound≤continuityBound r k*(QComplex.sub p q).normBound := by
  have stronger : ∀N, (QComplex.sub (finitePrefix p k N) (finitePrefix q k N)).normBound≤
      continuityFactor r*majorantPrefix r (k+1) N*(QComplex.sub p q).normBound := by
    intro N
    induction N with
    | zero =>
      simp only [finitePrefix,majorantPrefix,Rat.mul_zero,Rat.zero_mul]
      rw [show (QComplex.sub QComplex.zero QComplex.zero).normBound=0 by decide +kernel]
      exact Rat.le_refl
    | succ N ih =>
      change (QComplex.sub (QComplex.add (finitePrefix p k N) (term p k N)) (QComplex.add (finitePrefix q k N) (term q k N))).normBound≤_
      rw [QComplex.sub_add_sub]
      have ht := term_difference p q r hr hr1 hp hq k N
      have := Rat.le_trans (QComplex.normBound_add_le _ _) (rat_add_le_add ih ht)
      dsimp [majorantPrefix]
      grind only
  have h := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (majorantPrefix_bound r (Rat.le_of_lt hr) hr1 (k+1) N) (continuityFactor_nonneg r hr hr1)
  have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (QComplex.normBound_nonneg (QComplex.sub p q))
  exact Rat.le_trans (stronger N) hm

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambert

/-! Exact compatibility with all existing small-chart represented evaluations. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambert
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert RationalLambert CauchyTaylor DomainFunctions
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000

theorem small_mem (q : Scalar) (hq : Small q.val ((1:Rat)/64)) : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain q := by
  let eps : QPos := ⟨1/64,by decide +kernel⟩
  let N := PrecisionSearch.stage q.val q.property eps
  have hn := PrecisionSearch.stage_spec q.val q.property eps
  have h1 := hq.1 0 N
  have h2 := hq.2.1 N 0
  have h3 := hq.2.2.1 0 N
  have h4 := hq.2.2.2 N 0
  have hb : -((1:Rat)/32)≤(q.val.compute N).lo.re ∧ (q.val.compute N).hi.re≤(1:Rat)/32 ∧
      -((1:Rat)/32)≤(q.val.compute N).lo.im ∧ (q.val.compute N).hi.im≤(1:Rat)/32 := by
    change -((1:Rat)/64)≤(q.val.compute N).hi.re at h1
    change (q.val.compute N).lo.re≤(1:Rat)/64 at h2
    change -((1:Rat)/64)≤(q.val.compute N).hi.im at h3
    change (q.val.compute N).lo.im≤(1:Rat)/64 at h4
    change (q.val.compute N).hi.re-(q.val.compute N).lo.re≤(1:Rat)/64 ∧
      (q.val.compute N).hi.im-(q.val.compute N).lo.im≤(1:Rat)/64 at hn
    grind only
  have h := EisensteinUnitDisk.bound_of_coordinates _ (1/32) (1/32) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) hb (valid_ordered q.property N)
  have hr := EisensteinUnitDisk.square_mono _ _ (EisensteinUnitDisk.re_nonneg _) h.1
  have hi := EisensteinUnitDisk.square_mono _ _ (EisensteinUnitDisk.im_nonneg _) h.2
  refine ⟨N,?_⟩
  dsimp [EisensteinUnitDisk.bound]
  grind only

theorem wide_mem (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain q :=
  small_mem q (LocalODE.interior_bound _ _ hq)

private theorem old_sample_disk (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) (N : Nat) :
    InDisk (RationalLambert.samplePoint q hq N) (1/32) := by
  have hs := LocalODE.interior_bound _ _ (RationalLambert.sample_inside q hq N)
  have h1 := hs.1 0 0
  have h2 := hs.2.1 0 0
  have h3 := hs.2.2.1 0 0
  have h4 := hs.2.2.2 0 0
  let p := RationalLambert.samplePoint q hq N
  change -((1:Rat)/64)≤p.re at h1
  change p.re≤(1:Rat)/64 at h2
  change -((1:Rat)/64)≤p.im at h3
  change p.im≤(1:Rat)/64 at h4
  have hr := Rat.mul_nonneg (show 0≤(1:Rat)/64-p.re by grind only) (show 0≤(1:Rat)/64+p.re by grind only)
  have hi := Rat.mul_nonneg (show 0≤(1:Rat)/64-p.im by grind only) (show 0≤(1:Rat)/64+p.im by grind only)
  dsimp [InDisk,QComplex.normSq]
  change p.re*p.re+p.im*p.im≤_
  grind only

private theorem old_input_error (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) (N : Nat) :
    (RationalLambert.inputRadius q hq N).val≤(RepresentedCauchySum.error N).val := by
  have hm := Rat.le_trans (minRadius_right (LocalODE.interiorRadius (1/64) q hq) _)
    (minRadius_right (⟨1,by decide +kernel⟩ : QPos) (divideRadius (RepresentedCauchySum.error N) ⟨139264,by decide +kernel⟩))
  have hx := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm (by decide +kernel : (0:Rat)≤139264)
  rw [divideRadius_identity (RepresentedCauchySum.error N) (⟨139264,by decide +kernel⟩ : QPos)] at hx
  have hpos := (RationalLambert.inputRadius q hq N).property
  change 139264*(RationalLambert.inputRadius q hq N).val≤_ at hx
  have hy := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by decide +kernel : (1:Rat)≤139264) (Rat.le_of_lt hpos)
  grind only

theorem value_legacy_agreement (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) (k : Nat) (hk : k=1 ∨ k=3 ∨ k=5) :
    (value q (wide_mem q hq) k).Equiv (comparison q (LocalODE.interior_bound _ _ hq) k).val := by
  let hD := wide_mem q hq
  let r := max (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius q hD) (1/32:Rat)
  have hr : 0<r := by have := EisensteinUnitDisk.radius_pos q hD; dsimp [r]; grind
  have hr1 : r<1 := by
    have := EisensteinUnitDisk.radius_lt_one q hD
    have hrat : (1/32:Rat)<1 := by decide +kernel
    dsimp [r]
    grind
  have hL := continuityBound_nonneg r hr hr1 k
  apply SeriesLimitLaws.equiv_of_small_sub_zero
  apply SeriesLimitLaws.small_closed _ 0 (fun N => (3+4*continuityBound r k)*(RepresentedCauchySum.error N).val)
    (SeriesLimitLaws.shrinks_scale _ RepresentedCauchySum.error_shrinks _ (by grind only))
  intro N
  let p := RationalLambert.samplePoint q hq N
  have hp : InDisk p r := Rat.le_trans (old_sample_disk q hq N)
    (EisensteinUnitDisk.square_mono _ _ (by decide +kernel) (by dsimp [r]; grind))
  have hz : InDisk (samplePoint q hD k N) r := Rat.le_trans (sample_inside q hD k N)
    (EisensteinUnitDisk.square_mono _ _ (Rat.le_of_lt (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius_pos q hD)) (by dsimp [r]; grind))
  have hdist := triangle _ _ _ (ofQComplex_valid _) q.property (ofQComplex_valid _) _ _
    (sample_close q hD k N) (RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ (RationalLambert.sample_close q hq N))
  have hb := rational_small_norm _ _ _ hdist
  have he1 := inputRadius_le_error q hD k N
  have he2 := old_input_error q hq N
  have hsum : 2*((inputRadius q hD k N).val+(RationalLambert.inputRadius q hq N).val)≤4*(RepresentedCauchySum.error N).val := by grind only
  have hml := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hL
  have hs := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum hL
  have hdiff := (rational_lipschitz _ p r hr hr1 hz hp k).mono (show continuityBound r k*(QComplex.sub (samplePoint q hD k N) p).normBound≤4*continuityBound r k*(RepresentedCauchySum.error N).val by grind only)
  have hsmall := LocalODE.interior_bound _ _ (RationalLambert.sample_inside q hq N)
  have hagree := rational_legacy_agreement p hsmall k hk
  have hcp := RationalLambert.input_error q hq k N
  have hcp' := Small.congr
    (sub_valid (comparison (point p) hsmall k).property (comparison q (LocalODE.interior_bound _ _ hq) k).property)
    (sub_valid (rationalValue_valid p (by have := old_sample_disk q hq N; change QComplex.normSq p≤(1/32:Rat)*(1/32:Rat) at this; grind only) k)
      (comparison q (LocalODE.interior_bound _ _ hq) k).property)
    (FunctionTheory.sub_congr (equiv_symm hagree) (equiv_refl _ (comparison q (LocalODE.interior_bound _ _ hq) k).property)) hcp
  have h1 := triangle _ _ _ (value_valid q hD k) (sampledValue_valid q hD k N)
    (rationalValue_valid p (by have := old_sample_disk q hq N; change QComplex.normSq p≤(1/32:Rat)*(1/32:Rat) at this; grind only) k)
    _ _ (value_close_sample q hD k N) hdiff
  have h2 := triangle _ _ _ (value_valid q hD k) (rationalValue_valid p (by have := old_sample_disk q hq N; change QComplex.normSq p≤(1/32:Rat)*(1/32:Rat) at this; grind only) k)
    (comparison q (LocalODE.interior_bound _ _ hq) k).property _ _ h1 hcp'
  exact h2.mono (by grind only)

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambert

/-! Derive values at every represented point of the open unit disk from
 primary rational Lambert samples and their quantitative continuity. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambert
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert RationalLambert CauchyTaylor DomainFunctions
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000

def inputRadius (q : Scalar) (hq : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain q) (k N : Nat) : QPos :=
  divideRadius (RepresentedCauchySum.error N)
    ⟨2*continuityBound (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius q hq) k+1, by
      have := continuityBound_nonneg _ (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius_pos q hq) (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius_lt_one q hq) k
      grind only⟩

def sampleStage (q : Scalar) (hq : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain q) (k N : Nat) : Nat :=
  EisensteinUnitDisk.stage q hq+PrecisionSearch.stage q.val q.property (inputRadius q hq k N)
def samplePoint (q : Scalar) (hq : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain q) (k N : Nat) : QComplex :=
  (q.val.compute (sampleStage q hq k N)).center

theorem sample_close (q : Scalar) (hq : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain q) (k N : Nat) :
    Small (sub (ofQComplex (samplePoint q hq k N)) q.val) (inputRadius q hq k N).val := by
  let n := PrecisionSearch.stage q.val q.property (inputRadius q hq k N)
  have h := PrecisionSearch.stage_spec q.val q.property (inputRadius q hq k N)
  have hn := valid_nestedIn q.property (show n≤sampleStage q hq k N by dsimp [n,sampleStage]; omega)
  have hnlo : (q.val.compute n).lo.re≤(q.val.compute (sampleStage q hq k N)).lo.re ∧
      (q.val.compute n).lo.im≤(q.val.compute (sampleStage q hq k N)).lo.im := hn.1
  have hnhi : (q.val.compute (sampleStage q hq k N)).hi.re≤(q.val.compute n).hi.re ∧
      (q.val.compute (sampleStage q hq k N)).hi.im≤(q.val.compute n).hi.im := hn.2
  have hw : (q.val.compute (sampleStage q hq k N)).width≤(inputRadius q hq k N).val ∧
      (q.val.compute (sampleStage q hq k N)).height≤(inputRadius q hq k N).val := by
    change (q.val.compute n).hi.re-(q.val.compute n).lo.re≤_ ∧ (q.val.compute n).hi.im-(q.val.compute n).lo.im≤_ at h
    change (q.val.compute _).hi.re-(q.val.compute _).lo.re≤_ ∧ (q.val.compute _).hi.im-(q.val.compute _).lo.im≤_
    grind only
  exact RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ (BoxApproximation.center_error q _ _
    (Rat.le_of_lt (inputRadius q hq k N).property) hw.1 hw.2)

theorem sample_inside (q : Scalar) (hq : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain q) (k N : Nat) :
    InDisk (samplePoint q hq k N) (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius q hq) :=
  EisensteinUnitDisk.centers_inside q hq _ (by dsimp [sampleStage]; omega)

theorem sample_unit_disk (q : Scalar) (hq : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain q) (k N : Nat) :
    QComplex.normSq (samplePoint q hq k N)<1 := by
  have h := sample_inside q hq k N
  have hr := EisensteinUnitDisk.radius_pos q hq
  have hr1 := EisensteinUnitDisk.radius_lt_one q hq
  have hh := Rat.mul_pos (show 0<1-EisensteinUnitDisk.radius q hq by grind only)
    (show 0<1+EisensteinUnitDisk.radius q hq by grind only)
  dsimp [InDisk] at h
  grind only

theorem inputRadius_le_error (q : Scalar) (hq : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain q) (k N : Nat) :
    (inputRadius q hq k N).val≤(RepresentedCauchySum.error N).val := by
  have hL := continuityBound_nonneg _ (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius_pos q hq) (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius_lt_one q hq) k
  have hid := divideRadius_identity (RepresentedCauchySum.error N)
    (⟨2*continuityBound (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius q hq) k+1,by grind only⟩ : QPos)
  have hpos := (inputRadius q hq k N).property
  change (2*continuityBound (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius q hq) k+1)*(inputRadius q hq k N).val=_ at hid
  have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (show (1:Rat)≤2*continuityBound (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius q hq) k+1 by grind only) (Rat.le_of_lt hpos)
  grind only

theorem inputRadius_antitone (q : Scalar) (hq : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain q) (k m n : Nat) (hmn : m≤n) :
    (inputRadius q hq k n).val≤(inputRadius q hq k m).val :=
  Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (RepresentedCauchySum.error_antitone m n hmn)
    (Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr (by
      have := continuityBound_nonneg _ (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius_pos q hq) (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius_lt_one q hq) k
      grind only)))

theorem rational_small_norm (p q : QComplex) (H : Rat) (h : Small (sub (ofQComplex p) (ofQComplex q)) H) :
    (QComplex.sub p q).normBound≤2*H := by
  have hb := Small.congr (sub_valid (ofQComplex_valid _) (ofQComplex_valid _)) (ofQComplex_valid _) (sub_constants p q) h
  have h1 := hb.1 0 0
  have h2 := hb.2.1 0 0
  have h3 := hb.2.2.1 0 0
  have h4 := hb.2.2.2 0 0
  change -H≤(QComplex.sub p q).re at h1
  change (QComplex.sub p q).re≤H at h2
  change -H≤(QComplex.sub p q).im at h3
  change (QComplex.sub p q).im≤H at h4
  unfold QComplex.normBound qabs
  split <;> split <;> grind only

def sampledValue (q : Scalar) (hq : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain q) (k N : Nat) : ComplexRaw :=
  rationalValue (samplePoint q hq k N) k

theorem sampledValue_valid (q : Scalar) (hq : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain q) (k N : Nat) : (sampledValue q hq k N).Valid :=
  rationalValue_valid _ (sample_unit_disk q hq k N) k

theorem samples_cauchy (q : Scalar) (hq : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain q) (k m n : Nat) (hmn : m≤n) :
    Small (sub (sampledValue q hq k n) (sampledValue q hq k m)) (2*(RepresentedCauchySum.error m).val) := by
  have hc := triangle _ _ _ (ofQComplex_valid _) q.property (ofQComplex_valid _) _ _
    (sample_close q hq k n) (RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ (sample_close q hq k m))
  have hdist := rational_small_norm _ _ _ hc
  have h := rational_lipschitz _ _ _ (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius_pos q hq) (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius_lt_one q hq)
    (sample_inside q hq k n) (sample_inside q hq k m) k
  apply h.mono
  have hL := continuityBound_nonneg _ (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius_pos q hq) (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius_lt_one q hq) k
  have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdist hL
  have ha := inputRadius_antitone q hq k m n hmn
  have hid := divideRadius_identity (RepresentedCauchySum.error m)
    (⟨2*continuityBound (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius q hq) k+1,by grind only⟩ : QPos)
  change (2*continuityBound (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius q hq) k+1)*(inputRadius q hq k m).val=_ at hid
  have hp := (inputRadius q hq k m).property
  have hmul := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha (show 0≤2*continuityBound (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius q hq) k by grind only)
  grind only

def value (q : Scalar) (hq : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain q) (k : Nat) : ComplexRaw :=
  RepresentedCauchySum.value (sampledValue q hq k) (sampledValue_valid q hq k)
    (fun N => 2*(RepresentedCauchySum.error N).val)

theorem value_valid (q : Scalar) (hq : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain q) (k : Nat) : (value q hq k).Valid :=
  RepresentedCauchySum.value_valid _ _ _ (RepresentedCauchySum.twice_shrinks _ RepresentedCauchySum.error_shrinks)
    (samples_cauchy q hq k)

theorem value_close_sample (q : Scalar) (hq : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain q) (k N : Nat) :
    Small (sub (value q hq k) (sampledValue q hq k N)) (2*(RepresentedCauchySum.error N).val) :=
  RepresentedCauchySum.value_close_prefix _ _ _ (samples_cauchy q hq k) N

private theorem self_zero (q z : Scalar) (he : q.val.Equiv z.val) : Small (sub q.val z.val) 0 := by
  have hs : (sub q.val z.val).Equiv zero := by
    apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq (hleft := sub_valid q.property z.property) (hright := ofQComplex_valid _)
    have h := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_eq_ofRaw (hleft := q.property) (hright := z.property) he
    change ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw q.val q.property-ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw z.val z.property=0
    rw [h]; grind only
  exact Small.congr (ofQComplex_valid _) (sub_valid q.property z.property) (equiv_symm hs) (Small.zero (by decide +kernel))

theorem value_congr (q z : Scalar) (hq : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain q) (hz : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain z)
    (he : q.val.Equiv z.val) (k : Nat) : (value q hq k).Equiv (value z hz k) := by
  let r := max (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius q hq) (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius z hz)
  have hr : 0<r := by have := EisensteinUnitDisk.radius_pos q hq; dsimp [r]; grind
  have hr1 : r<1 := by have := EisensteinUnitDisk.radius_lt_one q hq; have := EisensteinUnitDisk.radius_lt_one z hz; dsimp [r]; grind
  have hL := continuityBound_nonneg r hr hr1 k
  apply SeriesLimitLaws.equiv_of_small_sub_zero
  apply SeriesLimitLaws.small_closed _ 0 (fun N => (4+4*continuityBound r k)*(RepresentedCauchySum.error N).val)
    (SeriesLimitLaws.shrinks_scale _ RepresentedCauchySum.error_shrinks _ (by grind only))
  intro N
  have hp : InDisk (samplePoint q hq k N) r := Rat.le_trans (sample_inside q hq k N)
    (EisensteinUnitDisk.square_mono _ _ (Rat.le_of_lt (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius_pos q hq)) (by dsimp [r]; grind))
  have hz' : InDisk (samplePoint z hz k N) r := Rat.le_trans (sample_inside z hz k N)
    (EisensteinUnitDisk.square_mono _ _ (Rat.le_of_lt (EisensteinUnitDisk.radius_pos z hz)) (by dsimp [r]; grind))
  have h1 := triangle _ _ _ (ofQComplex_valid _) q.property z.property _ _ (sample_close q hq k N) (self_zero q z he)
  have h2 := triangle _ _ _ (ofQComplex_valid _) z.property (ofQComplex_valid _) _ _ h1
    (RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ (sample_close z hz k N))
  have hd := rational_small_norm _ _ _ h2
  have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd hL
  have heq := inputRadius_le_error q hq k N
  have hez := inputRadius_le_error z hz k N
  have hsum : 2*((inputRadius q hq k N).val+0+(inputRadius z hz k N).val)≤4*(RepresentedCauchySum.error N).val := by grind only
  have hsumL := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum hL
  have hs := (rational_lipschitz _ _ r hr hr1 hp hz' k).mono (show continuityBound r k*(QComplex.sub (samplePoint q hq k N) (samplePoint z hz k N)).normBound≤4*continuityBound r k*(RepresentedCauchySum.error N).val by dsimp [r] at hL hm; grind only)
  have ha := triangle _ _ _ (value_valid q hq k) (sampledValue_valid q hq k N) (sampledValue_valid z hz k N) _ _ (value_close_sample q hq k N) hs
  have hb := triangle _ _ _ (value_valid q hq k) (sampledValue_valid z hz k N) (value_valid z hz k) _ _ ha
    (RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ (value_close_sample z hz k N))
  exact hb.mono (by grind only)

theorem value_rational_agreement (q : QComplex) (hq : QComplex.normSq q<1) (k : Nat) :
    (value (point q) (EisensteinUnitDisk.rational_mem q hq) k).Equiv (rationalValue q k) := by
  have hs : ∀N, samplePoint (point q) (EisensteinUnitDisk.rational_mem q hq) k N=q := by
    intro N
    change (QBox.point q).center=q
    cases q
    simp only [QBox.center,QBox.point,QComplex.mk.injEq]
    constructor <;> grind only
  apply SeriesLimitLaws.equiv_of_small_sub_zero
  apply SeriesLimitLaws.small_closed _ 0 (fun N => 2*(RepresentedCauchySum.error N).val)
    (RepresentedCauchySum.twice_shrinks _ RepresentedCauchySum.error_shrinks)
  intro N
  have h := value_close_sample (point q) (EisensteinUnitDisk.rational_mem q hq) k N
  dsimp [sampledValue] at h
  rw [hs] at h
  exact h.mono (by grind only)

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambert

/-! Primary rational Lambert values on the full Euclidean unit disk. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambert
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert RationalLambert CauchyTaylor
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000

theorem rational_norm_small (q : QComplex) (B : Rat) (h : q.normBound≤B) : Small (ofQComplex q) B := by
  apply (BoxApproximation.rational_small q).mono
  have hre := qabs_nonneg q.re
  have him := qabs_nonneg q.im
  dsimp [BoxApproximation.coordinateBound,QComplex.normBound] at *
  grind

theorem rational_difference_small (p q : QComplex) (B : Rat) (h : (QComplex.sub p q).normBound≤B) :
    Small (sub (ofQComplex p) (ofQComplex q)) B :=
  Small.congr (ofQComplex_valid _) (sub_valid (ofQComplex_valid _) (ofQComplex_valid _))
    (equiv_symm (sub_constants p q)) (rational_norm_small _ _ h)

def atRadius (q : QComplex) (r : Rat) (k : Nat) : ComplexRaw :=
  RepresentedCauchySum.value (fun N => ofQComplex (finitePrefix q k (cutoff r k+N)))
    (fun _ => ofQComplex_valid _) (tail r k)

theorem rational_cauchy (q : QComplex) (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (hq : InDisk q r)
    (k m n : Nat) (hmn : m≤n) :
    Small (sub (ofQComplex (finitePrefix q k (cutoff r k+n))) (ofQComplex (finitePrefix q k (cutoff r k+m)))) (tail r k m) := by
  have h := prefix_tail q r hr hr1 hq k m (n-m)
  have he : cutoff r k+m+(n-m)=cutoff r k+n := by omega
  rw [he] at h
  exact rational_difference_small _ _ _ h

theorem atRadius_valid (q : QComplex) (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (hq : InDisk q r) (k : Nat) :
    (atRadius q r k).Valid := RepresentedCauchySum.value_valid _ _ _ (tail_shrinks r hr hr1 k) (rational_cauchy q r hr hr1 hq k)

theorem atRadius_close (q : QComplex) (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (hq : InDisk q r) (k N : Nat) :
    Small (sub (atRadius q r k) (ofQComplex (finitePrefix q k (cutoff r k+N)))) (tail r k N) :=
  RepresentedCauchySum.value_close_prefix _ _ _ (rational_cauchy q r hr hr1 hq k) N

/-- The radius is computed from the rational squared modulus. -/
def rationalRadius (q : QComplex) : Rat := (1+QComplex.normSq q)/2

theorem rationalRadius_pos (q : QComplex) : 0<rationalRadius q := by
  have := normSq_nonneg q; dsimp [rationalRadius]; grind only

theorem rationalRadius_lt_one (q : QComplex) (hq : QComplex.normSq q<1) : rationalRadius q<1 := by
  dsimp [rationalRadius]; grind only

theorem rationalRadius_inside (q : QComplex) : InDisk q (rationalRadius q) := by
  have := rat_square_nonneg_basic (1-QComplex.normSq q)
  dsimp [InDisk,rationalRadius]; grind only

theorem denominator_nonzero (q : QComplex) (hq : QComplex.normSq q<1) (n : Nat) :
    QComplex.normSq (RationalLambert.denominator q n)≠0 := by
  let r := rationalRadius q
  have hr := Rat.le_of_lt (rationalRadius_pos q)
  have hr1 := rationalRadius_lt_one q hq
  have hp := disk_power (rationalRadius_inside q) (n+1)
  have hpr := power_antitone hr (Rat.le_of_lt hr1) (show 1≤n+1 by omega)
  rw [Rat.pow_one] at hpr
  exact denominator_ne_zero hr hr1 (Rat.le_trans hp (EisensteinUnitDisk.square_mono _ _ (Rat.pow_nonneg hr) hpr))

def rationalValue (q : QComplex) (k : Nat) : ComplexRaw := atRadius q (rationalRadius q) k

theorem rationalValue_valid (q : QComplex) (hq : QComplex.normSq q<1) (k : Nat) : (rationalValue q k).Valid :=
  atRadius_valid q _ (Rat.le_of_lt (rationalRadius_pos q)) (rationalRadius_lt_one q hq) (rationalRadius_inside q) k

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambert

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.RationalLambertArithmetic
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.RationalLambertBounds
import ComputableAnalysis.CauchyTaylorKernel
import ComputableAnalysis.ComplexReciprocalCalculus

/-! Finite rational Lambert estimates on every closed Euclidean disk inside
 the unit disk. The cutoff is computed by a rational ceiling. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambert
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert RationalLambert CauchyTaylor
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000

theorem pow_product (a b : Rat) (n : Nat) : (a*b)^n=a^n*b^n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [Rat.pow_zero,Rat.one_mul]
  | succ n ih => rw [Rat.pow_succ,Rat.pow_succ,Rat.pow_succ,ih]; grind only

theorem pow_add (a : Rat) (m n : Nat) : a^(m+n)=a^m*a^n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [Nat.add_zero,Rat.pow_zero,Rat.mul_one]
  | succ n ih => rw [Nat.add_succ,Rat.pow_succ,Rat.pow_succ,ih]; grind only

theorem two_power_ge_one (k : Nat) : 1≤(2:Rat)^k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp only [Rat.pow_zero]; exact Rat.le_refl
  | succ k ih => rw [Rat.pow_succ]; grind only

theorem binomial_bound (x : Rat) (hx : 0≤x) (hx1 : x≤1) (k : Nat) :
    (1+x)^k≤1+((2:Rat)^k-1)*x := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp only [Rat.pow_zero]; grind only
  | succ k ih =>
    have h2 := two_power_ge_one k
    have hs := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hx1 hx
    have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (show 0≤(2:Rat)^k-1 by grind only)
    have h := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ih (show 0≤1+x by grind only)
    rw [Rat.pow_succ,Rat.pow_succ]
    grind only

def cutoff (r : Rat) (k : Nat) : Nat := (2*(2:Rat)^k/(1-r)).ceil.natAbs+1

theorem cutoff_bound (r : Rat) (k : Nat) : 2*(2:Rat)^k/(1-r)≤(cutoff r k:Rat) := by
  have h := Int.le_natAbs (a := (2*(2:Rat)^k/(1-r)).ceil)
  have hc : ((2*(2:Rat)^k/(1-r)).ceil:Rat)≤(cutoff r k:Rat) := by
    unfold cutoff
    exact_mod_cast (show (2*(2:Rat)^k/(1-r)).ceil≤(2*(2:Rat)^k/(1-r)).ceil.natAbs+1 by omega)
  exact Rat.le_trans Rat.le_ceil hc

def ratio (r : Rat) : Rat := (1+r)/2
def majorant (r : Rat) (k n : Nat) : Rat := 2*((n+1:Nat):Rat)^k*r^(n+1)*(1-r)⁻¹

theorem majorant_nonneg (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (k n : Nat) : 0≤majorant r k n := by
  unfold majorant
  exact Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide +kernel) (Rat.pow_nonneg Rat.natCast_nonneg))
    (Rat.pow_nonneg hr)) (Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr (by grind only)))

theorem majorant_step (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (k n : Nat) (hn : cutoff r k≤n) :
    majorant r k (n+1)≤majorant r k n*ratio r := by
  let a : Rat := ((n+1:Nat):Rat)
  have ha : 0<a := Rat.natCast_pos.mpr (by omega)
  have ha1 : 1≤a := by dsimp [a]; exact_mod_cast (show 1≤n+1 by omega)
  have hi := Rat.mul_inv_cancel a (Rat.ne_of_gt ha)
  have hai : 0≤a⁻¹ := Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr ha)
  have hai1 : a⁻¹≤1 := by
    have h := Rat.inv_antitone_of_pos (by decide +kernel : (0:Rat)<1) ha1
    simpa only [show (1:Rat)⁻¹=1 by decide +kernel] using h
  have hb := binomial_bound (a⁻¹) hai hai1 k
  have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (Rat.pow_nonneg (Rat.le_of_lt ha) (n := k))
  have he : a*(1+a⁻¹)=a+1 := by grind only
  rw [←pow_product,he] at hm
  have hc := cutoff_bound r k
  have hcn : (cutoff r k:Rat)≤(n:Rat) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hg : 0<1-r := by grind only
  have hc' := Rat.le_trans hc (show (cutoff r k:Rat)≤a by dsimp [a]; simp only [Rat.natCast_add]; grind only)
  have hiG := Rat.mul_inv_cancel (1-r) (Rat.ne_of_gt hg)
  have hd : 2*(2:Rat)^k≤a*(1-r) := by
    have h := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc' (Rat.le_of_lt hg)
    rw [Rat.div_def,Rat.mul_assoc,Rat.inv_mul_cancel (1-r) (Rat.ne_of_gt hg),Rat.mul_one] at h
    exact h
  have h2 : 0≤(2:Rat)^k := Rat.pow_nonneg (by decide +kernel)
  have hx : ((2:Rat)^k-1)*a⁻¹*r≤(1-r)/2 := by
    have h := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd hai
    have hid : a*(1-r)*a⁻¹=1-r := by
      rw [Rat.mul_comm a (1-r),Rat.mul_assoc,hi,Rat.mul_one]
    rw [hid] at h
    have hx := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Rat.le_of_lt hr1) (Rat.mul_nonneg h2 hai)
    have hy : ((2:Rat)^k-1)*a⁻¹*r≤(2:Rat)^k*a⁻¹*r :=
      Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (show (2:Rat)^k-1≤(2:Rat)^k by grind only) hai) hr
    rw [show (1-r)/2=(1-r)*(1/2:Rat) by simp only [Rat.div_def,Rat.one_mul]]
    have hhalf := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (by decide +kernel : (0:Rat)≤1/2)
    have hh : 2*(2:Rat)^k*a⁻¹*(1/2:Rat)=(2:Rat)^k*a⁻¹ := by grind only
    rw [hh] at hhalf
    exact Rat.le_trans hy (Rat.le_trans (by simpa only [Rat.one_mul,Rat.mul_comm] using hx) hhalf)
  have hpow : (a+1)^k*r≤a^k*ratio r := by
    have h := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm hr
    have hh := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx (Rat.pow_nonneg (Rat.le_of_lt ha) (n := k))
    dsimp [ratio]
    grind only
  have hp := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow
    (Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.pow_nonneg hr (n := n+1)) (Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr hg)))
  unfold majorant
  rw [Rat.pow_succ r (n+1)]
  simp only [Rat.natCast_add] at *
  dsimp [a] at *
  grind only

theorem majorant_geometric (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (k n : Nat) :
    majorant r k (cutoff r k+n)≤majorant r k (cutoff r k)*(ratio r)^n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [Nat.add_zero,Rat.pow_zero,Rat.mul_one]; exact Rat.le_refl
  | succ n ih =>
    have h := majorant_step r hr hr1 k (cutoff r k+n) (by omega)
    have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ih (show 0≤ratio r by dsimp [ratio]; grind only)
    rw [Nat.add_succ,Rat.pow_succ]
    grind only

theorem disk_normBound (z : QComplex) (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hz : InDisk z r) : z.normBound≤2*r := by
  have h := disk_coordinates hr hz
  unfold QComplex.normBound qabs
  split <;> split <;> grind only

theorem term_bound (q : QComplex) (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (hq : InDisk q r) (k n : Nat) :
    (term q k n).normBound≤majorant r k n := by
  have hp := disk_power hq (n+1)
  have hpr : 0≤r^(n+1) := Rat.pow_nonneg hr
  have hpr1 : r^(n+1)≤r := by
    simpa only [Rat.pow_one] using power_antitone hr (Rat.le_of_lt hr1) (show 1≤n+1 by omega)
  have hk := kernel_disk hr hr1 (show InDisk (QComplex.natPow q (n+1)) r from
    Rat.le_trans hp (by have h := pow_mono (r^(n+1)) r hpr hpr1 2; simpa only [Rat.pow_succ,Rat.pow_zero,Rat.one_mul] using h))
  have hf := disk_mul hp hk
  have hn : 0≤r^(n+1)*(1-r)⁻¹ := Rat.mul_nonneg hpr (Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr (by grind only)))
  have hb := disk_normBound _ _ hn hf
  have he : RationalReciprocal.inverse (denominator q n)=kernel (QComplex.natPow q (n+1)) := rfl
  unfold term factor
  rw [QComplex.normBound_scaleRat,qabs_eq_self_of_nonneg (Rat.pow_nonneg Rat.natCast_nonneg),he]
  have h := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (Rat.pow_nonneg (n := k) (Rat.natCast_nonneg (a := n+1)))
  dsimp [majorant]
  grind only

def tail (r : Rat) (k N : Nat) : Rat := majorant r k (cutoff r k)*(ratio r)^N*(1-ratio r)⁻¹

theorem tail_nonneg (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (k N : Nat) : 0≤tail r k N := by
  unfold tail
  exact Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg (majorant_nonneg r hr hr1 k _) (Rat.pow_nonneg (show 0≤ratio r by dsimp [ratio]; grind only)))
    (Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr (show 0<1-ratio r by dsimp [ratio]; grind only)))

theorem tail_shrinks (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (k : Nat) : ShrinksToZero (tail r k) := by
  have hg : 0<1-ratio r := by dsimp [ratio]; grind only
  let C := majorant r k (cutoff r k)*(1-ratio r)⁻¹*(1-ratio r)⁻¹
  have hC : 0≤C := Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg (majorant_nonneg r hr hr1 k _)
    (Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr hg))) (Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr hg))
  let B := C.ceil.natAbs+1
  have hCB : C≤(B:Rat) := by
    have hi : C.ceil≤(B:Int) := by dsimp [B]; have := Int.le_natAbs (a := C.ceil); omega
    exact Rat.le_trans Rat.le_ceil (by exact_mod_cast hi)
  apply shrinksToZero_of_natOverSuccBound (C := B)
  intro n
  have hp := power_nat_bound (show 0≤ratio r by dsimp [ratio]; grind only) (show ratio r<1 by dsimp [ratio]; grind only) n
  have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (Rat.mul_nonneg (majorant_nonneg r hr hr1 k (cutoff r k)) (Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr hg)))
  have hx := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCB (Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr (show (0:Rat)<((n+1:Nat):Rat) from Rat.natCast_pos.mpr (by omega))))
  dsimp [tail,C] at *
  rw [Rat.div_def] at *
  grind only

theorem tail_antitone (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (k m n : Nat) (hmn : m≤n) : tail r k n≤tail r k m := by
  have hp := power_antitone (show 0≤ratio r by dsimp [ratio]; grind only) (show ratio r≤1 by dsimp [ratio]; grind only) hmn
  have h := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (majorant_nonneg r hr hr1 k (cutoff r k))
  exact Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr (show 0<1-ratio r by dsimp [ratio]; grind only)))

theorem prefix_tail (q : QComplex) (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (hq : InDisk q r)
    (k N d : Nat) :
    (QComplex.sub (finitePrefix q k (cutoff r k+N+d)) (finitePrefix q k (cutoff r k+N))).normBound≤tail r k N := by
  have stronger : ∀d, (QComplex.sub (finitePrefix q k (cutoff r k+N+d)) (finitePrefix q k (cutoff r k+N))).normBound≤
      tail r k N-tail r k (N+d) := by
    intro d
    induction d with
    | zero =>
      simp only [Nat.add_zero,QComplex.sub,QComplex.add,QComplex.neg,QComplex.normBound]
      have he : ∀a:Rat, a + -a=0 := by intro a; grind only
      simp only [he,show qabs (0:Rat)=0 by decide +kernel]
      grind only
    | succ d ih =>
      have hid : QComplex.sub (finitePrefix q k (cutoff r k+N+(d+1))) (finitePrefix q k (cutoff r k+N))=
        QComplex.add (QComplex.sub (finitePrefix q k (cutoff r k+N+d)) (finitePrefix q k (cutoff r k+N))) (term q k (cutoff r k+N+d)) := by
        simp only [Nat.add_succ,finitePrefix,QComplex.sub,QComplex.add,QComplex.neg,QComplex.mk.injEq]
        constructor <;> grind only
      rw [hid]
      have ht := Rat.le_trans (term_bound q r hr hr1 hq k (cutoff r k+N+d))
        (by simpa only [Nat.add_assoc] using majorant_geometric r hr hr1 k (N+d))
      have h := Rat.le_trans (QComplex.normBound_add_le _ _) (rat_add_le_add ih ht)
      have hi := Rat.mul_inv_cancel (1-ratio r) (show 1-ratio r≠0 by dsimp [ratio]; grind only)
      have he : tail r k (N+d)-tail r k (N+(d+1))=majorant r k (cutoff r k)*(ratio r)^(N+d) := by
        dsimp [tail]
        rw [Nat.add_succ,Rat.pow_succ]
        grind only
      grind only
  have h := stronger d
  have ht := tail_nonneg r hr hr1 k (N+d)
  grind only

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambert

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambertTail
import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.BoxApproximation

/-! The full open Euclidean unit disk, certified by a rational rectangle
 strictly inside it. Searching for that rectangle is executable. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.EisensteinUnitDisk
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert CauchyTaylor
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000

def reBound (B : QBox) : Rat := max (qabs B.lo.re) (qabs B.hi.re)
def imBound (B : QBox) : Rat := max (qabs B.lo.im) (qabs B.hi.im)
def bound (B : QBox) : Rat := reBound B*reBound B+imBound B*imBound B

theorem re_nonneg (B : QBox) : 0≤reBound B := by have := qabs_nonneg B.lo.re; unfold reBound; grind
theorem im_nonneg (B : QBox) : 0≤imBound B := by have := qabs_nonneg B.lo.im; unfold imBound; grind
theorem bound_nonneg (B : QBox) : 0≤bound B := Rat.add_nonneg (rat_square_nonneg_basic _) (rat_square_nonneg_basic _)

theorem coordinates (B : QBox) : -reBound B≤B.lo.re ∧ B.hi.re≤reBound B ∧ -imBound B≤B.lo.im ∧ B.hi.im≤imBound B := by
  unfold reBound imBound qabs
  split <;> split <;> split <;> split <;> grind

theorem square_mono (a b : Rat) (ha : 0≤a) (hab : a≤b) : a*a≤b*b := by
  have h1 := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hab ha
  have h2 := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hab (Rat.le_trans ha hab)
  grind

theorem bound_of_coordinates (B : QBox) (A C : Rat) (hA : 0≤A) (hC : 0≤C)
    (h : -A≤B.lo.re ∧ B.hi.re≤A ∧ -C≤B.lo.im ∧ B.hi.im≤C) (ho : B.lo≤B.hi) :
    reBound B≤A ∧ imBound B≤C := by
  unfold reBound imBound qabs
  change B.lo.re≤B.hi.re ∧ B.lo.im≤B.hi.im at ho
  split <;> split <;> split <;> split <;> grind

theorem nested_bound (A B : QBox) (h : B.NestedIn A) (ho : B.lo≤B.hi) : bound B≤bound A := by
  have hc := coordinates A
  have hn : -reBound A≤B.lo.re ∧ B.hi.re≤reBound A ∧ -imBound A≤B.lo.im ∧ B.hi.im≤imBound A := by
    change (A.lo.re≤B.lo.re ∧ A.lo.im≤B.lo.im) ∧ (B.hi.re≤A.hi.re ∧ B.hi.im≤A.hi.im) at h
    grind
  have hb := bound_of_coordinates B _ _ (re_nonneg A) (im_nonneg A) hn ho
  exact rat_add_le_add (square_mono _ _ (re_nonneg B) hb.1) (square_mono _ _ (im_nonneg B) hb.2)

theorem point_bound (B : QBox) (q : QComplex) (hq : B.lo≤q ∧ q≤B.hi) : QComplex.normSq q≤bound B := by
  have hc := coordinates B
  change (B.lo.re≤q.re ∧ B.lo.im≤q.im) ∧ (q.re≤B.hi.re ∧ q.im≤B.hi.im) at hq
  have hre : qabs q.re≤reBound B := by unfold qabs; split <;> grind
  have him : qabs q.im≤imBound B := by unfold qabs; split <;> grind
  have hr := square_mono _ _ (qabs_nonneg _) hre
  have hi := square_mono _ _ (qabs_nonneg _) him
  have he : ∀x:Rat, qabs x*qabs x=x*x := by intro x; unfold qabs; split <;> grind
  rw [he] at hr
  rw [he] at hi
  exact rat_add_le_add hr hi

/-- A valid name is in the open disk exactly when one of its shrinking
 rational boxes lies strictly inside the Euclidean unit circle. -/
def domain (z : Scalar) : Prop := ∃N, bound (z.val.compute N)<1

def good (z : Scalar) (N : Nat) : Bool := decide (bound (z.val.compute N)<1)

theorem eventually_good (z : Scalar) (hz : domain z) : ∃N, ∀n, N≤n → good z n=true := by
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := hz
  refine ⟨N,fun n hn => ?_⟩
  simp only [good,decide_eq_true_eq]
  have := nested_bound _ _ (valid_nestedIn z.property hn) (valid_ordered z.property n)
  grind

def stage (z : Scalar) (hz : domain z) : Nat := PrecisionSearch.firstFrom (good z) (eventually_good z hz) 0

theorem stage_spec (z : Scalar) (hz : domain z) : bound (z.val.compute (stage z hz))<1 := by
  have h := (PrecisionSearch.firstFrom_spec (good z) (eventually_good z hz) 0).2
  simpa only [stage,good,decide_eq_true_eq] using h

def radius (z : Scalar) (hz : domain z) : Rat := (1+bound (z.val.compute (stage z hz)))/2

theorem radius_pos (z : Scalar) (hz : domain z) : 0<radius z hz := by
  have := bound_nonneg (z.val.compute (stage z hz)); dsimp [radius]; grind

theorem radius_lt_one (z : Scalar) (hz : domain z) : radius z hz<1 := by
  have := stage_spec z hz; dsimp [radius]; grind

theorem radius_square (z : Scalar) (hz : domain z) : bound (z.val.compute (stage z hz))≤radius z hz*radius z hz := by
  have h := rat_square_nonneg_basic (1-bound (z.val.compute (stage z hz)))
  dsimp [radius]
  grind

theorem centers_inside (z : Scalar) (hz : domain z) (n : Nat) (hn : stage z hz≤n) :
    InDisk (z.val.compute n).center (radius z hz) := by
  have hc := QBox.center_mem (valid_ordered z.property n)
  have h := valid_nestedIn z.property hn
  exact Rat.le_trans (point_bound _ _ ⟨QComplex.le_trans h.1 hc.1,QComplex.le_trans hc.2 h.2⟩) (radius_square z hz)

theorem rational_mem (q : QComplex) (hq : QComplex.normSq q<1) : domain (RationalLambert.point q) := by
  refine ⟨0,?_⟩
  have he : bound (QBox.point q)=QComplex.normSq q := by
    dsimp [bound,reBound,imBound,QBox.point]
    have hm : ∀a:Rat, max a a=a := by intro a; grind
    rw [hm,hm]
    unfold qabs QComplex.normSq
    split <;> split <;> grind
  exact he ▸ hq

theorem rational_mem_iff (q : QComplex) : domain (RationalLambert.point q) ↔ QComplex.normSq q<1 := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨N,hN⟩
    have := point_bound (QBox.point q) q ⟨QComplex.le_refl _,QComplex.le_refl _⟩
    change bound (QBox.point q)<1 at hN
    grind
  · exact rational_mem q

private theorem cross_overlap (z w : Scalar) (he : z.val.Equiv w.val) (i j : Nat) :
    (z.val.compute i).Overlaps (w.val.compute j) := by
  let N := max i j
  have h := (compareAt_overlap_iff _ _ N N).mp (he N)
  have hz := valid_nestedIn z.property (Nat.le_max_left i j)
  have hw := valid_nestedIn w.property (Nat.le_max_right i j)
  dsimp [N] at h
  simp only [QBox.Overlaps,QBox.NestedIn,QComplex.le_def] at *
  grind

/-- Disk membership is a property of the value, not of a selected name. -/
theorem invariant (z w : Scalar) (he : z.val.Equiv w.val) : domain z ↔ domain w := by
  have forward : ∀ (z w : Scalar), z.val.Equiv w.val → domain z → domain w := by
    intro z w he
    rintro ⟨N,hN⟩
    let B := z.val.compute N
    let A := reBound B
    let C := imBound B
    let D := 8*(A+C+1)
    have hA : 0≤A := re_nonneg B
    have hC : 0≤C := im_nonneg B
    have hB : 0≤bound B := bound_nonneg B
    have hg : 0<1-bound B := by change bound B<1 at hN; grind
    have hD : 0<D := by dsimp [D]; grind
    let eps : QPos := ⟨(1-bound B)/D,Rat.mul_pos hg (Rat.inv_pos.mpr hD)⟩
    have hi := Rat.mul_inv_cancel D (Rat.ne_of_gt hD)
    have heD : eps.val*D=1-bound B := by
      dsimp [eps]; rw [Rat.div_def,Rat.mul_assoc,Rat.inv_mul_cancel D (Rat.ne_of_gt hD),Rat.mul_one]
    have he1 : eps.val≤1 := by
      have h := eps.property
      dsimp [D] at heD
      have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show (1:Rat)≤8*(A+C+1) by grind) (Rat.le_of_lt h)
      grind
    obtain ⟨M,hM⟩ := w.property.2.2 eps
    refine ⟨M,?_⟩
    have hw := hM M (Nat.le_refl _)
    have ho := valid_ordered w.property M
    have hov := cross_overlap z w he N M
    have hb := coordinates B
    have hs : - (A+eps.val)≤(w.val.compute M).lo.re ∧ (w.val.compute M).hi.re≤A+eps.val ∧
        -(C+eps.val)≤(w.val.compute M).lo.im ∧ (w.val.compute M).hi.im≤C+eps.val := by
      simp only [QBox.Overlaps,QComplex.le_def] at hov
      change (w.val.compute M).hi.re-(w.val.compute M).lo.re≤eps.val ∧
        (w.val.compute M).hi.im-(w.val.compute M).lo.im≤eps.val at hw
      dsimp [B,A,C] at *
      grind
    have hc := bound_of_coordinates _ _ _ (by have := eps.property; grind) (by have := eps.property; grind) hs ho
    have hsq := rat_add_le_add (square_mono _ _ (re_nonneg _) hc.1) (square_mono _ _ (im_nonneg _) hc.2)
    have hess := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he1 (Rat.le_of_lt eps.property)
    have htarget : (A+eps.val)*(A+eps.val)+(C+eps.val)*(C+eps.val)<1 := by
      have hbEq : bound B=A*A+C*C := rfl
      rw [hbEq] at heD hg
      dsimp [D] at heD
      grind
    change bound (w.val.compute M)<1
    unfold bound
    grind only
  exact ⟨forward z w he,forward w z (equiv_symm he)⟩

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.EisensteinUnitDisk

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.RationalLambertSamples
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.RationalLambertLift
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.WideNomeEisensteinTwo
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.WideNomeEisensteinFour
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.WideNomeEisensteinSix

/-! Rational-first normalized Eisenstein nome charts. The represented maps
are derived from moving exact rational Lambert prefixes. Their domain is the
existing open coordinate square of radius `1/64`, including irrational points.
Weight two is quasimodular; holomorphicity alone does not assert modularity. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.RationalEisenstein
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert DomainFunctions RationalLambert

inductive Weight where
  | two | four | six
  deriving DecidableEq

def degree : Weight → Nat | .two => 1 | .four => 3 | .six => 5
def coefficient : Weight → Rat | .two => -24 | .four => 240 | .six => -504

theorem degree_supported (w : Weight) : degree w=1 ∨ degree w=3 ∨ degree w=5 := by
  cases w <;> simp [degree]

def legacyMap : Weight → DomainFunctions.Map
  | .two => wideNomeEisensteinTwoMap
  | .four => wideNomeEisensteinFourMap
  | .six => wideNomeEisensteinSixMap

theorem legacyDomain (w : Weight) (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) : (legacyMap w).domain q := by
  cases w <;> exact hq

def derivedValue (w : Weight) (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) : Scalar :=
  ⟨add one (scaleRat (coefficient w) (RationalLambert.value q hq (degree w))),
    add_valid (ofQComplex_valid _) (scaleRat_valid (value_valid q hq (degree w) (degree_supported w)))⟩

theorem derivedValue_agrees (w : Weight) (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) :
    (derivedValue w q hq).val.Equiv ((legacyMap w).eval q (legacyDomain w q hq)).val := by
  have h := add_equiv (equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid QComplex.one))
    (scaleRat_equiv (r := coefficient w) (value_agrees q hq (degree w) (degree_supported w)))
  cases w <;> simpa [derivedValue,degree,coefficient,legacyMap,RationalLambert.comparison,
    wideNomeEisensteinTwoMap,wideNomeEisensteinFourMap,wideNomeEisensteinSixMap,
    wideLambertFirstMap,wideLambertThirdMap,wideLambertFifthMap,ComplexRaw.one,
    if_pos (by decide : (1:Nat)=1),if_neg (by decide : (3:Nat)≠1),
    if_pos (by decide : (3:Nat)=3),if_neg (by decide : (5:Nat)≠1),if_neg (by decide : (5:Nat)≠3)] using h

def derivedMap (w : Weight) : DomainFunctions.Map where
  domain := wideLambertFifthDomain
  eval := derivedValue w
  domain_congr := wideLambertFifthDomain_openData.invariant
  eval_congr q z hq hz he := equiv_trans (derivedValue w q hq).property ((legacyMap w).eval q (legacyDomain w q hq)).property
    (derivedValue w z hz).property (derivedValue_agrees w q hq)
    (equiv_trans ((legacyMap w).eval q (legacyDomain w q hq)).property ((legacyMap w).eval z (legacyDomain w z hz)).property (derivedValue w z hz).property
      ((legacyMap w).eval_congr q z (legacyDomain w q hq) (legacyDomain w z hz) he) (equiv_symm (derivedValue_agrees w z hz)))

noncomputable def derivedMap_holomorphic (w : Weight) : Holomorphic (derivedMap w) := by
  have h : Holomorphic (legacyMap w) := by
    cases w
    · exact wideNomeEisensteinTwoMap_holomorphic
    · exact wideNomeEisensteinFourMap_holomorphic
    · exact wideNomeEisensteinSixMap_holomorphic
  exact h.transfer (derivedMap w) (fun q h => legacyDomain w q h)
    ⟨wideLambertFifthDomain_openData.radius,wideLambertFifthDomain_openData.inside⟩
    (fun q hq => equiv_symm (derivedValue_agrees w q hq))

def rationalDomain (q : QComplex) : Prop := BoxApproximation.coordinateBound q < (1:Rat)/64

theorem rationalDomain_small (q : QComplex) (hq : rationalDomain q) : Small (ofQComplex q) ((1:Rat)/64) :=
  (BoxApproximation.rational_small q).mono (Rat.le_of_lt hq)

theorem rationalDomain_inside (q : QComplex) (hq : rationalDomain q) : wideLambertFifthDomain (point q) :=
  ⟨BoxApproximation.coordinateBound q,BoxApproximation.coordinateBound_nonneg q,hq,BoxApproximation.rational_small q⟩

/-- Direct rational evaluation uses fixed rational prefixes, not a restriction
of any represented-point Eisenstein map. -/
def rationalValue (w : Weight) (q : QComplex) (hq : rationalDomain q) : Scalar :=
  ⟨add one (scaleRat (coefficient w) (RationalLambert.rationalValue q (degree w))),
    add_valid (ofQComplex_valid _) (scaleRat_valid
      (rationalValue_valid q (rationalDomain_small q hq) (degree w) (degree_supported w)))⟩

theorem rationalValue_agrees (w : Weight) (q : QComplex) (hq : rationalDomain q) :
    (rationalValue w q hq).val.Equiv ((legacyMap w).eval (point q) (legacyDomain w (point q) (rationalDomain_inside q hq))).val := by
  have h := add_equiv (equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid QComplex.one))
    (scaleRat_equiv (r := coefficient w) (RationalLambert.rationalValue_agrees q (rationalDomain_small q hq) (degree w) (degree_supported w)))
  cases w <;> simpa [rationalValue,degree,coefficient,legacyMap,RationalLambert.comparison,
    wideNomeEisensteinTwoMap,wideNomeEisensteinFourMap,wideNomeEisensteinSixMap,
    wideLambertFirstMap,wideLambertThirdMap,wideLambertFifthMap,ComplexRaw.one,
    if_pos (by decide : (1:Nat)=1),if_neg (by decide : (3:Nat)≠1),
    if_pos (by decide : (3:Nat)=3),if_neg (by decide : (5:Nat)≠1),if_neg (by decide : (5:Nat)≠3)] using h

theorem derived_rational_agreement (w : Weight) (q : QComplex) (hq : rationalDomain q) :
    ((derivedMap w).eval (point q) (rationalDomain_inside q hq)).val.Equiv (rationalValue w q hq).val :=
  equiv_trans (derivedValue w (point q) (rationalDomain_inside q hq)).property
    ((legacyMap w).eval (point q) (legacyDomain w (point q) (rationalDomain_inside q hq))).property (rationalValue w q hq).property
    (derivedValue_agrees w _ _) (equiv_symm (rationalValue_agrees w q hq))

def rationalRaw (w : Weight) : FunctionRaw where
  domain := rationalDomain
  compute q hq := (rationalValue w q hq).val.compute

theorem rationalRaw_valid (w : Weight) : (rationalRaw w).Valid := fun q hq => (rationalValue w q hq).property

def legacyRationalRaw (w : Weight) : FunctionRaw where
  domain := rationalDomain
  compute q hq := ((legacyMap w).eval (point q) (legacyDomain w (point q) (rationalDomain_inside q hq))).val.compute

def legacyImplementation (w : Weight) : ComplexFunctionImplementation (rationalRaw w) where
  raw := legacyRationalRaw w
  valid q hq := ((legacyMap w).eval (point q) (legacyDomain w (point q) (rationalDomain_inside q hq))).property
  agrees q hq _ := rationalValue_agrees w q hq

def smallChartRationalFunction (w : Weight) : ComplexFunction where
  preferred := rationalRaw w
  valid := rationalRaw_valid w
  implementations := [legacyImplementation w]

abbrev smallChartRationalEisensteinTwo := smallChartRationalFunction .two
abbrev smallChartRationalEisensteinFour := smallChartRationalFunction .four
abbrev smallChartRationalEisensteinSix := smallChartRationalFunction .six
abbrev smallChartSampledEisensteinTwo := derivedMap .two
abbrev smallChartSampledEisensteinFour := derivedMap .four
abbrev smallChartSampledEisensteinSix := derivedMap .six

/-- Exact overlap with the original narrower nome computations. -/
theorem smallChartSampledEisensteinTwo_original_agreement (q : Scalar) (hq : tauEulerNomeDomain q) :
    (smallChartSampledEisensteinTwo.eval q (tauEulerNomeDomain_wide_fifth_mem q hq)).val.Equiv (tauWeightTwoNomeMap.eval q hq).val :=
  equiv_trans (derivedValue .two q _).property (wideNomeEisensteinTwoMap.eval q _).property
    (tauWeightTwoNomeMap.eval q hq).property (derivedValue_agrees .two q _) (wideNomeEisensteinTwoMap_agreement q hq)

theorem smallChartSampledEisensteinFour_original_agreement (q : Scalar) (hq : tauEulerNomeDomain q) :
    (smallChartSampledEisensteinFour.eval q (tauEulerNomeDomain_wide_fifth_mem q hq)).val.Equiv (nomeEisensteinFourMap.eval q hq).val :=
  equiv_trans (derivedValue .four q _).property (wideNomeEisensteinFourMap.eval q _).property
    (nomeEisensteinFourMap.eval q hq).property (derivedValue_agrees .four q _) (wideNomeEisensteinFourMap_agreement q hq)

theorem smallChartSampledEisensteinSix_original_agreement (q : Scalar) (hq : tauEulerNomeDomain q) :
    (smallChartSampledEisensteinSix.eval q (tauEulerNomeDomain_wide_fifth_mem q hq)).val.Equiv (nomeEisensteinSixMap.eval q hq).val :=
  equiv_trans (derivedValue .six q _).property (wideNomeEisensteinSixMap.eval q _).property
    (nomeEisensteinSixMap.eval q hq).property (derivedValue_agrees .six q _) (wideNomeEisensteinSixMap_agreement q hq)

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.RationalEisenstein

/-! Normalized E2, E4 and E6 on the full open Euclidean nome disk.
 Primary samples take Q(i) arguments. Arbitrary represented evaluations are
 derived from those samples, with exact agreement on the previous chart.
 E2 is quasimodular; this construction does not change its transformation law. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.RationalEisenstein
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert DomainFunctions RationalLambert

abbrev unitDiskRationalDomain (q : QComplex) : Prop := QComplex.normSq q<1
abbrev unitDiskDomain := EisensteinUnitDisk.domain

def unitDiskRationalValue (w : Weight) (q : QComplex) (hq : unitDiskRationalDomain q) : Scalar :=
  ⟨add one (scaleRat (coefficient w) (DiskLambert.rationalValue q (degree w))),
    add_valid (ofQComplex_valid _) (scaleRat_valid (DiskLambert.rationalValue_valid q hq (degree w)))⟩

def unitDiskDerivedValue (w : Weight) (q : Scalar) (hq : unitDiskDomain q) : Scalar :=
  ⟨add one (scaleRat (coefficient w) (DiskLambert.value q hq (degree w))),
    add_valid (ofQComplex_valid _) (scaleRat_valid (DiskLambert.value_valid q hq (degree w)))⟩

def unitDiskDerivedMap (w : Weight) : DomainFunctions.Map where
  domain := unitDiskDomain
  eval := unitDiskDerivedValue w
  domain_congr := EisensteinUnitDisk.invariant
  eval_congr q z hq hz he := add_equiv (equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid _))
    (scaleRat_equiv (r := coefficient w) (DiskLambert.value_congr q z hq hz he (degree w)))

def unitDiskRationalRaw (w : Weight) : FunctionRaw where
  domain := unitDiskRationalDomain
  compute q hq := (unitDiskRationalValue w q hq).val.compute

theorem unitDiskRationalRaw_valid (w : Weight) : (unitDiskRationalRaw w).Valid :=
  fun q hq => (unitDiskRationalValue w q hq).property

theorem unitDiskDerived_rational_agreement (w : Weight) (q : QComplex) (hq : unitDiskRationalDomain q) :
    (unitDiskDerivedValue w (point q) (EisensteinUnitDisk.rational_mem q hq)).val.Equiv (unitDiskRationalValue w q hq).val :=
  add_equiv (equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid _))
    (scaleRat_equiv (r := coefficient w) (DiskLambert.value_rational_agreement q hq (degree w)))

theorem unitDiskDerived_smallChart_agreement (w : Weight) (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) :
    (unitDiskDerivedValue w q (DiskLambert.wide_mem q hq)).val.Equiv (derivedValue w q hq).val := by
  have h := equiv_trans (DiskLambert.value_valid q (DiskLambert.wide_mem q hq) (degree w))
    (comparison q (LocalODE.interior_bound _ _ hq) (degree w)).property
    (RationalLambert.value_valid q hq (degree w) (degree_supported w))
    (DiskLambert.value_legacy_agreement q hq (degree w) (degree_supported w))
    (equiv_symm (RationalLambert.value_agrees q hq (degree w) (degree_supported w)))
  exact add_equiv (equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid _)) (scaleRat_equiv (r := coefficient w) h)

theorem unitDiskRational_smallChart_agreement (w : Weight) (q : QComplex)
    (hq : unitDiskRationalDomain q) (hs : rationalDomain q) :
    (unitDiskRationalValue w q hq).val.Equiv (rationalValue w q hs).val := by
  have h := equiv_trans (DiskLambert.rationalValue_valid q hq (degree w))
    (comparison (point q) (rationalDomain_small q hs) (degree w)).property
    (RationalLambert.rationalValue_valid q (rationalDomain_small q hs) (degree w) (degree_supported w))
    (DiskLambert.rational_legacy_agreement q (rationalDomain_small q hs) (degree w) (degree_supported w))
    (equiv_symm (RationalLambert.rationalValue_agrees q (rationalDomain_small q hs) (degree w) (degree_supported w)))
  exact add_equiv (equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid _)) (scaleRat_equiv (r := coefficient w) h)

def smallChartImplementation (w : Weight) : ComplexFunctionImplementation (unitDiskRationalRaw w) where
  raw := rationalRaw w
  valid := rationalRaw_valid w
  agrees q hq hs := unitDiskRational_smallChart_agreement w q hq hs

/-- Preferred full-disk rational sampler with the former chart as an
 explicitly proved alternative on its overlap. -/
def unitDiskRationalFunction (w : Weight) : ComplexFunction where
  preferred := unitDiskRationalRaw w
  valid := unitDiskRationalRaw_valid w
  implementations := [smallChartImplementation w]

abbrev unitDiskRationalEisensteinTwo := unitDiskRationalFunction .two
abbrev unitDiskRationalEisensteinFour := unitDiskRationalFunction .four
abbrev unitDiskRationalEisensteinSix := unitDiskRationalFunction .six
abbrev unitDiskSampledEisensteinTwo := unitDiskDerivedMap .two
abbrev unitDiskSampledEisensteinFour := unitDiskDerivedMap .four
abbrev unitDiskSampledEisensteinSix := unitDiskDerivedMap .six

abbrev rationalFunction := unitDiskRationalFunction

/-- Default elementary modular chart interfaces now cover the full unit disk. -/
abbrev rationalEisensteinTwo := unitDiskRationalEisensteinTwo
abbrev rationalEisensteinFour := unitDiskRationalEisensteinFour
abbrev rationalEisensteinSix := unitDiskRationalEisensteinSix
abbrev sampledEisensteinTwo := unitDiskSampledEisensteinTwo
abbrev sampledEisensteinFour := unitDiskSampledEisensteinFour
abbrev sampledEisensteinSix := unitDiskSampledEisensteinSix

/-- All exact small-chart clients use the same value after enlargement. -/
theorem unitDiskDerived_legacy_agreement (w : Weight) (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) :
    (unitDiskDerivedValue w q (DiskLambert.wide_mem q hq)).val.Equiv ((legacyMap w).eval q (legacyDomain w q hq)).val :=
  equiv_trans (unitDiskDerivedValue w q _).property (derivedValue w q hq).property ((legacyMap w).eval q _).property
    (unitDiskDerived_smallChart_agreement w q hq) (derivedValue_agrees w q hq)

theorem sampledEisensteinTwo_original_agreement (q : Scalar) (hq : tauEulerNomeDomain q) :
    (sampledEisensteinTwo.eval q (DiskLambert.wide_mem q (tauEulerNomeDomain_wide_fifth_mem q hq))).val.Equiv (tauWeightTwoNomeMap.eval q hq).val :=
  equiv_trans (unitDiskDerivedValue .two q _).property (wideNomeEisensteinTwoMap.eval q (tauEulerNomeDomain_wide_fifth_mem q hq)).property
    (tauWeightTwoNomeMap.eval q hq).property (unitDiskDerived_legacy_agreement .two q (tauEulerNomeDomain_wide_fifth_mem q hq))
    (wideNomeEisensteinTwoMap_agreement q hq)

theorem sampledEisensteinFour_original_agreement (q : Scalar) (hq : tauEulerNomeDomain q) :
    (sampledEisensteinFour.eval q (DiskLambert.wide_mem q (tauEulerNomeDomain_wide_fifth_mem q hq))).val.Equiv (nomeEisensteinFourMap.eval q hq).val :=
  equiv_trans (unitDiskDerivedValue .four q _).property (wideNomeEisensteinFourMap.eval q (tauEulerNomeDomain_wide_fifth_mem q hq)).property
    (nomeEisensteinFourMap.eval q hq).property (unitDiskDerived_legacy_agreement .four q (tauEulerNomeDomain_wide_fifth_mem q hq))
    (wideNomeEisensteinFourMap_agreement q hq)

theorem sampledEisensteinSix_original_agreement (q : Scalar) (hq : tauEulerNomeDomain q) :
    (sampledEisensteinSix.eval q (DiskLambert.wide_mem q (tauEulerNomeDomain_wide_fifth_mem q hq))).val.Equiv (nomeEisensteinSixMap.eval q hq).val :=
  equiv_trans (unitDiskDerivedValue .six q _).property (wideNomeEisensteinSixMap.eval q (tauEulerNomeDomain_wide_fifth_mem q hq)).property
    (nomeEisensteinSixMap.eval q hq).property (unitDiskDerived_legacy_agreement .six q (tauEulerNomeDomain_wide_fifth_mem q hq))
    (wideNomeEisensteinSixMap_agreement q hq)

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambertPolynomialBridge
import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.BoundedHolomorphicSequenceLimit

/-! Holomorphicity of the full-disk extension of the primary rational Lambert
function. Finite polynomial laws, uniform rational errors and the checked
represented-input bridge construct local Cauchy derivative witnesses. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambert
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert DomainFunctions RationalLambert CauchyTaylor EisensteinDiskPatches
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000

def map (k : Nat) : DomainFunctions.Map where
  domain := EisensteinUnitDisk.domain
  eval q hq := ⟨value q hq k,value_valid q hq k⟩
  domain_congr := EisensteinUnitDisk.invariant
  eval_congr q z hq hz he := value_congr q z hq hz he k

def patchMap (P : Patch) (k : Nat) : DomainFunctions.Map :=
  onDomain (map k) (openData P).invariant (included P)
def patchPolynomial (P : Patch) (k N : Nat) : DomainFunctions.Map :=
  onDomain (polynomialMap k N (cutoff (EisensteinDiskPatches.radius P) k+N)) (openData P).invariant (fun _ _ => trivial)
def patchPolynomial_holomorphic (P : Patch) (k N : Nat) : Holomorphic (patchPolynomial P k N) :=
  (polynomialMap_holomorphic k N (cutoff (EisensteinDiskPatches.radius P) k+N)).onDomain (openData P) (fun _ _ => trivial)

theorem patch_holomorphic_exists (P : Patch) (k : Nat) : Nonempty (Holomorphic (patchMap P k)) := by
  let r := EisensteinDiskPatches.radius P
  have hr : 0≤r := Rat.le_of_lt (radius_pos P)
  have hr1 : r<1 := radius_lt_one P
  let e := polynomialError r k
  let B : QPos := ⟨2*budget r k+1,by have := budget_nonneg r hr hr1 k; grind only⟩
  apply BoundedHolomorphicSequenceLimit.exists_holomorphic (patchMap P k) (patchPolynomial P k)
    (fun _ => rfl) (patchPolynomial_holomorphic P k) B
    (fun N q hq => (polynomial_patch_bound P q hq k N (cutoff r k+N)).mono (by dsimp [B]; grind only))
    (fun N => 2*e N) e
    (RepresentedCauchySum.twice_shrinks e (polynomialError_shrinks r hr hr1 k))
    (polynomialError_shrinks r hr hr1 k)
    (fun N => Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide +kernel) (polynomialError_nonneg r hr hr1 k N))
  · intro N L hNL q hL hN
    have hleft := RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ (value_polynomial_close P q hL k L)
    have hright := value_polynomial_close P q hN k N
    have hb := triangle _ _ _ ((patchPolynomial P k L).eval q hL).property
      ((patchMap P k).eval q hN).property ((patchPolynomial P k N).eval q hN).property _ _ hleft hright
    have he := polynomialError_antitone r hr hr1 k N L hNL
    exact hb.mono (by change e L+e N≤2*e N; dsimp [e] at *; grind only)
  · exact fun N q hf _ => value_polynomial_close P q hf k N

noncomputable def patch_holomorphic (P : Patch) (k : Nat) : Holomorphic (patchMap P k) :=
  Classical.choice (patch_holomorphic_exists P k)

/-- Actual holomorphicity on the entire open Euclidean unit disk. No
holomorphicity, derivative or Cauchy identity is assumed for the limit. -/
noncomputable def holomorphic (k : Nat) : Holomorphic (map k) := by
  let P := fun q hq => Classical.choose (covers q hq)
  have mem := fun q hq => Classical.choose_spec (covers q hq)
  exact holomorphic_of_local (map k) (fun q hq => patchMap (P q hq) k)
    (fun q hq => patch_holomorphic (P q hq) k) mem
    (fun q hq => included (P q hq)) (fun q hq z hz => equiv_refl _ (value_valid z (included (P q hq) z hz) k))
end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambert

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambertPolynomials
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.EisensteinDiskPatches

/-! Actual represented-input bridges for the finite polynomial certificates.
Continuity of each finite polynomial and the existing rational-sample lift
transfer the uniform rational estimates to every point of a compact patch. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambert
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert DomainFunctions RationalLambert CauchyTaylor
open EisensteinDiskPatches
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000

theorem select_sample (P : Patch) (q : Scalar) (hq : EisensteinDiskPatches.domain P q)
    (hd : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain q) (k : Nat) (F : DomainFunctions.Map)
    (hD : ∀z, F.domain z) (hF : ContinuousOn F.domain F.eval) (eps : QPos) :
    ∃T, InDisk (samplePoint q hd k T) (EisensteinDiskPatches.radius P) ∧
      (RepresentedCauchySum.error T).val≤eps.val ∧
      Small (sub (F.eval (point (samplePoint q hd k T)) (hD _)).val (F.eval q (hD q)).val) eps.val := by
  let eta := minRadius eps (hF.delta q (hD q) eps)
  obtain ⟨A,hA⟩ := samples_eventually_inside P q hq hd k
  obtain ⟨B,hB⟩ := RepresentedCauchySum.error_shrinks eta
  let T := max A B
  have herr := hB T (Nat.le_max_right A B)
  have hs := (sample_close q hd k T).mono (Rat.le_trans (inputRadius_le_error q hd k T)
    (Rat.le_trans herr (minRadius_right _ _)))
  exact ⟨T,hA T (Nat.le_max_left A B),Rat.le_trans herr (minRadius_left _ _),hF.estimate q (hD q) eps _ (hD _) hs⟩

theorem polynomial_patch_bound (P : Patch) (q : Scalar) (hq : EisensteinDiskPatches.domain P q) (k M N : Nat) :
    Small ((polynomialMap k M N).eval q trivial).val (2*budget (EisensteinDiskPatches.radius P) k) := by
  apply SeriesLimitLaws.small_closed _ _ (fun j => (RepresentedCauchySum.error j).val) RepresentedCauchySum.error_shrinks
  intro j
  obtain ⟨T,hT,_,hF⟩ := select_sample P q hq (included P q hq) k (polynomialMap k M N)
    (fun _ => trivial) (polynomialMap_holomorphic k M N).continuous (RepresentedCauchySum.error j)
  let p := samplePoint q (included P q hq) k T
  have hb := rational_norm_small _ _ (polynomialPrefix_bound p _ (Rat.le_of_lt (radius_pos P)) (radius_lt_one P) hT k M N)
  have hbp := Small.congr (ofQComplex_valid _) ((polynomialMap k M N).eval (point p) trivial).property
    (equiv_symm (polynomialMap_rational p k M N)) hb
  have hs := LocalODE.small_add hbp (RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ hF)
  exact Small.congr (add_valid ((polynomialMap k M N).eval (point p) trivial).property
    (sub_valid ((polynomialMap k M N).eval q trivial).property ((polynomialMap k M N).eval (point p) trivial).property))
    ((polynomialMap k M N).eval q trivial).property
    (SeriesLimitLaws.add_difference _ _ ((polynomialMap k M N).eval q trivial).property
      ((polynomialMap k M N).eval (point p) trivial).property) hs

theorem value_polynomial_close (P : Patch) (q : Scalar) (hq : EisensteinDiskPatches.domain P q) (k N : Nat) :
    Small (sub (value q (included P q hq) k)
      ((polynomialMap k N (cutoff (EisensteinDiskPatches.radius P) k+N)).eval q trivial).val)
      (polynomialError (EisensteinDiskPatches.radius P) k N) := by
  let r := EisensteinDiskPatches.radius P
  let F := polynomialMap k N (cutoff r k+N)
  apply SeriesLimitLaws.small_closed _ _ (fun j => 3*(RepresentedCauchySum.error j).val)
    (SeriesLimitLaws.shrinks_scale _ RepresentedCauchySum.error_shrinks 3 (by decide +kernel))
  intro j
  obtain ⟨T,hT,herr,hF⟩ := select_sample P q hq (included P q hq) k F (fun _ => trivial)
    (polynomialMap_holomorphic k N (cutoff r k+N)).continuous (RepresentedCauchySum.error j)
  let p := samplePoint q (included P q hq) k T
  have h1 := (value_close_sample q (included P q hq) k T).mono
    (Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left herr (by decide +kernel : (0:Rat)≤2))
  have h2 := rational_polynomial_close p r (Rat.le_of_lt (radius_pos P)) (radius_lt_one P) hT k N
  have h2' := Small.congr (sub_valid (rationalValue_valid p (sample_unit_disk q (included P q hq) k T) k) (ofQComplex_valid _))
    (sub_valid (rationalValue_valid p (sample_unit_disk q (included P q hq) k T) k) (F.eval (point p) trivial).property)
    (FunctionTheory.sub_congr (equiv_refl _ (rationalValue_valid p (sample_unit_disk q (included P q hq) k T) k))
      (equiv_symm (polynomialMap_rational p k N (cutoff r k+N)))) h2
  have h12 := triangle _ _ _ (value_valid q (included P q hq) k)
    (rationalValue_valid p (sample_unit_disk q (included P q hq) k T) k) (F.eval (point p) trivial).property _ _ h1 h2'
  have h123 := triangle _ _ _ (value_valid q (included P q hq) k) (F.eval (point p) trivial).property
    (F.eval q trivial).property _ _ h12 hF
  exact h123.mono (by grind only)
end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambert

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambertLift
import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.EntireMonomial
