/-! Finite polynomial certificates for the primary rational Lambert samples.
Both truncations are finite: the outer Lambert prefix and the inner geometric
kernel. They are used as proof approximations, not as a new value evaluator. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambert
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert DomainFunctions RationalLambert CauchyTaylor
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000

def polynomialTerm (q : QComplex) (k n M : Nat) : QComplex :=
  QComplex.scaleRat (((n+1:Nat):Rat)^k)
    (QComplex.mul (QComplex.natPow q (n+1)) (geometric (QComplex.natPow q (n+1)) M))
def polynomialPrefix (q : QComplex) (k M : Nat) : Nat → QComplex
  | 0 => QComplex.zero
  | N+1 => QComplex.add (polynomialPrefix q k M N) (polynomialTerm q k N M)

def geometricScalar (q : Scalar) (n : Nat) : Nat → Scalar
  | 0 => ⟨zero,ofQComplex_valid _⟩
  | M+1 => scalarSum oneScalar (scalarProduct (EntireMonomial.scalar q (n+1)) (geometricScalar q n M))
def geometricMap (n M : Nat) : DomainFunctions.Map where
  domain _ := True
  eval q _ := geometricScalar q n M
  domain_congr _ _ _ := Iff.rfl
  eval_congr q z _ _ he := by
    induction M with
    | zero => exact equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid _)
    | succ M ih =>
      exact add_equiv (equiv_refl _ oneScalar.property)
        (mul_equiv (EntireMonomial.scalar q (n+1)).property (EntireMonomial.scalar z (n+1)).property
          (geometricScalar q n M).property (geometricScalar z n M).property
          (EntireMonomial.scalar_names q z he (n+1)) ih)
def geometricMap_holomorphic (n : Nat) : (M : Nat) → Holomorphic (geometricMap n M)
  | 0 => constantOn_holomorphic ScalarTopology.wholeData _
  | M+1 => ((constantOn_holomorphic ScalarTopology.wholeData oneScalar).sumOn
      ((EntireMonomial.holomorphic (n+1)).productOn (geometricMap_holomorphic n M) (fun _ _ => trivial))
      (fun _ _ => trivial)).transfer (geometricMap n (M+1)) (fun _ _ => trivial)
        ⟨fun _ _ => unitError,fun _ _ _ _ => trivial⟩ (fun q _ => equiv_refl _ (geometricScalar q n (M+1)).property)
def polynomialTermMap (k n M : Nat) : DomainFunctions.Map :=
  productOn (constantOn (fun _ => True) ScalarTopology.wholeData.invariant
      (point ⟨((n+1:Nat):Rat)^k,0⟩))
    (productOn (EntireMonomial.function (n+1)) (geometricMap n M) (fun _ _ => trivial)) (fun _ _ => trivial)
def polynomialTermMap_holomorphic (k n M : Nat) : Holomorphic (polynomialTermMap k n M) :=
  (constantOn_holomorphic ScalarTopology.wholeData _).productOn
    ((EntireMonomial.holomorphic (n+1)).productOn (geometricMap_holomorphic n M) (fun _ _ => trivial)) (fun _ _ => trivial)
def polynomialScalar (q : Scalar) (k M : Nat) : Nat → Scalar
  | 0 => ⟨zero,ofQComplex_valid _⟩
  | N+1 => scalarSum (polynomialScalar q k M N) ((polynomialTermMap k N M).eval q trivial)
def polynomialMap (k M N : Nat) : DomainFunctions.Map where
  domain _ := True
  eval q _ := polynomialScalar q k M N
  domain_congr _ _ _ := Iff.rfl
  eval_congr q z _ _ he := by
    induction N with
    | zero => exact equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid _)
    | succ N ih => exact add_equiv ih ((polynomialTermMap k N M).eval_congr q z trivial trivial he)
def polynomialMap_holomorphic (k M : Nat) : (N : Nat) → Holomorphic (polynomialMap k M N)
  | 0 => constantOn_holomorphic ScalarTopology.wholeData _
  | N+1 => ((polynomialMap_holomorphic k M N).sumOn (polynomialTermMap_holomorphic k N M)
      (fun _ _ => trivial)).transfer (polynomialMap k M (N+1)) (fun _ _ => trivial)
        ⟨fun _ _ => unitError,fun _ _ _ _ => trivial⟩ (fun q _ => equiv_refl _ (polynomialScalar q k M (N+1)).property)

theorem geometricMap_rational (q : QComplex) (n M : Nat) :
    ((geometricMap n M).eval (point q) trivial).val.Equiv (ofQComplex (geometric (QComplex.natPow q (n+1)) M)) := by
  induction M with
  | zero => exact equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid _)
  | succ M ih =>
    have hp := mul_equiv (EntireMonomial.scalar (point q) (n+1)).property (ofQComplex_valid (QComplex.natPow q (n+1)))
      (geometricScalar (point q) n M).property (ofQComplex_valid (geometric (QComplex.natPow q (n+1)) M))
      (power_constants q (n+1)) ih
    have hm := equiv_trans (mul_valid (EntireMonomial.scalar (point q) (n+1)).property (geometricScalar (point q) n M).property)
      (mul_valid (ofQComplex_valid _) (ofQComplex_valid _)) (ofQComplex_valid _) hp (RationalReciprocal.raw_mul_constants _ _)
    exact equiv_trans (geometricScalar (point q) n (M+1)).property
      (add_valid oneScalar.property (ofQComplex_valid _)) (ofQComplex_valid _) (add_equiv (equiv_refl _ oneScalar.property) hm) (add_constants _ _)

theorem polynomialTermMap_rational (q : QComplex) (k n M : Nat) :
    ((polynomialTermMap k n M).eval (point q) trivial).val.Equiv (ofQComplex (polynomialTerm q k n M)) := by
  have hp := mul_equiv (EntireMonomial.scalar (point q) (n+1)).property (ofQComplex_valid (QComplex.natPow q (n+1)))
    (geometricScalar (point q) n M).property (ofQComplex_valid (geometric (QComplex.natPow q (n+1)) M))
    (power_constants q (n+1)) (geometricMap_rational q n M)
  have hm := equiv_trans (mul_valid (EntireMonomial.scalar (point q) (n+1)).property (geometricScalar (point q) n M).property)
      (mul_valid (ofQComplex_valid _) (ofQComplex_valid _)) (ofQComplex_valid _) hp (RationalReciprocal.raw_mul_constants _ _)
  have h := mul_equiv (ofQComplex_valid (⟨((n+1:Nat):Rat)^k,0⟩ : QComplex)) (ofQComplex_valid _)
    (mul_valid (EntireMonomial.scalar (point q) (n+1)).property (geometricScalar (point q) n M).property)
    (ofQComplex_valid _) (equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid _)) hm
  exact equiv_trans ((polynomialTermMap k n M).eval (point q) trivial).property
    (mul_valid (ofQComplex_valid _) (ofQComplex_valid _)) (ofQComplex_valid _) h (by
    have h := RationalReciprocal.raw_mul_constants (⟨((n+1:Nat):Rat)^k,0⟩ : QComplex)
      (QComplex.mul (QComplex.natPow q (n+1)) (geometric (QComplex.natPow q (n+1)) M))
    have he : QComplex.mul (⟨((n+1:Nat):Rat)^k,0⟩ : QComplex)
        (QComplex.mul (QComplex.natPow q (n+1)) (geometric (QComplex.natPow q (n+1)) M))=polynomialTerm q k n M := by
      simp only [polynomialTerm,QComplex.mul,QComplex.scaleRat,QComplex.mk.injEq]
      constructor <;> grind only
    exact he ▸ h)

theorem polynomialMap_rational (q : QComplex) (k M N : Nat) :
    ((polynomialMap k M N).eval (point q) trivial).val.Equiv (ofQComplex (polynomialPrefix q k M N)) := by
  induction N with
  | zero => exact equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid _)
  | succ N ih =>
    exact equiv_trans (polynomialScalar (point q) k M (N+1)).property
      (add_valid (ofQComplex_valid _) (ofQComplex_valid _)) (ofQComplex_valid _)
      (add_equiv ih (polynomialTermMap_rational q k N M)) (add_constants _ _)

theorem power_disk_same (q : QComplex) (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (hq : InDisk q r) (n : Nat) :
    InDisk (QComplex.natPow q (n+1)) r := by
  have hp := disk_power hq (n+1)
  have hm := power_antitone hr (Rat.le_of_lt hr1) (show 1≤n+1 by omega)
  simp only [Rat.pow_one] at hm
  exact Rat.le_trans hp (EisensteinUnitDisk.square_mono _ _ (Rat.pow_nonneg hr) hm)

theorem polynomialTerm_error (q : QComplex) (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1)
    (hq : InDisk q r) (k n M : Nat) :
    (QComplex.sub (term q k n) (polynomialTerm q k n M)).normBound≤majorant r k n*r^M := by
  have hd := kernel_remainder_disk hr hr1 (power_disk_same q r hr hr1 hq n) M
  have hm := disk_mul (disk_power hq (n+1)) hd
  have hc := disk_normBound _ _ (Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.pow_nonneg hr)
    (Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.pow_nonneg hr) (Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr (by grind only : 0<1-r))))) hm
  have he : QComplex.sub (term q k n) (polynomialTerm q k n M)=
      QComplex.scaleRat (((n+1:Nat):Rat)^k) (QComplex.mul (QComplex.natPow q (n+1))
        (QComplex.sub (kernel (QComplex.natPow q (n+1))) (geometric (QComplex.natPow q (n+1)) M))) := by
    simp only [term,factor,polynomialTerm,kernel,denominator,RationalReciprocal.inverse,QComplex.inverse,
      QComplex.sub,QComplex.add,QComplex.neg,QComplex.mul,QComplex.scaleRat,QComplex.mk.injEq]
    constructor <;> grind only
  rw [he,QComplex.normBound_scaleRat]
  have hk : 0≤((n+1:Nat):Rat)^k := Rat.pow_nonneg (Rat.natCast_nonneg)
  have ha : qabs (((n+1:Nat):Rat)^k)=((n+1:Nat):Rat)^k := by unfold qabs; split <;> grind only
  rw [ha]
  have ht := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc hk
  dsimp [majorant] at *
  grind only

theorem polynomialPrefix_error (q : QComplex) (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1)
    (hq : InDisk q r) (k M N : Nat) :
    (QComplex.sub (finitePrefix q k N) (polynomialPrefix q k M N)).normBound≤majorantPrefix r k N*r^M := by
  induction N with
  | zero =>
    simp only [finitePrefix,polynomialPrefix,majorantPrefix,QComplex.sub,QComplex.add,QComplex.neg,QComplex.zero,QComplex.normBound,Rat.neg_zero,Rat.add_zero,Rat.zero_mul]
    decide +kernel
  | succ N ih =>
    have he : QComplex.sub (finitePrefix q k (N+1)) (polynomialPrefix q k M (N+1))=
        QComplex.add (QComplex.sub (finitePrefix q k N) (polynomialPrefix q k M N))
          (QComplex.sub (term q k N) (polynomialTerm q k N M)) := by
      simp only [finitePrefix,polynomialPrefix,QComplex.sub,QComplex.add,QComplex.neg,QComplex.mk.injEq]
      constructor <;> grind only
    rw [he]
    have hb := QComplex.normBound_add_le (QComplex.sub (finitePrefix q k N) (polynomialPrefix q k M N))
      (QComplex.sub (term q k N) (polynomialTerm q k N M))
    have ht := polynomialTerm_error q r hr hr1 hq k N M
    dsimp [majorantPrefix]
    grind only

/-- A finite bound uniform in both polynomial truncations. -/
def budget (r : Rat) (k : Nat) : Rat := majorantPrefix r k (cutoff r k)+tail r k 0
theorem budget_nonneg (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (k : Nat) : 0≤budget r k :=
  Rat.add_nonneg (majorantPrefix_nonneg r hr hr1 k _) (tail_nonneg r hr hr1 k 0)
theorem prefix_norm (q : QComplex) (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (hq : InDisk q r) (k N : Nat) :
    (finitePrefix q k N).normBound≤majorantPrefix r k N := by
  induction N with
  | zero =>
    simp only [finitePrefix,majorantPrefix,QComplex.zero,QComplex.normBound]
    decide +kernel
  | succ N ih =>
    exact Rat.le_trans (QComplex.normBound_add_le _ _) (rat_add_le_add ih (term_bound q r hr hr1 hq k N))
theorem norm_le_difference (a b : QComplex) : b.normBound≤a.normBound+(QComplex.sub a b).normBound := by
  have he : b=QComplex.sub a (QComplex.sub a b) := by
    cases b
    simp only [QComplex.sub,QComplex.add,QComplex.neg,QComplex.mk.injEq]
    constructor <;> grind only
  have h := QComplex.normBound_sub_le a (QComplex.sub a b)
  rw [←he] at h
  exact h
theorem polynomialPrefix_bound (q : QComplex) (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1)
    (hq : InDisk q r) (k M N : Nat) : (polynomialPrefix q k M N).normBound≤2*budget r k := by
  have hp := prefix_norm q r hr hr1 hq k N
  have he := polynomialPrefix_error q r hr hr1 hq k M N
  have hb := majorantPrefix_bound r hr hr1 k N
  have hm := CauchyTaylor.power_antitone hr (Rat.le_of_lt hr1) (show 0≤M by omega)
  rw [Rat.pow_zero] at hm
  have ht := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm (majorantPrefix_nonneg r hr hr1 k N)
  have hn := norm_le_difference (finitePrefix q k N) (polynomialPrefix q k M N)
  change majorantPrefix r k N≤budget r k at hb
  grind only

/-- The quantitative polynomial error on a compact disk. -/
def polynomialError (r : Rat) (k N : Nat) : Rat := tail r k N+budget r k*r^N
theorem polynomialError_nonneg (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (k N : Nat) : 0≤polynomialError r k N :=
  Rat.add_nonneg (tail_nonneg r hr hr1 k N) (Rat.mul_nonneg (budget_nonneg r hr hr1 k) (Rat.pow_nonneg hr))
theorem geometric_shrinks (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) : ShrinksToZero (fun N => r^N) := by
  let C := (1-r)⁻¹
  have hC : 0≤C := Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr (by grind only : 0<1-r))
  let B := C.ceil.natAbs+1
  have hCB : C≤(B:Rat) := by
    have hi : C.ceil≤(B:Int) := by dsimp [B]; have := Int.le_natAbs (a := C.ceil); omega
    exact Rat.le_trans Rat.le_ceil (by exact_mod_cast hi)
  apply shrinksToZero_of_natOverSuccBound (C := B)
  intro n
  have hp := power_nat_bound hr hr1 n
  have hx := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCB (Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr
    (show (0:Rat)<((n+1:Nat):Rat) from Rat.natCast_pos.mpr (by omega))))
  dsimp [C] at hx
  rw [Rat.div_def] at hp ⊢
  exact Rat.le_trans hp hx
theorem polynomialError_shrinks (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (k : Nat) : ShrinksToZero (polynomialError r k) :=
  RepresentedCauchySum.sum_shrinks _ _ (tail_shrinks r hr hr1 k)
    (SeriesLimitLaws.shrinks_scale _ (geometric_shrinks r hr hr1) (budget r k) (budget_nonneg r hr hr1 k))
theorem polynomialError_antitone (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1) (k m n : Nat) (hmn : m≤n) :
    polynomialError r k n≤polynomialError r k m :=
  rat_add_le_add (tail_antitone r hr hr1 k m n hmn)
    (Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (CauchyTaylor.power_antitone hr (Rat.le_of_lt hr1) hmn) (budget_nonneg r hr hr1 k))
theorem rational_polynomial_close (q : QComplex) (r : Rat) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r<1)
    (hq : InDisk q r) (k N : Nat) :
    Small (sub (rationalValue q k) (ofQComplex (polynomialPrefix q k N (cutoff r k+N)))) (polynomialError r k N) := by
  have hq1 : QComplex.normSq q<1 := by
    have hh := Rat.mul_pos (show 0<1-r by grind only) (show 0<1+r by grind only)
    dsimp [InDisk] at hq; grind only
  have hc := atRadius_close q r hr hr1 hq k N
  have ha := Small.congr (sub_valid (atRadius_valid q r hr hr1 hq k) (ofQComplex_valid _))
    (sub_valid (rationalValue_valid q hq1 k) (ofQComplex_valid _))
    (FunctionTheory.sub_congr (equiv_symm (rational_atRadius q r hr hr1 hq k)) (equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid _))) hc
  have he := polynomialPrefix_error q r hr hr1 hq k N (cutoff r k+N)
  have hb := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (majorantPrefix_bound r hr hr1 k (cutoff r k+N)) (Rat.pow_nonneg hr (n := N))
  have hs := rational_difference_small _ _ _ (Rat.le_trans he hb)
  exact triangle _ _ _ (rationalValue_valid q hq1 k) (ofQComplex_valid _) (ofQComplex_valid _) _ _ ha hs

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambert

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambertLift
import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.RectangularPoleSearch

/-! Rational rectangles compactly inside the disk provide local analytic
patches. Every full-disk name has such a patch; its rational samples eventually
lie in the same rectangle. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.EisensteinDiskPatches
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert DomainFunctions RectangularContour CauchyTaylor
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000

structure Patch where
  A : Rat
  C : Rat
  re_nonneg : 0≤A
  im_nonneg : 0≤C
  inside : A*A+C*C<1

def rectangle (P : Patch) : QInterval × QInterval := (⟨-P.A,P.A⟩,⟨-P.C,P.C⟩)
def domain (P : Patch) := RectangularPoleSearch.domain true (rectangle P)
def openData (P : Patch) : ScalarTopology.OpenData (domain P) := RectangularPoleSearch.openData true (rectangle P)
def radius (P : Patch) : Rat := (1+P.A*P.A+P.C*P.C)/2

theorem radius_pos (P : Patch) : 0<(radius P) := by
  have := rat_square_nonneg_basic P.A; have := rat_square_nonneg_basic P.C
  dsimp [radius]; grind only
theorem radius_lt_one (P : Patch) : (radius P)<1 := by have := P.inside; dsimp [radius]; grind only
theorem radius_square (P : Patch) : P.A*P.A+P.C*P.C≤(radius P)*(radius P) := by
  have := rat_square_nonneg_basic (1-(P.A*P.A+P.C*P.C)); dsimp [radius]; grind only
theorem rational_inside (P : Patch) (p : QComplex)
    (h : -P.A≤p.re ∧ p.re≤P.A ∧ -P.C≤p.im ∧ p.im≤P.C) : InDisk p (radius P) := by
  have hr := Rat.mul_nonneg (show 0≤P.A-p.re by grind only) (show 0≤P.A+p.re by grind only)
  have hi := Rat.mul_nonneg (show 0≤P.C-p.im by grind only) (show 0≤P.C+p.im by grind only)
  have := radius_square P
  dsimp [InDisk,QComplex.normSq]; grind only

theorem included (P : Patch) (q : Scalar) (hq : (domain P) q) : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain q := by
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := RectangularPoleSearch.eventually_inside (rectangle P) q hq
  refine ⟨N,?_⟩
  have h := hN N (Nat.le_refl _)
  have hc := EisensteinUnitDisk.bound_of_coordinates (q.val.compute N) P.A P.C P.re_nonneg P.im_nonneg
    (by dsimp [RectangularPoleSearch.InsideBox,rectangle] at h; grind only) (valid_ordered q.property N)
  have hb := rat_add_le_add
    (EisensteinUnitDisk.square_mono _ _ (EisensteinUnitDisk.re_nonneg _) hc.1)
    (EisensteinUnitDisk.square_mono _ _ (EisensteinUnitDisk.im_nonneg _) hc.2)
  have := P.inside
  dsimp [EisensteinUnitDisk.bound]; grind only

theorem samples_eventually_inside (P : Patch) (q : Scalar) (hq : (domain P) q) (hd : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain q) (k : Nat) :
    ∃N, ∀n, N≤n → InDisk (DiskLambert.samplePoint q hd k n) (radius P) := by
  obtain ⟨D,hD⟩ := (show RectanglePoleInterior (rectangle P) q from hq)
  let eps := halfError D
  obtain ⟨M,hM⟩ := q.property.2.2 eps
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := RepresentedCauchySum.error_shrinks eps
  refine ⟨N,fun n hn => (rational_inside P) _ ?_⟩
  have hclose := (DiskLambert.sample_close q hd k n).mono
    (Rat.le_trans (DiskLambert.inputRadius_le_error q hd k n) (hN n hn))
  have h1 := hclose.1 0 M
  have h2 := hclose.2.1 M 0
  have h3 := hclose.2.2.1 0 M
  have h4 := hclose.2.2.2 M 0
  have hb1 := hD.1 0 M
  have hb2 := hD.2.1 M 0
  have hb3 := hD.2.2.1 0 M
  have hb4 := hD.2.2.2 M 0
  have hw := hM M (Nat.le_refl _)
  change -eps.val≤(DiskLambert.samplePoint q hd k n).re+ -(q.val.compute M).lo.re at h1
  change (DiskLambert.samplePoint q hd k n).re+ -(q.val.compute M).hi.re≤eps.val at h2
  change -eps.val≤(DiskLambert.samplePoint q hd k n).im+ -(q.val.compute M).lo.im at h3
  change (DiskLambert.samplePoint q hd k n).im+ -(q.val.compute M).hi.im≤eps.val at h4
  change -P.A+D.val≤(q.val.compute M).hi.re at hb1
  change (q.val.compute M).lo.re≤P.A-D.val at hb2
  change -P.C+D.val≤(q.val.compute M).hi.im at hb3
  change (q.val.compute M).lo.im≤P.C-D.val at hb4
  change (q.val.compute M).hi.re-(q.val.compute M).lo.re≤eps.val ∧
    (q.val.compute M).hi.im-(q.val.compute M).lo.im≤eps.val at hw
  have := halfError_identity D
  change 2*eps.val=D.val at this
  constructor
  · grind only
  constructor
  · grind only
  constructor <;> grind only

theorem covers (q : Scalar) (hq : EisensteinUnitDisk.domain q) : ∃P : Patch, (domain P) q := by
  let B := q.val.compute (EisensteinUnitDisk.stage q hq)
  let A := EisensteinUnitDisk.reBound B
  let C := EisensteinUnitDisk.imBound B
  let D := 8*(A+C+1)
  have hA : 0≤A := EisensteinUnitDisk.re_nonneg B
  have hC : 0≤C := EisensteinUnitDisk.im_nonneg B
  have hb : A*A+C*C<1 := EisensteinUnitDisk.stage_spec q hq
  have hg : 0<1-(A*A+C*C) := by grind only
  have hD : 0<D := by dsimp [D]; grind only
  let eps : QPos := ⟨(1-(A*A+C*C))/D,Rat.mul_pos hg (Rat.inv_pos.mpr hD)⟩
  have he : eps.val*D=1-(A*A+C*C) := by
    dsimp [eps]; rw [Rat.div_def,Rat.mul_assoc,Rat.inv_mul_cancel D (Rat.ne_of_gt hD),Rat.mul_one]
  have he1 : eps.val≤1 := by
    have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show (1:Rat)≤D by dsimp [D]; grind only) (Rat.le_of_lt eps.property)
    have := rat_square_nonneg_basic A; have := rat_square_nonneg_basic C; grind only
  have he2 := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he1 (Rat.le_of_lt eps.property)
  have hp : (A+eps.val)*(A+eps.val)+(C+eps.val)*(C+eps.val)<1 := by dsimp [D] at he; grind only
  let P : Patch := ⟨A+eps.val,C+eps.val,by have := eps.property; grind only,by have := eps.property; grind only,hp⟩
  refine ⟨P,eps,?_⟩
  have hc := EisensteinUnitDisk.coordinates B
  have lower (j : Nat) : -A≤(q.val.compute j).hi.re ∧ -C≤(q.val.compute j).hi.im := by
    have hn := valid_nestedIn q.property (Nat.le_max_left (EisensteinUnitDisk.stage q hq) j)
    have hj := valid_nestedIn q.property (Nat.le_max_right (EisensteinUnitDisk.stage q hq) j)
    have ho := valid_ordered q.property (max (EisensteinUnitDisk.stage q hq) j)
    simp only [QBox.NestedIn,QBox.Ordered,QComplex.le_def] at hn hj ho
    change -A≤B.lo.re ∧ B.hi.re≤A ∧ -C≤B.lo.im ∧ B.hi.im≤C at hc
    grind only
  have upper (i : Nat) : (q.val.compute i).lo.re≤A ∧ (q.val.compute i).lo.im≤C := by
    have hn := valid_nestedIn q.property (Nat.le_max_left (EisensteinUnitDisk.stage q hq) i)
    have hj := valid_nestedIn q.property (Nat.le_max_right (EisensteinUnitDisk.stage q hq) i)
    have ho := valid_ordered q.property (max (EisensteinUnitDisk.stage q hq) i)
    simp only [QBox.NestedIn,QBox.Ordered,QComplex.le_def] at hn hj ho
    change -A≤B.lo.re ∧ B.hi.re≤A ∧ -C≤B.lo.im ∧ B.hi.im≤C at hc
    grind only
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro i j
    change -(A+eps.val)+eps.val≤(q.val.compute j).hi.re
    have := lower j
    grind only
  · intro i j
    change (q.val.compute i).lo.re≤A+eps.val-eps.val
    have := upper i
    grind only
  · intro i j
    change -(C+eps.val)+eps.val≤(q.val.compute j).hi.im
    have := lower j
    grind only
  · intro i j
    change (q.val.compute i).lo.im≤C+eps.val-eps.val
    have := upper i
    grind only
end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.EisensteinDiskPatches

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.UnitDiskEisenstein
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.DiskLambertHolomorphic

/-! Full-unit-disk holomorphicity for the extensions of the primary rational
Eisenstein functions. Normalization preserves the rational evaluator and all
exact comparison identities. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.RationalEisenstein
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert DomainFunctions

/-- The extension of each rational Eisenstein function is holomorphic at
 every represented point of the open unit disk, in all complex directions. -/
noncomputable def unitDiskDerivedMap_holomorphic (w : Weight) : Holomorphic (unitDiskDerivedMap w) := by
  let L := DiskLambert.map (degree w)
  let HL := DiskLambert.holomorphic (degree w)
  let O := ScalarTopology.ofDomain L HL.openDomain
  let c : Scalar := ⟨scaleRat (coefficient w) one,scaleRat_valid (ofQComplex_valid _)⟩
  let C := constantOn L.domain L.domain_congr c
  let U := constantOn L.domain L.domain_congr oneScalar
  have HC : Holomorphic C := constantOn_holomorphic O c
  have HU : Holomorphic U := constantOn_holomorphic O oneScalar
  exact (HU.sumOn (HC.productOn HL (fun _ h => h)) (fun _ h => h)).transfer (unitDiskDerivedMap w)
    (fun _ h => h) ⟨HL.openDomain.radius,HL.openDomain.inside⟩ (fun q hq => by
      apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
        (hleft := add_valid oneScalar.property (mul_valid c.property (L.eval q hq).property))
        (hright := (unitDiskDerivedValue w q hq).property)
      let V := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (L.eval q hq).val (L.eval q hq).property
      change 1+ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (coefficient w) 1*V=1+ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (coefficient w) V
      rw [←ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat_mul]
      have h : (1:ComplexRawQuotient.Value)*V=V := by grind only
      rw [h])

noncomputable def sampledEisensteinTwo_holomorphic : Holomorphic sampledEisensteinTwo := unitDiskDerivedMap_holomorphic .two
noncomputable def sampledEisensteinFour_holomorphic : Holomorphic sampledEisensteinFour := unitDiskDerivedMap_holomorphic .four
noncomputable def sampledEisensteinSix_holomorphic : Holomorphic sampledEisensteinSix := unitDiskDerivedMap_holomorphic .six

/-- Exact derivative agreement on the previous chart follows from actual
 derivative uniqueness, rather than from a chosen derivative formula. -/
theorem unitDiskDerived_derivative_smallChart_agreement (w : Weight) (q : Scalar) (hq : wideLambertFifthDomain q) :
    ((unitDiskDerivedMap_holomorphic w).derivative q (DiskLambert.wide_mem q hq)).val.Equiv
      ((derivedMap_holomorphic w).derivative q hq).val := by
  let H := (unitDiskDerivedMap_holomorphic w).transfer (derivedMap w)
    (fun z hz => DiskLambert.wide_mem z hz) (derivedMap_holomorphic w).openDomain
    (fun z hz => unitDiskDerived_smallChart_agreement w z hz)
  exact (H.atPoint q hq).unique ((derivedMap_holomorphic w).atPoint q hq) H.openDomain
end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.RationalEisenstein

import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.BoundaryCauchyInteriorReconstruction
import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.HolomorphicBoundaryDataExistence

/-! Genuine holomorphicity of supplied bounded represented limits.
Actual Cauchy moment computations construct the local derivative series;
finite errors prove its agreement with the supplied limit. Numerical bound
selection stays only inside the Prop existence proof. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.BoundedHolomorphicSequenceLimit
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory DomainFunctions RectangularContour BoundaryCauchyPowers
set_option autoImplicit false

/-- A represented shrinking limit of genuinely holomorphic prefixes is
holomorphic. Only validity, actual source bounds and quantitative convergence
are supplied; no derivative, Cauchy identity or holomorphic limit is assumed. -/
theorem exists_holomorphic (f : DomainFunctions.Map) (g : Nat → DomainFunctions.Map)
    (hD : ∀ K, (g K).domain=f.domain) (hg : ∀ K, Holomorphic (g K))
    (B : QPos) (hB : ∀ K z hz, Small ((g K).eval z hz).val B.val)
    (r e : Nat → Rat) (hr : ShrinksToZero r) (he : ShrinksToZero e)
    (hr0 : ∀ K, 0≤r K)
    (hfuture : ∀ K L, K≤L → ∀ z hL hK,
      Small (sub ((g L).eval z hL).val ((g K).eval z hK).val) (r K))
    (hclose : ∀ K z hf hg, Small (sub (f.eval z hf).val ((g K).eval z hg).val) (e K)) :
    Nonempty (Holomorphic f) := by
  classical
  have localWitnesses : ∀ a (ha : f.domain a), ∃ q : DomainFunctions.Map,
      Nonempty (Holomorphic q) ∧ q.domain a ∧
      (∀ z, q.domain z → f.domain z) ∧
      (∀ z hz hf, q.eval z hz≈f.eval z hf) := by
    intro a ha
    let ha0 : (g 0).domain a := (hD 0).symm ▸ ha
    let J := effectiveLocalRectangle (g 0) (hg 0) a ha0
    have hp : RectanglePoleInterior J a := effectiveLocalRectangle_pole_inside (g 0) (hg 0) a ha0
    have hord := rectanglePoleInterior_ordered J a hp
    have inside : ∀ K z, representedRectangleContains J z → (g K).domain z := by
      intro K z hz
      exact (hD K).symm ▸ ((hD 0) ▸ (effectiveLocalRectangle_domain (g 0) (hg 0) a ha0 z hz))
    let hd := fun K => rectangleBoundaryDomains_of_rectangle (g K) J hord.1 hord.2 (inside K)
    have hder : ∀ K, ∃ D : QPos, RectangleBoundaryDerivativeBound (g K) (hg K) J (hd K) D :=
      fun K => HolomorphicBoundaryDataExistence.derivative_bound_exists (g K) (hg K) J hord.1 hord.2 (hd K)
    let D : Nat → QPos := fun K => (hder K).choose
    have hderBound : ∀ K, RectangleBoundaryDerivativeBound (g K) (hg K) J (hd K) (D K) :=
      fun K => (hder K).choose_spec
    let rd := RectangularPoleReciprocal.boundaryDomains true J a hp hord.1 hord.2
    let U := RectangularPoleReciprocal.bound true J a hp
    let hu := RectangularPoleReciprocal.boundary_bound true J a hp hord.1 hord.2 rd
    let data : Nat → Data := fun K => {
      source := g K, holomorphic := hg K, rectangle := J, xOrder := hord.1, yOrder := hord.2,
      center := a, sourceDomains := hd K, reciprocalDomains := rd,
      valueBound := B, derivativeBound := D K, reciprocalBound := U,
      values := ⟨fun z hz => hB K z ((hd K).bottom z hz),fun z hz => hB K z ((hd K).top z hz),
        fun z hz => hB K z ((hd K).left z hz),fun z hz => hB K z ((hd K).right z hz)⟩,
      derivatives := hderBound K, reciprocals := hu }
    have hj : ∀ K, (data K).rectangle=(data 0).rectangle := fun _ => rfl
    have hc : ∀ K, (data K).center≈(data 0).center := fun _ => Setoid.refl a
    have hU : ∀ K, (data K).reciprocalBound=(data 0).reciprocalBound := fun _ => rfl
    have hV : ∀ K, (data K).valueBound=(data 0).valueBound := fun _ => rfl
    have hs : ∀ K L, K≤L → ∀ q, rationalRectangleBoundaryContains (data 0).rectangle q →
        ∀ hL hK, Small (sub ((data L).source.eval (rationalRectangleScalar q) hL).val
          ((data K).source.eval (rationalRectangleScalar q) hK).val) (r K) :=
      fun K L hKL _q _hq hL hK => hfuture K L hKL _ hL hK
    let F := BoundaryCauchySequenceLimits.function data hj hc hU hV r hr hr0 hs
    let H := BoundaryCauchySequenceLimits.holomorphic data hj hc hU hV r hr hr0 hs
    let O := (ScalarTopology.ofDomain F H.openDomain).inter (RectangularPoleSearch.openData true J)
    let q := onDomain F O.invariant (fun _ hz => hz.1)
    let Hq := H.onDomain O (fun _ hz => hz.1)
    have includeQ : ∀ z, q.domain z → f.domain z :=
      fun z hz => (hD 0) ▸ (inside 0 z (rectanglePoleInterior_mem J z hz.2))
    refine ⟨q,⟨Hq⟩,⟨Centered.center_mem a _,hp⟩,includeQ,?_⟩
    intro z hz hf
    apply SeriesLimitLaws.equiv_of_small_sub_zero
    let C := BoundaryCauchySequenceLimits.constant data
    have hC := BoundaryCauchySequenceLimits.constant_nonneg data
    have hshrinks := RepresentedCauchySum.sum_shrinks _ _
      (SeriesLimitLaws.shrinks_scale r hr (4*C) (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide +kernel) hC)) he
    apply SeriesLimitLaws.small_closed _ 0 (fun K => 4*C*r K+e K) hshrinks
    intro K
    let hzK := BoundaryCauchySequenceAgreement.prefix_domain data hc hU K z hz.1
    let gmem := inside K z (rectanglePoleInterior_mem J z hz.2)
    have hproj := BoundaryCauchyInteriorReconstruction.projection (data K) (inside K) z hzK hz.2
    have hleft := Small.congr
      (sub_valid (F.eval z hz.1).property ((BoundaryCauchySeries.function (data K)).eval z hzK).property)
      (sub_valid (F.eval z hz.1).property ((g K).eval z gmem).property)
      (FunctionTheory.sub_congr (equiv_refl _ (F.eval z hz.1).property) hproj)
      (BoundaryCauchySequenceAgreement.projection_close data hj hc hU hV r hr hr0 hs K z hz.1)
    have hright := RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ (hclose K z hf gmem)
    have hb := LocalODE.small_add hleft hright
    have heq := representedDifference_split (F.eval z hz.1) ((g K).eval z gmem) (f.eval z hf)
    exact (Small.congr (add_valid (sub_valid (F.eval z hz.1).property ((g K).eval z gmem).property)
      (sub_valid ((g K).eval z gmem).property (f.eval z hf).property))
      (sub_valid (q.eval z hz).property (f.eval z hf).property) heq hb).mono (by change 4*C*r K+e K≤0+(4*C*r K+e K); grind only)
  let q := fun a ha => (localWitnesses a ha).choose
  let cert := fun a ha => (localWitnesses a ha).choose_spec
  let H := fun a ha => Classical.choice (cert a ha).1
  let mem := fun a ha => (cert a ha).2.1
  let inside := fun a ha => (cert a ha).2.2.1
  let agree := fun a ha => (cert a ha).2.2.2
  exact ⟨holomorphic_of_local f q H mem inside (fun a ha z hz => agree a ha z hz (inside a ha z hz))⟩

end ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.BoundedHolomorphicSequenceLimit

import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.DomainAffineFunction
import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.DomainHolomorphicValueLaws

/-! Actual entire represented monomials, with name invariance and
holomorphic witnesses built from the quantitative affine and product laws. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.EntireMonomial
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory LocalODE DomainFunctions
set_option autoImplicit false

def scalar (z : Scalar) (k : Nat) : Scalar := ⟨power z.val k,power_valid z.val z.property k⟩

theorem scalar_names (z w : Scalar) (he : z≈w) (k : Nat) : scalar z k≈scalar w k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid _)
  | succ k ih => exact mul_equiv (scalar z k).property (scalar w k).property z.property w.property ih he

def function (k : Nat) : DomainFunctions.Map where
  domain _ := True
  eval z _ := scalar z k
  domain_congr _ _ _ := Iff.rfl
  eval_congr z w _ _ he := scalar_names z w he k

def identity : DomainFunctions.Map where
  domain _ := True
  eval z _ := z
  domain_congr _ _ _ := Iff.rfl
  eval_congr _ _ _ _ he := he

def identity_holomorphic : Holomorphic identity :=
  (affine_holomorphic ⟨zero,ofQComplex_valid _⟩ oneScalar).transfer identity (fun _ _ => trivial)
    ⟨fun _ _ => unitError,fun _ _ _ _ => trivial⟩
    (fun z _ => equiv_trans (add_valid (ofQComplex_valid _) (mul_valid oneScalar.property z.property))
      (mul_valid oneScalar.property z.property) z.property (zero_add_equiv _ (mul_valid oneScalar.property z.property))
      (one_mul_equiv _ z.property))

def holomorphic (k : Nat) : Holomorphic (function k) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact constantOn_holomorphic ScalarTopology.wholeData oneScalar
  | succ k ih =>
    exact (ih.productOn identity_holomorphic (fun _ _ => trivial)).transfer (function (k+1))
      (fun _ _ => trivial) ⟨fun _ _ => unitError,fun _ _ _ _ => trivial⟩
      (fun z _ => equiv_refl _ (power_valid z.val z.property (k+1)))

end ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.EntireMonomial

import ComputableAnalysis.ExponentialComputations.API
import ComputableAnalysis.ComplexExponentialRealBridge
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.GeometricQuarterTurn

/-! Exact bridges from rational elementary samplers to established numerical
computations and derived represented-point evaluations. No modular function
or additional holomorphic construction is defined here. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ExponentialComputations.Rational
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert ModularForms
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000

theorem rational_exponentialReal_agrees (x : Rat) :
    (ElementaryRational.exponentialReal.evalRaw x trivial).Equiv (expPowerSeries x) := by
  apply ComplexExponentialApproximation.exponentialRawAt_realPart_equiv_expPowerSeries
    x (QComplex.normBound (QComplex.ofRat x)) (QComplex.normBound_nonneg _)
  simp only [QComplex.normBound,QComplex.ofRat]
  rw [show qabs (0:Rat)=0 by decide +kernel,Rat.add_zero]
  exact Rat.le_refl

theorem rational_sinPi_agrees_derived (r : Rat) :
    (ElementaryRational.sinPi.evalRaw r trivial).Equiv
      (entireExponentialValue
        ⟨imaginaryAxis (ElementaryRational.piAngle r),
          imaginaryAxis_valid (ElementaryRational.piAngle_valid r)⟩).val.imagPart := by
  apply imagPart_equiv
  exact equiv_symm (entireExponential_legacy_lift (ElementaryRational.piRotationInput r))

theorem rational_cosPi_agrees_derived (r : Rat) :
    (ElementaryRational.cosPi.evalRaw r trivial).Equiv
      (entireExponentialValue
        ⟨imaginaryAxis (ElementaryRational.piAngle r),
          imaginaryAxis_valid (ElementaryRational.piAngle_valid r)⟩).val.realPart := by
  apply realPart_equiv
  exact equiv_symm (entireExponential_legacy_lift (ElementaryRational.piRotationInput r))

theorem rational_logarithm_agrees_derived (x : Rat) (hx : logarithm.definedAt x) :
    (logarithm.evalRaw x hx).Equiv (log (positiveRationalInput x hx)).val :=
  integralLog_equiv_log _

private theorem imaginaryAxis_rational (x : Rat) :
    (imaginaryAxis (RealRaw.ofRat x)).Equiv (ofQComplex ⟨0,x⟩) := by
  intro n
  apply (compareAt_overlap_iff _ _ n n).mpr
  rw [imaginaryAxis_compute]
  change QBox.Overlaps (QBox.point ⟨0,x⟩) (QBox.point ⟨0,x⟩)
  exact ⟨QComplex.le_refl _,QComplex.le_refl _⟩

private theorem piRotation_agrees_rational_rotation (r x : Rat)
    (h : (ElementaryRational.piAngle r).Equiv (RealRaw.ofRat x)) :
    (ElementaryRational.piRotationValue r).Equiv
      (ElementaryRational.exponentialValue ⟨0,x⟩) := by
  let a : Scalar := ⟨imaginaryAxis (ElementaryRational.piAngle r),
    imaginaryAxis_valid (ElementaryRational.piAngle_valid r)⟩
  let b : Scalar := ⟨ofQComplex ⟨0,x⟩,ofQComplex_valid _⟩
  have hab : a.val.Equiv b.val := equiv_trans a.property
    (imaginaryAxis_valid (x := RealRaw.ofRat x) (RealRaw.ofRat_valid x)) b.property
    (imaginaryAxis_equiv (y := RealRaw.ofRat x)
      (ElementaryRational.piAngle_valid r) (RealRaw.ofRat_valid x) h)
    (imaginaryAxis_rational x)
  exact equiv_trans (ElementaryRational.piRotationValue_valid r)
    (entireExponentialValue a).property (ElementaryRational.exponentialValue_valid ⟨0,x⟩)
    (equiv_symm (entireExponential_legacy_lift (ElementaryRational.piRotationInput r)))
    (equiv_trans (entireExponentialValue a).property (entireExponentialValue b).property
      (ElementaryRational.exponentialValue_valid ⟨0,x⟩)
      (entireExponentialValue_congr a b hab) (rational_powerSeries_agrees ⟨0,x⟩))

/-- Different rational coordinate sets are compared at their actual common
points, rather than comparing sine at the same untransformed parameter. -/
theorem sinPi_radian_agrees_on_chart_overlap :
    ElementaryRational.sinPi.AgreeAtCoordinates ElementaryRational.sineRadianRotation
      ElementaryRational.piAngle RealRaw.ofRat :=
  fun r x _ _ h => imagPart_equiv (piRotation_agrees_rational_rotation r x h)

theorem cosPi_radian_agrees_on_chart_overlap :
    ElementaryRational.cosPi.AgreeAtCoordinates ElementaryRational.cosineRadianRotation
      ElementaryRational.piAngle RealRaw.ofRat :=
  fun r x _ _ h => realPart_equiv (piRotation_agrees_rational_rotation r x h)

private theorem piAngle_half :
    (ElementaryRational.piAngle (1/2)).Equiv GeometricPiRotation.halfPi := by
  intro n
  apply (RealRaw.compareAt_overlap_iff _ _ n n).mpr
  have ho := RealRaw.interval_order_of_valid _ GeometricPiRotation.halfPi_valid n
  simp only [ElementaryRational.piAngle,ElementaryRational.pi,
    RealRaw.scaleRat,RealRaw.scaleRatCompute,
    if_pos (show (0:Rat)≤1/2 by decide +kernel),
    if_pos (show (0:Rat)≤2 by decide +kernel)]
  rw [←Rat.mul_assoc,←Rat.mul_assoc,show (1/2:Rat)*2=1 by decide +kernel,Rat.one_mul,Rat.one_mul]
  exact ⟨ho,ho⟩

theorem rational_piRotation_half :
    (ElementaryRational.piRotationValue (1/2)).Equiv
      (ofQComplex RotationSeries.imaginaryUnit) := by
  let a : Scalar := ⟨imaginaryAxis (ElementaryRational.piAngle (1/2)),
    imaginaryAxis_valid (ElementaryRational.piAngle_valid _)⟩
  let b : Scalar := ⟨GeometricPiRotation.imaginaryHalf,GeometricPiRotation.imaginaryHalf_valid⟩
  have hab : a.val.Equiv b.val :=
    imaginaryAxis_equiv (ElementaryRational.piAngle_valid _) GeometricPiRotation.halfPi_valid piAngle_half
  exact equiv_trans (ElementaryRational.piRotationValue_valid _) (entireExponentialValue a).property
    (ofQComplex_valid _) (equiv_symm (entireExponential_legacy_lift (ElementaryRational.piRotationInput _)))
    (equiv_trans (entireExponentialValue a).property (entireExponentialValue b).property
      (ofQComplex_valid _) (entireExponentialValue_congr a b hab) entireExponential_geometric_quarterTurn)

theorem rational_sinPi_half :
    (ElementaryRational.sinPi.evalRaw (1/2) trivial).Equiv (RealRaw.ofRat 1) :=
  imagPart_equiv rational_piRotation_half

theorem rational_cosPi_half :
    (ElementaryRational.cosPi.evalRaw (1/2) trivial).Equiv (RealRaw.ofRat 0) :=
  realPart_equiv rational_piRotation_half

end ComputableAnalysis.ExponentialComputations.Rational

import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.DomainContinuity

/-! Holomorphic composition for executable domain-dependent maps:
the domain is proved open, the chain-rule derivative is constructed,
and its continuity and representation invariance are derived. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.DomainFunctions
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory

def composeOpen (f g : Map) (hf : OpenDomain f) (hg : OpenDomain g)
    (hc : ContinuousOn g.domain g.eval) : OpenDomain (compose f g) where
  radius a ha := minRadius (hg.radius a (compose_inner_mem ha))
    (hc.delta a (compose_inner_mem ha) (hf.radius (g.eval a (compose_inner_mem ha)) (compose_outer_mem ha)))
  inside a ha z hza := by
    have hz := hg.inside a (compose_inner_mem ha) z (hza.mono (minRadius_left _ _))
    have himage := hc.estimate a (compose_inner_mem ha) _ z hz (hza.mono (minRadius_right _ _))
    exact ⟨hz, hf.inside _ (compose_outer_mem ha) (g.eval z hz) himage⟩

def Holomorphic.continuous {f : Map} (h : Holomorphic f) : ContinuousOn f.domain f.eval :=
  continuousOn_of_derivative f h.derivative h.atPoint

def Holomorphic.compose {f g : Map} (hf : Holomorphic f) (hg : Holomorphic g) :
    Holomorphic (compose f g) where
  openDomain := composeOpen f g hf.openDomain hg.openDomain hg.continuous
  derivative a ha := scalarProduct (hf.derivative (g.eval a (compose_inner_mem ha)) (compose_outer_mem ha))
    (hg.derivative a (compose_inner_mem ha))
  atPoint a ha := composeDerivative f g a ha _ _
    (hf.atPoint (g.eval a (compose_inner_mem ha)) (compose_outer_mem ha))
    (hg.atPoint a (compose_inner_mem ha))
  derivative_congr a b ha hb hab :=
    mul_equiv (hf.derivative (g.eval a (compose_inner_mem ha)) (compose_outer_mem ha)).property
      (hf.derivative (g.eval b (compose_inner_mem hb)) (compose_outer_mem hb)).property
      (hg.derivative a (compose_inner_mem ha)).property (hg.derivative b (compose_inner_mem hb)).property
      (hf.derivative_congr _ _ _ _ (g.eval_congr _ _ _ _ hab))
      (hg.derivative_congr _ _ _ _ hab)
  continuousDerivative := productContinuous _ _
    (composeContinuous f g hf.derivative hf.continuousDerivative hg.continuous)
    (restrictContinuous hg.derivative hg.continuousDerivative (fun _ hz => compose_inner_mem hz))

end ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.DomainFunctions

import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.UnitIntervalOpenCover
import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.RationalParameterCuts

/-! Local value equality propagates along the represented unit interval.
The finite bisection cover is proved from pointwise open coverage, and its
neighboring rational cells meet at an actual common rational parameter. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.UnitInterval
universe u v
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RectangularContour
set_option autoImplicit false
variable {I : Type u} {X : Type v} [Setoid X]

theorem rational_endpoint_contains (J : QInterval) (h0 : 0≤J.lo) (hJ : J.lo≤J.hi) (h1 : J.hi≤1) :
    intervalContains J (⟨J.lo,h0,Rat.le_trans hJ h1⟩ : RationalParameter).point ∧
      intervalContains J (⟨J.hi,Rat.le_trans h0 hJ,h1⟩ : RationalParameter).point := by
  refine ⟨⟨?_,?_⟩,⟨?_,?_⟩⟩ <;> intro k l
  · exact Rat.le_refl
  · exact hJ
  · exact hJ
  · exact Rat.le_refl

namespace RationalOpenCover

theorem endpoint_values_equal (U : I → Point → Prop) (value : Point → X)
    (localEqual : ∀ i s t, U i s → U i t → value s≈value t)
    (J : QInterval) (hc : RationalOpenCover U J) :
    ∀ h0 : 0≤J.lo, ∀ hJ : J.lo≤J.hi, ∀ h1 : J.hi≤1,
      value (⟨J.lo,h0,Rat.le_trans hJ h1⟩ : RationalParameter).point≈
        value (⟨J.hi,Rat.le_trans h0 hJ,h1⟩ : RationalParameter).point := by
  induction hc with
  | cell J i inside =>
    intro h0 hJ h1
    have hp := rational_endpoint_contains J h0 hJ h1
    exact localEqual i _ _ (inside _ hp.1) (inside _ hp.2)
  | split J hl hr il ir =>
    intro h0 hJ h1
    have bl := bisectInterval_bounds J hJ false
    have br := bisectInterval_bounds J hJ true
    exact Setoid.trans
      (il (Rat.le_trans h0 bl.1) bl.2.1 (Rat.le_trans bl.2.2 h1))
      (ir (Rat.le_trans h0 br.1) br.2.1 (Rat.le_trans br.2.2 h1))

end RationalOpenCover

/-- Equality on each member of a pointwise relative-open cover proves
endpoint equality. No uniform radius or finite cover is a caller input. -/
theorem values_equal_of_local (U : I → Point → Prop) (hU : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (cover : ∀ s, ∃ i, U i s) (value : Point → X)
    (localEqual : ∀ i s t, U i s → U i t → value s≈value t) :
    value UnitInterval.zero≈value UnitInterval.one :=
  RationalOpenCover.endpoint_values_equal U value localEqual ⟨0,1⟩ (rational_open_cover U hU cover)
    (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel)

end ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.UnitInterval

import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.ExponentialFrameHolomorphic
import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.HolomorphicPathConstancy

/-! Global constant-coefficient uniqueness for actual holomorphic solutions.
The inverse exponential reduces the equation to zero derivative. Checked
local uniqueness and the finite rational open-cover argument in path constancy
provide domain coverage; no equality or continuation provider is assumed. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.MatrixExponential
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory DomainVectorFunctions LinearField
set_option autoImplicit false
variable {n : Nat}

theorem constant_ode_path_unique
    (A : ValueMap (Fiber n) (Fiber n)) (hA : IsLinear A)
    (f g : DomainVectorFunctions.Map n)
    (hf : DomainVectorFunctions.Holomorphic f) (hg : DomainVectorFunctions.Holomorphic g)
    (hfODE : CoordinateConnection.Horizontal f hf (fun _ _ => A))
    (hgODE : CoordinateConnection.Horizontal g hg (fun _ _ => A))
    {p q : Scalar} (a : ScalarPaths.Path p q)
    (insideF : ∀ t, f.domain (a.eval t)) (insideG : ∀ t, g.domain (a.eval t))
    (hfp : f.domain p) (hfq : f.domain q) (hgp : g.domain p) (hgq : g.domain q)
    (hinitial : f.eval p hfp ≈ g.eval p hgp) : f.eval q hfq ≈ g.eval q hgq := by
  let N := inverseField (frameField A hA)
  let hN := frame_inverse_holomorphic A hA
  let F := action N (frame_inverse_congr A hA) f (fun _ _ => True.intro)
  let G := action N (frame_inverse_congr A hA) g (fun _ _ => True.intro)
  let hF := action_holomorphic N (fun _ _ _ => Iff.rfl) (frame_inverse_congr A hA)
    (fun z _ => value_linear (negativeOperator A) (negativeOperator_linear A hA) z)
    hN f hf (fun _ _ => True.intro)
  let hG := action_holomorphic N (fun _ _ _ => Iff.rfl) (frame_inverse_congr A hA)
    (fun z _ => value_linear (negativeOperator A) (negativeOperator_linear A hA) z)
    hN g hg (fun _ _ => True.intro)
  have hzF : ∀ z hz, derivative F hF z hz ≈ Fiber.zero n :=
    frame_inverse_horizontal A hA hN f hf hfODE
  have hzG : ∀ z hz, derivative G hG z hz ≈ Fiber.zero n :=
    frame_inverse_horizontal A hA hN g hg hgODE
  have hpathF := zero_derivative_path_constant F hF hzF a insideF hfp hfq
  have hpathG := zero_derivative_path_constant G hG hzG a insideG hgp hgq
  have he : (N q True.intro).eval (f.eval q hfq) ≈ (N q True.intro).eval (g.eval q hgq) :=
    Setoid.trans (Setoid.symm hpathF)
      (Setoid.trans ((N p True.intro).congr hinitial) hpathG)
  exact (frame A hA q).toValueIso.inverse.forward_reflects he

/-- Entire solutions need no caller-supplied path, bounds or neighborhoods.
The constructed affine route covers every valid represented endpoint. -/
theorem constant_ode_entire_unique
    (A : ValueMap (Fiber n) (Fiber n)) (hA : IsLinear A)
    (f g : DomainVectorFunctions.Map n)
    (hf : DomainVectorFunctions.Holomorphic f) (hg : DomainVectorFunctions.Holomorphic g)
    (hfullF : ∀ z, f.domain z) (hfullG : ∀ z, g.domain z)
    (hfODE : CoordinateConnection.Horizontal f hf (fun _ _ => A))
    (hgODE : CoordinateConnection.Horizontal g hg (fun _ _ => A))
    (p : Scalar) (hinitial : f.eval p (hfullF p) ≈ g.eval p (hfullG p))
    (z : Scalar) : f.eval z (hfullF z) ≈ g.eval z (hfullG z) :=
  constant_ode_path_unique A hA f g hf hg hfODE hgODE (ScalarPaths.affine p z)
    (fun _t => hfullF _) (fun _t => hfullG _) (hfullF p) (hfullF z)
    (hfullG p) (hfullG z) hinitial

end ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.MatrixExponential
