import ComputableAnalysis.ElementaryPowerSeries

/-! Exact finite coefficient identities for the certified odd/even samplers. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ElementaryPowerSeries
open ComplexExponentialApproximation

theorem sinSign_succ (n : Nat) : ComplexSeries.sinSign (n+1) = -ComplexSeries.sinSign n := by
  unfold ComplexSeries.sinSign
  by_cases h : n%2=0
  · have hs : (n+1)%2 ≠ 0 := by omega
    simp [h,hs]
  · have hs : (n+1)%2=0 := by omega
    simp [h,hs]

theorem pow_eq_natPow (z : QComplex) (n : Nat) : QComplex.pow z n = QComplex.natPow z n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [QComplex.pow,ih,QComplex.natPow_succ,QComplex.mul_comm_cert]

theorem pow_mul (z w : QComplex) (n : Nat) :
    QComplex.pow (QComplex.mul z w) n = QComplex.mul (QComplex.pow z n) (QComplex.pow w n) := by
  simp only [pow_eq_natPow,QComplex.natPow_mul]

theorem pow_neg (z : QComplex) (n : Nat) :
    QComplex.pow (QComplex.neg z) n = QComplex.scaleRat (ComplexSeries.sinSign n) (QComplex.pow z n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [QComplex.pow,ComplexSeries.sinSign,QComplex.scaleRat,QComplex.one]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [QComplex.pow,QComplex.pow,ih,sinSign_succ]
    simp only [QComplex.mul,QComplex.neg,QComplex.scaleRat]
    congr 1 <;> grind only

theorem pow_i_even (n : Nat) :
    QComplex.pow ElementaryRational.imaginaryUnit (2*n) = ⟨ComplexSeries.sinSign n,0⟩ := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [show 2*(n+1)=2*n+1+1 by omega,QComplex.pow,QComplex.pow,ih,sinSign_succ]
    simp only [ElementaryRational.imaginaryUnit,QComplex.mul]
    congr 1 <;> grind only

theorem pow_i_odd (n : Nat) :
    QComplex.pow ElementaryRational.imaginaryUnit (2*n+1) = ⟨0,ComplexSeries.sinSign n⟩ := by
  rw [QComplex.pow,pow_i_even]
  simp only [ElementaryRational.imaginaryUnit,QComplex.mul]
  congr 1 <;> grind only

theorem expTerm_neg_even (z : QComplex) (n : Nat) :
    term (QComplex.neg z) (2*n) = term z (2*n) := by
  have hs : ComplexSeries.sinSign (2*n)=1 := by
    unfold ComplexSeries.sinSign; rw [if_pos (by omega)]
  unfold term ComplexSeries.expTerm
  rw [pow_neg,hs,QComplex.scaleRat_one_cert]

theorem expTerm_neg_odd (z : QComplex) (n : Nat) :
    term (QComplex.neg z) (2*n+1) = QComplex.neg (term z (2*n+1)) := by
  have hs : ComplexSeries.sinSign (2*n+1)= -1 := by
    unfold ComplexSeries.sinSign; rw [if_neg (by omega)]
  unfold term ComplexSeries.expTerm
  rw [pow_neg,hs,QComplex.scaleRat_neg_one_cert]
  simp only [QComplex.divRat,QComplex.neg]
  congr 1 <;> grind only [Rat.div_def]

theorem expTerm_i_even (z : QComplex) (n : Nat) :
    term (QComplex.mul ElementaryRational.imaginaryUnit z) (2*n) = ComplexSeries.cosTerm z n := by
  unfold term ComplexSeries.expTerm ComplexSeries.cosTerm
  rw [pow_mul,pow_i_even]
  simp only [QComplex.mul,QComplex.divRat,QComplex.scaleRat,Rat.zero_mul,Rat.mul_zero,Rat.add_zero,Rat.sub_eq_add_neg,Rat.neg_zero]
  congr 1 <;> grind only [Rat.div_def]

theorem expTerm_i_odd (z : QComplex) (n : Nat) :
    term (QComplex.mul ElementaryRational.imaginaryUnit z) (2*n+1) =
      QComplex.mul ElementaryRational.imaginaryUnit (ComplexSeries.sinTerm z n) := by
  unfold term ComplexSeries.expTerm ComplexSeries.sinTerm
  rw [pow_mul,pow_i_odd]
  simp only [ElementaryRational.imaginaryUnit,QComplex.mul,QComplex.divRat,QComplex.scaleRat,
    Rat.zero_mul,Rat.mul_zero,Rat.add_zero,Rat.zero_add]
  congr 1 <;> grind only [Rat.div_def]

theorem pair_add (odd : Bool) (a b c d : QComplex) :
    pair odd (QComplex.add a c) (QComplex.add b d) =
      QComplex.add (pair odd a b) (pair odd c d) := by
  cases odd <;> simp only [pair,if_true,if_false,Bool.false_eq_true,QComplex.scaleRat,
    QComplex.sub,QComplex.add,QComplex.neg]
  all_goals congr 1 <;> grind only

theorem pair_same (z : QComplex) : pair false z z = z := by
  simp only [pair,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,QComplex.scaleRat,QComplex.add]
  congr 1 <;> grind only
theorem pair_difference_same (z : QComplex) : pair true z z = QComplex.zero := by
  simp only [pair,if_true,QComplex.scaleRat,QComplex.sub,QComplex.add,QComplex.neg,QComplex.zero]
  congr 1 <;> grind only
theorem pair_opposite (z : QComplex) : pair false z (QComplex.neg z) = QComplex.zero := by
  simp only [pair,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,QComplex.scaleRat,QComplex.add,QComplex.neg,QComplex.zero]
  congr 1 <;> grind only
theorem pair_difference_opposite (z : QComplex) : pair true z (QComplex.neg z) = z := by
  simp only [pair,if_true,QComplex.scaleRat,QComplex.sub,QComplex.add,QComplex.neg]
  congr 1 <;> grind only

theorem pairPrefix_even_succ (odd : Bool) (z : QComplex) (n : Nat) :
    pairPrefix odd z (2*(n+1)) = QComplex.add (pairPrefix odd z (2*n))
      (term z (if odd then 2*n+1 else 2*n)) := by
  unfold pairPrefix
  rw [show 2*(n+1)=2*n+1+1 by omega,expPrefix_succ,expPrefix_succ,expPrefix_succ,expPrefix_succ]
  rw [pair_add,pair_add,expTerm_neg_even,expTerm_neg_odd]
  cases odd
  · rw [pair_same,pair_opposite,QComplex.add_zero_cert]; rfl
  · rw [pair_difference_same,pair_difference_opposite,QComplex.add_zero_cert]; rfl

theorem sine_partial_succ (z : QComplex) (n : Nat) : ComplexSeries.sinPartial z (n+1) =
    QComplex.add (ComplexSeries.sinPartial z n) (ComplexSeries.sinTerm z n) := by
  unfold ComplexSeries.sinPartial; rw [List.range_succ,List.foldl_append]; rfl
theorem cosine_partial_succ (z : QComplex) (n : Nat) : ComplexSeries.cosPartial z (n+1) =
    QComplex.add (ComplexSeries.cosPartial z n) (ComplexSeries.cosTerm z n) := by
  unfold ComplexSeries.cosPartial; rw [List.range_succ,List.foldl_append]; rfl

theorem pairPrefix_i_cosine (z : QComplex) (n : Nat) :
    pairPrefix false (QComplex.mul ElementaryRational.imaginaryUnit z) (2*n) = ComplexSeries.cosPartial z n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact pair_same QComplex.zero
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pairPrefix_even_succ]
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,if_false]
    rw [ih,expTerm_i_even,cosine_partial_succ]

theorem pairPrefix_i_sine (z : QComplex) (n : Nat) :
    pairPrefix true (QComplex.mul ElementaryRational.imaginaryUnit z) (2*n) =
      QComplex.mul ElementaryRational.imaginaryUnit (ComplexSeries.sinPartial z n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    change pair true QComplex.zero QComplex.zero = QComplex.mul ElementaryRational.imaginaryUnit QComplex.zero
    rw [pair_difference_same,QComplex.mul_zero_cert]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pairPrefix_even_succ]
    simp only [if_true]
    rw [ih,expTerm_i_odd,←QComplex.mul_add_cert,sine_partial_succ]


theorem pairPrefix_odd_succ (odd : Bool) (z : QComplex) (n : Nat) :
    pairPrefix odd z (2*n+1) = QComplex.add (pairPrefix odd z (2*n))
      (if odd then QComplex.zero else term z (2*n)) := by
  unfold pairPrefix
  rw [expPrefix_succ,expPrefix_succ,pair_add,expTerm_neg_even]
  cases odd
  · rw [pair_same]; rfl
  · rw [pair_difference_same]; rfl

theorem pairPrefix_i_cosine_odd (z : QComplex) (n : Nat) :
    pairPrefix false (QComplex.mul ElementaryRational.imaginaryUnit z) (2*n+1) =
      ComplexSeries.cosPartial z (n+1) := by
  rw [pairPrefix_odd_succ,pairPrefix_i_cosine]
  simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,if_false]
  rw [expTerm_i_even,cosine_partial_succ]

theorem pairPrefix_i_sine_odd (z : QComplex) (n : Nat) :
    pairPrefix true (QComplex.mul ElementaryRational.imaginaryUnit z) (2*n+1) =
      QComplex.mul ElementaryRational.imaginaryUnit (ComplexSeries.sinPartial z n) := by
  rw [pairPrefix_odd_succ,pairPrefix_i_sine]
  simp only [if_true,QComplex.add_zero_cert]

def hyperbolicSinePartial (z : QComplex) (n : Nat) : QComplex :=
  (List.range n).foldl (fun p k => QComplex.add p (term z (2*k+1))) QComplex.zero
def hyperbolicCosinePartial (z : QComplex) (n : Nat) : QComplex :=
  (List.range n).foldl (fun p k => QComplex.add p (term z (2*k))) QComplex.zero

theorem hyperbolicSinePartial_succ (z : QComplex) (n : Nat) :
    hyperbolicSinePartial z (n+1) = QComplex.add (hyperbolicSinePartial z n) (term z (2*n+1)) := by
  unfold hyperbolicSinePartial; rw [List.range_succ,List.foldl_append]; rfl
theorem hyperbolicCosinePartial_succ (z : QComplex) (n : Nat) :
    hyperbolicCosinePartial z (n+1) = QComplex.add (hyperbolicCosinePartial z n) (term z (2*n)) := by
  unfold hyperbolicCosinePartial; rw [List.range_succ,List.foldl_append]; rfl

theorem pairPrefix_hyperbolicSine (z : QComplex) (n : Nat) :
    pairPrefix true z (2*n) = hyperbolicSinePartial z n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact pair_difference_same QComplex.zero
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pairPrefix_even_succ,ih,hyperbolicSinePartial_succ]
    simp only [if_true]

theorem pairPrefix_hyperbolicCosine (z : QComplex) (n : Nat) :
    pairPrefix false z (2*n) = hyperbolicCosinePartial z n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact pair_same QComplex.zero
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pairPrefix_even_succ,ih,hyperbolicCosinePartial_succ]
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,if_false]

end ComputableAnalysis.ElementaryPowerSeries

import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.ScalarPathConcatenation
import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.SpherePaths
import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.UnitIntervalSegmentOrder

/-! Continuous paths in represented complex coordinates. Every parameter is
a valid represented real in the unit interval; endpoints and path comparisons
use equality of values. These paths embed in the finite sphere chart. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.ScalarPaths
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory DomainFunctions UnitInterval

structure Path (p q : Scalar) where
  eval : Point → Scalar
  congr : ∀ s t, s ≈ t → eval s ≈ eval t
  continuous : ScalarContinuous eval
  source : eval UnitInterval.zero ≈ p
  target : eval UnitInterval.one ≈ q

def Path.Equiv {p q : Scalar} (a b : Path p q) : Prop := ∀ t, a.eval t ≈ b.eval t

instance {p q : Scalar} : Setoid (Path p q) where
  r := Path.Equiv
  iseqv := ⟨fun a t => Setoid.refl (a.eval t), fun h t => Setoid.symm (h t),
    fun h k t => Setoid.trans (h t) (k t)⟩

def toSphere {p q : Scalar} (a : Path p q) : SpherePaths.Path (.finite p) (.finite q) :=
  SpherePaths.ofFinite p q a.eval a.congr a.continuous a.source a.target

def constant (p : Scalar) : Path p p where
  eval _ := p
  congr _ _ _ := Setoid.refl p
  continuous := (constantContinuousData p).continuous
  source := Setoid.refl p
  target := Setoid.refl p

def affine (p q : Scalar) : Path p q where
  eval := RepresentedAffineSegment.point p q
  congr _ _ h := RepresentedAffineSegment.point_congr (Setoid.refl p) (Setoid.refl q) h
  continuous := RepresentedAffineSegment.continuous p q
  source := RepresentedAffineSegment.point_zero p q
  target := RepresentedAffineSegment.point_one p q

def reverse {p q : Scalar} (a : Path p q) : Path q p where
  eval t := a.eval (UnitInterval.reverse t)
  congr _ _ h := a.congr _ _ (UnitInterval.reverse_congr h)
  continuous U hU := UnitInterval.continuous_reverse (fun t => U (a.eval t)) (a.continuous U hU)
  source := Setoid.trans (a.congr _ _ UnitInterval.reverse_zero) a.target
  target := Setoid.trans (a.congr _ _ UnitInterval.reverse_one) a.source

theorem reverse_reverse {p q : Scalar} (a : Path p q) : reverse (reverse a) ≈ a :=
  fun t => a.congr _ _ (UnitInterval.reverse_reverse t)

def concatenate {p q r : Scalar} (a : Path p q) (b : Path q r) : Path p r where
  eval := ScalarPathConcatenation.value a.eval b.eval q
  congr := ScalarPathConcatenation.point_congr a.eval b.eval q a.congr b.congr
  continuous := ScalarPathConcatenation.continuous a.eval b.eval q a.congr b.congr a.continuous b.continuous
  source := ScalarPathConcatenation.source a.eval b.eval p q a.congr b.congr a.source b.source
  target := ScalarPathConcatenation.target a.eval b.eval q r a.congr b.congr a.target b.target

def subpath {p q : Scalar} (a : Path p q) (s t : Point) : Path (a.eval s) (a.eval t) where
  eval u := a.eval (segment s t u)
  congr _ _ h := a.congr _ _ (segment_congr (Setoid.refl s) (Setoid.refl t) h)
  continuous U hU := (segmentContinuousData s t).continuous _ (a.continuous U hU)
  source := a.congr _ _ (segment_zero s t)
  target := a.congr _ _ (segment_one s t)

theorem subpath_whole {p q : Scalar} (a : Path p q) (u : Point) :
    (subpath a UnitInterval.zero UnitInterval.one).eval u ≈ a.eval u :=
  a.congr _ _ (segment_identity u)

theorem subpath_nested {p q : Scalar} (a : Path p q) (s t u v w : Point) :
    (subpath (subpath a s t) u v).eval w ≈
      (subpath a (segment s t u) (segment s t v)).eval w :=
  a.congr _ _ (Setoid.symm (segment_compose s t u v w))

theorem first_restriction {p q : Scalar} (a : Path p q) (s t u v : Point) :
    (subpath a s (segment s t u)).eval v ≈ (subpath a s t).eval (segment UnitInterval.zero u v) :=
  a.congr _ _ (segment_first_restriction s t u v)

theorem second_restriction {p q : Scalar} (a : Path p q) (s t u v : Point) :
    (subpath a (segment s t u) t).eval v ≈ (subpath a s t).eval (segment u UnitInterval.one v) :=
  a.congr _ _ (segment_second_restriction s t u v)

end ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.ScalarPaths

import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.FiniteFiberBasis

/-! Executable constant-operator exponential coefficients. The recurrence is
linear in the initial vector and uses arbitrary valid represented operators.
Convergence is proved separately. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.MatrixExponential
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory LocalSystem
variable {n : Nat}

def coefficient (A : ValueMap (Fiber n) (Fiber n)) (x : Fiber n) : Nat → Fiber n
  | 0 => x
  | k+1 => ratScale (1/((k+1 : Nat) : Rat)) (A.eval (coefficient A x k))

theorem coefficient_zero (A : ValueMap (Fiber n) (Fiber n)) (x : Fiber n) :
    coefficient A x 0 = x := rfl

theorem coefficient_succ (A : ValueMap (Fiber n) (Fiber n)) (x : Fiber n) (k : Nat) :
    coefficient A x (k+1) = ratScale (1/((k+1 : Nat) : Rat)) (A.eval (coefficient A x k)) := rfl

theorem coefficient_congr (A B : ValueMap (Fiber n) (Fiber n)) (hAB : A.Equiv B)
    (x y : Fiber n) (hxy : x ≈ y) (k : Nat) : coefficient A x k ≈ coefficient B y k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact hxy
  | succ k ih => exact ratScale_congr _ (Setoid.trans (A.congr ih) (hAB _))

theorem coefficient_add (A : ValueMap (Fiber n) (Fiber n)) (hA : IsLinear A)
    (x y : Fiber n) (k : Nat) :
    coefficient A (Fiber.add x y) k ≈ Fiber.add (coefficient A x k) (coefficient A y k) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact Setoid.refl _
  | succ k ih =>
      exact Setoid.trans
        (ratScale_congr _ (Setoid.trans (A.congr ih) (hA.1 _ _))) (ratScale_add _ _ _)

theorem coefficient_scale (A : ValueMap (Fiber n) (Fiber n)) (hA : IsLinear A)
    (c : Scalar) (x : Fiber n) (k : Nat) :
    coefficient A (Fiber.scale c x) k ≈ Fiber.scale c (coefficient A x k) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact Setoid.refl _
  | succ k ih =>
      exact Setoid.trans
        (ratScale_congr _ (Setoid.trans (A.congr ih) (hA.2 _ _))) (ratScale_scale _ _ _)

def coefficientMap (A : ValueMap (Fiber n) (Fiber n)) (k : Nat) : ValueMap (Fiber n) (Fiber n) :=
  ⟨fun x => coefficient A x k,
    fun h => coefficient_congr A A (fun _ => Setoid.refl _) _ _ h k⟩

theorem coefficientMap_linear (A : ValueMap (Fiber n) (Fiber n)) (hA : IsLinear A) (k : Nat) :
    IsLinear (coefficientMap A k) :=
  ⟨fun x y => coefficient_add A hA x y k, fun c x => coefficient_scale A hA c x k⟩

/-- The exact coefficient equation for the constant differential equation. -/
theorem coefficient_equation (A : ValueMap (Fiber n) (Fiber n)) (x : Fiber n) (k : Nat) :
    ratScale ((k+1 : Nat) : Rat) (coefficient A x (k+1)) ≈ A.eval (coefficient A x k) := by
  intro i
  exact LocalODE.cancel_scale ((k+1 : Nat) : Rat) (LocalODE.succCast_ne_zero k)
    ((A.eval (coefficient A x k)).val i) ((A.eval (coefficient A x k)).property i)

end ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.MatrixExponential

import ComputableAnalysis.ElementaryRational
import ComputableAnalysis.ComplexRawQuotientAlgebra

/-! Certified rational elementary series with input-dependent tail schedules.
The finite odd/even prefixes are computed before stabilization; agreement is
proved by shared finite witnesses, rather than assumed in a function record. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ElementaryPowerSeries
open ComplexRaw ComplexExponentialApproximation
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000

theorem normBound_neg (z : QComplex) : QComplex.normBound (QComplex.neg z) = QComplex.normBound z := by
  simp only [QComplex.normBound,QComplex.neg,qabs_neg]

theorem exponentialPrefix_future {z : QComplex} {C : Rat} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hz : QComplex.normBound z ≤ C) {first later : Nat} (hfl : first ≤ later) :
    (QBox.point (expPrefix z (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + later))).NestedIn
      (QBox.expand (QBox.point (expPrefix z (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + first)))
        (stageRadius C first)) := by
  let extra := later-first
  have hl : RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + later =
      (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + first)+extra := by dsimp [extra]; omega
  have hp := expPrefix_add z (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + first) extra
  rw [←hl] at hp
  have ht := tailPartial_normBound_le hC hz (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + first) extra
  have hm := RationalMajorant.factorialTailPartial_bound hC
    (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart_mono C _ first
      (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart_satisfies C)) extra
  have he : QComplex.normBound (tailPartial z
      (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + first) extra) ≤ stageRadius C first :=
    Rat.le_trans ht (by simpa [stageRadius] using hm)
  rw [hp]
  exact point_add_error_nested_expand _ _ he

theorem exponentialRaw_contains_future_prefix {z : QComplex} {C : Rat}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hz : QComplex.normBound z ≤ C) {first later : Nat} (hfl : first ≤ later) :
    (QBox.point (expPrefix z (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C + later))).NestedIn
      ((exponentialRawAt z C).compute first) :=
  cauchyStabilize_contains_external (candidate := directCandidate z C)
    (radius := stageRadius C)
    (external := fun n => QBox.point (expPrefix z (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C+n)))
    (fun _ _ h => exponentialPrefix_future hC hz h) _ _ hfl

def pair (odd : Bool) (a b : QComplex) : QComplex :=
  QComplex.scaleRat (1/2) (if odd then QComplex.sub a b else QComplex.add a b)

def pairPrefix (odd : Bool) (z : QComplex) (terms : Nat) : QComplex :=
  pair odd (expPrefix z terms) (expPrefix (QComplex.neg z) terms)

def pairCandidate (odd : Bool) (z : QComplex) (C : Rat) : ComplexRaw where
  compute n := QBox.point (pairPrefix odd z (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C+n))

theorem pairCandidate_future {z : QComplex} {C : Rat} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hz : QComplex.normBound z ≤ C) (odd : Bool) :
    ∀ first later, first ≤ later → ((pairCandidate odd z C).compute later).NestedIn
      (QBox.expand ((pairCandidate odd z C).compute first) (stageRadius C first)) := by
  intro first later hfl
  have ha := exponentialPrefix_future hC hz hfl
  have hb := exponentialPrefix_future hC (z := QComplex.neg z)
    (by rw [normBound_neg]; exact hz) hfl
  simp only [QBox.NestedIn,QBox.point,QBox.expand,QComplex.le_def,QComplex.neg] at ha hb
  change (QBox.point (pairPrefix odd z (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C+later))).NestedIn
    (QBox.expand (QBox.point (pairPrefix odd z (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart C+first))) _)
  unfold pairPrefix pair
  cases odd <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,if_true,QBox.NestedIn,
    QBox.point,QBox.expand,QComplex.scaleRat,QComplex.sub,QComplex.add,QComplex.neg,QComplex.le_def]
  all_goals constructor <;> constructor <;> grind only

def pairSeries (odd : Bool) (z : QComplex) : ComplexRaw :=
  cauchyStabilize (pairCandidate odd z (QComplex.normBound z)) (stageRadius (QComplex.normBound z))

theorem pairSeries_valid (odd : Bool) (z : QComplex) : (pairSeries odd z).Valid := by
  apply cauchyStabilize_valid
  · intro n; exact QComplex.le_refl _
  · intro eps; refine ⟨0,?_⟩; intro n _
    exact ⟨by simpa [pairCandidate,QBox.point,QBox.width,Rat.sub_self] using Rat.le_of_lt eps.property,
      by simpa [pairCandidate,QBox.point,QBox.height,Rat.sub_self] using Rat.le_of_lt eps.property⟩
  · exact pairCandidate_future (QComplex.normBound_nonneg z) Rat.le_refl odd
  · exact stageRadius_shrinks (QComplex.normBound_nonneg z)

def hyperbolicSineValue (z : QComplex) : ComplexRaw := pairSeries true z
def hyperbolicCosineValue (z : QComplex) : ComplexRaw := pairSeries false z
def sineValue (z : QComplex) : ComplexRaw :=
  mulI (neg (pairSeries true (QComplex.mul ElementaryRational.imaginaryUnit z)))
def cosineValue (z : QComplex) : ComplexRaw :=
  pairSeries false (QComplex.mul ElementaryRational.imaginaryUnit z)

theorem hyperbolicSineValue_valid (z : QComplex) : (hyperbolicSineValue z).Valid := pairSeries_valid _ _
theorem hyperbolicCosineValue_valid (z : QComplex) : (hyperbolicCosineValue z).Valid := pairSeries_valid _ _
theorem sineValue_valid (z : QComplex) : (sineValue z).Valid := mulI_valid (neg_valid (pairSeries_valid _ _))
theorem cosineValue_valid (z : QComplex) : (cosineValue z).Valid := pairSeries_valid _ _

def nativePair (odd : Bool) (z : QComplex) : ComplexRaw :=
  scaleRat (1/2) (if odd then sub (ElementaryRational.exponentialValue z)
    (ElementaryRational.exponentialValue (QComplex.neg z)) else
    add (ElementaryRational.exponentialValue z) (ElementaryRational.exponentialValue (QComplex.neg z)))

theorem nativePair_valid (odd : Bool) (z : QComplex) : (nativePair odd z).Valid := by
  unfold nativePair
  apply scaleRat_valid_of_nonneg (by decide +kernel)
  cases odd
  · exact add_valid (ElementaryRational.exponentialValue_valid _) (ElementaryRational.exponentialValue_valid _)
  · exact sub_valid (ElementaryRational.exponentialValue_valid _) (ElementaryRational.exponentialValue_valid _)

theorem pairSeries_agrees (odd : Bool) (z : QComplex) :
    (pairSeries odd z).Equiv (nativePair odd z) := by
  intro n
  let p := pairPrefix odd z (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart (QComplex.normBound z)+n)
  have ha := exponentialRaw_contains_future_prefix (QComplex.normBound_nonneg z)
    (z := z) Rat.le_refl (Nat.le_refl n)
  have hb := exponentialRaw_contains_future_prefix (QComplex.normBound_nonneg z)
    (z := QComplex.neg z) (by rw [normBound_neg]; exact Rat.le_refl) (Nat.le_refl n)
  have hp := cauchyStabilize_contains_current
    (pairCandidate_future (QComplex.normBound_nonneg z) Rat.le_refl odd) n
  have hn : ((nativePair odd z).compute n).lo ≤ p ∧ p ≤ ((nativePair odd z).compute n).hi := by
    have ha' : ((ElementaryRational.exponentialValue z).compute n).lo ≤
        expPrefix z (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart (QComplex.normBound z)+n) ∧
        expPrefix z (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart (QComplex.normBound z)+n) ≤
          ((ElementaryRational.exponentialValue z).compute n).hi := ha
    have hb' : ((ElementaryRational.exponentialValue (QComplex.neg z)).compute n).lo ≤
        expPrefix (QComplex.neg z) (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart (QComplex.normBound z)+n) ∧
        expPrefix (QComplex.neg z) (RationalMajorant.factorialTailStart (QComplex.normBound z)+n) ≤
          ((ElementaryRational.exponentialValue (QComplex.neg z)).compute n).hi := by
      simpa only [ElementaryRational.exponentialValue,normBound_neg,QBox.NestedIn,QBox.point] using hb
    cases odd
    · exact QBox.scaleRat_contains (QBox.add_contains ha'.1 ha'.2 hb'.1 hb'.2).1
        (QBox.add_contains ha'.1 ha'.2 hb'.1 hb'.2).2
    · have hs := QBox.add_contains ha'.1 ha'.2 (QBox.neg_contains hb').1 (QBox.neg_contains hb').2
      exact QBox.scaleRat_contains hs.1 hs.2
  apply (compareAt_overlap_iff _ _ n n).mpr
  exact QBox.overlaps_of_common_point hp hn

theorem rotation_half_equiv (z : ComplexRaw) (hz : z.Valid) :
    (mulI (neg (scaleRat (1/2) z))).Equiv (mul (ofQComplex ⟨0,-(1/2)⟩) z) := by
  intro n
  let p := (z.compute n).center
  have hp := QBox.center_mem (valid_ordered hz n)
  have hm := QBox.mul_contains (A := QBox.point ⟨0,-(1/2)⟩) (B := z.compute n)
    (z := ⟨0,-(1/2)⟩) (w := p) (QComplex.le_refl (⟨0,-(1/2)⟩ : QComplex))
    (QComplex.le_refl _) hp.1 hp.2
  apply (compareAt_overlap_iff _ _ n n).mpr
  apply QBox.overlaps_of_common_point (point := QComplex.mul ⟨0,-(1/2)⟩ p) _ hm
  simp only [mulI,neg,scaleRat,QBox.neg,QBox.scaleRat,Rat.neg_neg,
    if_pos (show (0:Rat) ≤ 1/2 by decide +kernel)]
  change (⟨(1/2)*(z.compute n).lo.im,-((1/2)*(z.compute n).hi.re)⟩ : QComplex) ≤
      QComplex.mul ⟨0,-(1/2)⟩ p ∧ QComplex.mul ⟨0,-(1/2)⟩ p ≤
      (⟨(1/2)*(z.compute n).hi.im,-((1/2)*(z.compute n).lo.re)⟩ : QComplex)
  simp only [QComplex.le_def,QComplex.mul,Rat.zero_mul,Rat.sub_eq_add_neg,Rat.zero_add]
  change (z.compute n).lo ≤ p ∧ p ≤ (z.compute n).hi at hp
  simp only [QComplex.le_def] at hp
  constructor <;> constructor <;> grind only

theorem sineValue_agrees (z : QComplex) : (sineValue z).Equiv (ElementaryRational.sineRadianValue z) := by
  unfold sineValue ElementaryRational.sineRadianValue
  apply equiv_trans (sineValue_valid z) (mulI_valid (neg_valid (nativePair_valid true _)))
    (ElementaryRational.sineRadianValue_valid z)
    (mulI_equiv (neg_equiv (pairSeries_agrees true _)))
  exact rotation_half_equiv _ (sub_valid (ElementaryRational.exponentialValue_valid _)
    (ElementaryRational.exponentialValue_valid _))

theorem cosineValue_agrees (z : QComplex) : (cosineValue z).Equiv (ElementaryRational.cosineRadianValue z) :=
  pairSeries_agrees false _
theorem hyperbolicSineValue_agrees (z : QComplex) :
    (hyperbolicSineValue z).Equiv (ElementaryRational.sinhValue z) := pairSeries_agrees true _
theorem hyperbolicCosineValue_agrees (z : QComplex) :
    (hyperbolicCosineValue z).Equiv (ElementaryRational.coshValue z) := pairSeries_agrees false _

def sine : FunctionRaw where

  compute z _ := (sineValue z).compute
def cosine : FunctionRaw where

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.ExponentialDerivative

/-! Actual entire sine/cosine solution computations. One calculation pairs
two scalar exponential series; the other evaluates the rotation matrix's
recursive Taylor coefficients. Their derivative laws are proved separately.
This module does not import elementary sine agreement theorems. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ElementarySineODE
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert DomainFunctions
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000

def zeroScalar : Scalar := ⟨zero,ofQComplex_valid _⟩
def iScalar : Scalar := ⟨ofQComplex ⟨0,1⟩,ofQComplex_valid _⟩
def sineFactor : Scalar := ⟨ofQComplex ⟨0,-(1/2)⟩,ofQComplex_valid _⟩
def halfScalar : Scalar := ⟨ofQComplex ⟨1/2,0⟩,ofQComplex_valid _⟩

def exponentialAt (a : Scalar) : DomainFunctions.Map where
  domain _ := True
  eval z _ := ModularForms.entireExponentialValue (scalarProduct a z)
  domain_congr _ _ _ := Iff.rfl
  eval_congr z w _ _ h := ModularForms.entireExponentialValue_congr _ _
    (mul_equiv a.property a.property z.property w.property (equiv_refl _ a.property) h)

def exponentialAt_holomorphic (a : Scalar) : DomainFunctions.Holomorphic (exponentialAt a) :=
  (ModularForms.entireExponential_holomorphic.compose (affine_holomorphic zeroScalar a)).transfer
    (exponentialAt a) (fun _ _ => ⟨trivial,trivial⟩)
    ⟨fun _ _ => unitError,fun _ _ _ _ => trivial⟩
    (fun z _ => ModularForms.entireExponentialValue_congr _ _
      (zero_add_equiv (mul a.val z.val) (mul_valid a.property z.property)))

theorem exponentialAt_derivative (a z : Scalar) :
    ((exponentialAt_holomorphic a).derivative z trivial).val.Equiv
      (mul ((exponentialAt a).eval z trivial).val a.val) := by
  let w := (DomainFunctions.affine zeroScalar a).eval z trivial
  have he : (ModularForms.entireExponentialValue w).val.Equiv
      ((exponentialAt a).eval z trivial).val :=
    ModularForms.entireExponentialValue_congr _ _
      (zero_add_equiv (mul a.val z.val) (mul_valid a.property z.property))
  exact mul_equiv
    (ModularForms.entireExponential_holomorphic.derivative w trivial).property
    ((exponentialAt a).eval z trivial).property a.property a.property
    (equiv_trans
      (ModularForms.entireExponential_holomorphic.derivative w trivial).property
      (ModularForms.entireExponentialValue w).property ((exponentialAt a).eval z trivial).property
      (ModularForms.entireExponential_derivative_value w) he)
    (equiv_refl _ a.property)

def positiveFrequency (a : Scalar) : Scalar := scalarProduct iScalar a
def negativeFrequency (a : Scalar) : Scalar := scalarNeg (positiveFrequency a)

def exponentialDifference (a : Scalar) : DomainFunctions.Map :=
  sumOn (exponentialAt (positiveFrequency a)) (negate (exponentialAt (negativeFrequency a)))
    (fun _ _ => trivial)
def exponentialSum (a : Scalar) : DomainFunctions.Map :=
  sumOn (exponentialAt (positiveFrequency a)) (exponentialAt (negativeFrequency a))
    (fun _ _ => trivial)

def sine (a : Scalar) : DomainFunctions.Map :=
  productOn (constantOn (fun _ : Scalar => True) ScalarTopology.wholeData.invariant sineFactor)
    (exponentialDifference a) (fun _ _ => trivial)
def cosine (a : Scalar) : DomainFunctions.Map :=
  productOn (constantOn (fun _ : Scalar => True) ScalarTopology.wholeData.invariant halfScalar)
    (exponentialSum a) (fun _ _ => trivial)

def sine_holomorphic (a : Scalar) : DomainFunctions.Holomorphic (sine a) :=
  (constantOn_holomorphic ScalarTopology.wholeData sineFactor).productOn
    ((exponentialAt_holomorphic (positiveFrequency a)).sumOn
      (exponentialAt_holomorphic (negativeFrequency a)).negate (fun _ _ => trivial))
    (fun _ _ => trivial)
def cosine_holomorphic (a : Scalar) : DomainFunctions.Holomorphic (cosine a) :=
  (constantOn_holomorphic ScalarTopology.wholeData halfScalar).productOn
    ((exponentialAt_holomorphic (positiveFrequency a)).sumOn
      (exponentialAt_holomorphic (negativeFrequency a)) (fun _ _ => trivial))
    (fun _ _ => trivial)

private theorem rationalProduct (p q : QComplex) :
    (mul (ofQComplex p) (ofQComplex q)).Equiv (ofQComplex (QComplex.mul p q)) :=
  equiv_trans (mul_valid (ofQComplex_valid _) (ofQComplex_valid _))
    (qcomplexLeftMul_valid p (ofQComplex_valid q)) (ofQComplex_valid _)
    (equiv_symm (qcomplexLeftMul_equiv_mul_ofQComplex p (ofQComplex_valid q)))
    (qcomplexLeftMul_ofQComplex p q)

private theorem sineFactor_i :
    (mul sineFactor.val iScalar.val).Equiv halfScalar.val := by
  simpa only [sineFactor,iScalar,halfScalar,
    show QComplex.mul ⟨0,-(1/2)⟩ ⟨0,1⟩ = ⟨1/2,0⟩ by decide +kernel] using
    rationalProduct ⟨0,-(1/2)⟩ ⟨0,1⟩

private theorem halfScalar_i :
    (mul halfScalar.val iScalar.val).Equiv (neg sineFactor.val) := by
  have h := rationalProduct ⟨1/2,0⟩ ⟨0,1⟩
  have he : QComplex.mul ⟨1/2,0⟩ ⟨0,1⟩ = ⟨0,1/2⟩ := by decide +kernel
  rw [he] at h
  apply equiv_trans (mul_valid halfScalar.property iScalar.property) (ofQComplex_valid _)
    (neg_valid sineFactor.property) h
  intro n
  apply (compareAt_overlap_iff _ _ n n).mpr
  change ((0:Rat)≤ -0 ∧ (1/2:Rat)≤ -(-(1/2))) ∧
    (-0≤ (0:Rat) ∧ -(-(1/2))≤ (1/2:Rat))
  decide +kernel

private theorem exponentialAt_derivative_quotient (a z : Scalar) :
    ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw ((exponentialAt_holomorphic a).derivative z trivial).val
      ((exponentialAt_holomorphic a).derivative z trivial).property =
    ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw ((exponentialAt a).eval z trivial).val
      ((exponentialAt a).eval z trivial).property * ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw a.val a.property :=
  ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_eq_ofRaw
    (hleft := ((exponentialAt_holomorphic a).derivative z trivial).property)
    (hright := mul_valid ((exponentialAt a).eval z trivial).property a.property)
    (exponentialAt_derivative a z)

theorem sine_derivative (a z : Scalar) :
    ((sine_holomorphic a).derivative z trivial).val.Equiv
      (mul a.val ((cosine a).eval z trivial).val) := by
  have hp := exponentialAt_derivative_quotient (positiveFrequency a) z
  have hm := exponentialAt_derivative_quotient (negativeFrequency a) z
  have hji := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_eq_ofRaw
    (hleft := mul_valid sineFactor.property iScalar.property) (hright := halfScalar.property) sineFactor_i
  apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
    (hleft := ((sine_holomorphic a).derivative z trivial).property)
    (hright := mul_valid a.property ((cosine a).eval z trivial).property)
  let A := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw a.val a.property
  let I := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw iScalar.val iScalar.property
  let J := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw sineFactor.val sineFactor.property
  let H := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw halfScalar.val halfScalar.property
  let P := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw ((exponentialAt (positiveFrequency a)).eval z trivial).val
    ((exponentialAt (positiveFrequency a)).eval z trivial).property
  let M := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw ((exponentialAt (negativeFrequency a)).eval z trivial).val
    ((exponentialAt (negativeFrequency a)).eval z trivial).property
  let DP := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw ((exponentialAt_holomorphic (positiveFrequency a)).derivative z trivial).val
    ((exponentialAt_holomorphic (positiveFrequency a)).derivative z trivial).property
  let DM := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw ((exponentialAt_holomorphic (negativeFrequency a)).derivative z trivial).val
    ((exponentialAt_holomorphic (negativeFrequency a)).derivative z trivial).property
  change DP=P*(I*A) at hp
  change DM=M*(-(I*A)) at hm
  change J*I=H at hji
  change 0*(P + -M)+J*(DP + -DM)=A*(H*(P+M))
  grind only

theorem cosine_derivative (a z : Scalar) :
    ((cosine_holomorphic a).derivative z trivial).val.Equiv
      (neg (mul a.val ((sine a).eval z trivial).val)) := by
  have hp := exponentialAt_derivative_quotient (positiveFrequency a) z
  have hm := exponentialAt_derivative_quotient (negativeFrequency a) z
  have hhi := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_eq_ofRaw
    (hleft := mul_valid halfScalar.property iScalar.property) (hright := neg_valid sineFactor.property) halfScalar_i
  apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
    (hleft := ((cosine_holomorphic a).derivative z trivial).property)
    (hright := neg_valid (mul_valid a.property ((sine a).eval z trivial).property))
  let A := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw a.val a.property
  let I := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw iScalar.val iScalar.property
  let J := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw sineFactor.val sineFactor.property
  let H := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw halfScalar.val halfScalar.property
  let P := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw ((exponentialAt (positiveFrequency a)).eval z trivial).val
    ((exponentialAt (positiveFrequency a)).eval z trivial).property
  let M := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw ((exponentialAt (negativeFrequency a)).eval z trivial).val
    ((exponentialAt (negativeFrequency a)).eval z trivial).property
  let DP := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw ((exponentialAt_holomorphic (positiveFrequency a)).derivative z trivial).val
    ((exponentialAt_holomorphic (positiveFrequency a)).derivative z trivial).property
  let DM := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw ((exponentialAt_holomorphic (negativeFrequency a)).derivative z trivial).val
    ((exponentialAt_holomorphic (negativeFrequency a)).derivative z trivial).property
  change DP=P*(I*A) at hp
  change DM=M*(-(I*A)) at hm
  change H*I= -J at hhi
  change 0*(P+M)+H*(DP+DM)= -(A*(J*(P + -M)))
  grind only

def pair (s c : Scalar) : Fiber 2 :=
  ⟨fun i => if i=0 then s.val else c.val,
    fun i => by dsimp; split <;> first | exact s.property | exact c.property⟩

def rotation (a : Scalar) : ValueMap (Fiber 2) (Fiber 2) where
  eval x := pair (scalarProduct a (Fiber.coordinate x 1))
    (scalarNeg (scalarProduct a (Fiber.coordinate x 0)))
  congr := by
    intro x y h i
    have hi : i=0 ∨ i=1 := by omega
    rcases hi with rfl | rfl
    · exact mul_equiv a.property a.property (x.property 1) (y.property 1) (equiv_refl _ a.property) (h 1)
    · exact neg_equiv (mul_equiv a.property a.property (x.property 0) (y.property 0) (equiv_refl _ a.property) (h 0))

theorem rotation_linear (a : Scalar) : IsLinear (rotation a) := by
  constructor
  · intro x y i
    have hi : i=0 ∨ i=1 := by omega
    rcases hi with rfl | rfl
    · exact mul_add_equiv a.val (x.val 1) (y.val 1) a.property (x.property 1) (y.property 1)
    · apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
        (hleft := ((rotation a).eval (Fiber.add x y)).property 1)
        (hright := (Fiber.add ((rotation a).eval x) ((rotation a).eval y)).property 1)
      let A := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw a.val a.property
      let X := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (x.val 0) (x.property 0)
      let Y := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (y.val 0) (y.property 0)
      change -(A*(X+Y))= -(A*X)+ -(A*Y)
      grind only
  · intro b x i
    have hi : i=0 ∨ i=1 := by omega
    rcases hi with rfl | rfl
    · apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
        (hleft := ((rotation a).eval (Fiber.scale b x)).property 0)
        (hright := (Fiber.scale b ((rotation a).eval x)).property 0)
      let A := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw a.val a.property
      let B := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw b.val b.property
      let X := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (x.val 1) (x.property 1)
      change A*(B*X)=B*(A*X)
      grind only
    · apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
        (hleft := ((rotation a).eval (Fiber.scale b x)).property 1)
        (hright := (Fiber.scale b ((rotation a).eval x)).property 1)
      let A := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw a.val a.property
      let B := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw b.val b.property
      let X := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (x.val 0) (x.property 0)
      change -(A*(B*X))=B*(-(A*X))
      grind only

def exponentialVector (a : Scalar) : DomainVectorFunctions.Map 2 where
  domain _ := True
  eval z _ := pair ((sine a).eval z trivial) ((cosine a).eval z trivial)
  domain_congr _ _ _ := Iff.rfl
  eval_congr z w _ _ h i := by
    have hi : i=0 ∨ i=1 := by omega
    rcases hi with rfl | rfl
    · exact (sine a).eval_congr z w trivial trivial h
    · exact (cosine a).eval_congr z w trivial trivial h

def exponentialVector_holomorphic (a : Scalar) : DomainVectorFunctions.Holomorphic (exponentialVector a) where
  openDomain := ⟨fun _ _ => unitError,fun _ _ _ _ => trivial⟩
  coordinates i := by
    by_cases hi : i=0
    · subst i
      exact (sine_holomorphic a).transfer _ (fun _ _ => trivial)
        ⟨fun _ _ => unitError,fun _ _ _ _ => trivial⟩
        (fun z _ => equiv_refl _ ((sine a).eval z trivial).property)
    · have hi1 : i=1 := by omega
      subst i
      exact (cosine_holomorphic a).transfer _ (fun _ _ => trivial)
        ⟨fun _ _ => unitError,fun _ _ _ _ => trivial⟩
        (fun z _ => equiv_refl _ ((cosine a).eval z trivial).property)

theorem exponentialVector_ode (a : Scalar) :
    CoordinateConnection.Horizontal (exponentialVector a) (exponentialVector_holomorphic a)
      (fun _ _ => rotation a) := by
  intro z _ i
  have hi : i=0 ∨ i=1 := by omega
  rcases hi with rfl | rfl
  · exact sine_derivative a z
  · exact cosine_derivative a z

theorem exponentialAt_zero (a : Scalar) :
    ((exponentialAt a).eval zeroScalar trivial).val.Equiv one :=
  equiv_trans ((exponentialAt a).eval zeroScalar trivial).property
    (ModularForms.entireExponentialValue zeroScalar).property (ofQComplex_valid _)
    (ModularForms.entireExponentialValue_congr _ _ (mul_zero_equiv a.val a.property))
    ModularForms.entireExponential_zero

private theorem two_halves : (add halfScalar.val halfScalar.val).Equiv one := by
  intro n
  apply (compareAt_overlap_iff _ _ n n).mpr
  change ((1/2:Rat)+(1/2)≤1 ∧ (0:Rat)+0≤0) ∧ (1≤(1/2:Rat)+(1/2) ∧ 0≤(0:Rat)+0)
  decide +kernel

def initial : Fiber 2 := pair zeroScalar oneScalar

theorem exponentialVector_initial (a : Scalar) :
    (exponentialVector a).eval zeroScalar trivial ≈ initial := by
  have hp := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_eq_ofRaw
    (hleft := ((exponentialAt (positiveFrequency a)).eval zeroScalar trivial).property)
    (hright := ofQComplex_valid _) (exponentialAt_zero (positiveFrequency a))
  have hm := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_eq_ofRaw
    (hleft := ((exponentialAt (negativeFrequency a)).eval zeroScalar trivial).property)
    (hright := ofQComplex_valid _) (exponentialAt_zero (negativeFrequency a))
  have hh := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_eq_ofRaw
    (hleft := add_valid halfScalar.property halfScalar.property) (hright := ofQComplex_valid _) two_halves
  let P := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw ((exponentialAt (positiveFrequency a)).eval zeroScalar trivial).val
    ((exponentialAt (positiveFrequency a)).eval zeroScalar trivial).property
  let M := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw ((exponentialAt (negativeFrequency a)).eval zeroScalar trivial).val
    ((exponentialAt (negativeFrequency a)).eval zeroScalar trivial).property
  change P=1 at hp
  change M=1 at hm
  intro i
  have hi : i=0 ∨ i=1 := by omega
  rcases hi with rfl | rfl
  · apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
      (hleft := ((exponentialVector a).eval zeroScalar trivial).property 0)
      (hright := initial.property 0)
    let J := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw sineFactor.val sineFactor.property
    change J*(P + -M)=0
    rw [hp,hm]
    grind only
  · apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
      (hleft := ((exponentialVector a).eval zeroScalar trivial).property 1)
      (hright := initial.property 1)
    let H := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw halfScalar.val halfScalar.property
    change H+H=1 at hh
    change H*(P+M)=1
    rw [hp,hm]
    grind only

/-- The second computation is the actual executable matrix Taylor sum, with
coefficients determined by the rotation generator and initial vector. -/
def seriesVector (a : Scalar) : DomainVectorFunctions.Map 2 :=
  MatrixExponential.vector (rotation a) (rotation_linear a) initial
def seriesVector_holomorphic (a : Scalar) : DomainVectorFunctions.Holomorphic (seriesVector a) :=
  MatrixExponential.vector_holomorphic (rotation a) (rotation_linear a) initial

theorem seriesVector_ode (a : Scalar) :
    CoordinateConnection.Horizontal (seriesVector a) (seriesVector_holomorphic a)
      (fun _ _ => rotation a) :=
  fun z _ => MatrixExponential.vector_derivative_ode (rotation a) (rotation_linear a) initial z

theorem seriesVector_initial (a : Scalar) :
    (seriesVector a).eval zeroScalar trivial ≈ initial :=
  MatrixExponential.value_initial (rotation a) (rotation_linear a) initial

/-- Both independently justified solution calculations agree on the whole
represented complex plane. The proof uses ODE uniqueness, not a sine identity
or coefficient comparison between the two calculations. -/
theorem computations_agree_global (a z : Scalar) :
    (exponentialVector a).eval z trivial ≈ (seriesVector a).eval z trivial :=
  MatrixExponential.constant_ode_entire_unique (rotation a) (rotation_linear a)
    (exponentialVector a) (seriesVector a) (exponentialVector_holomorphic a) (seriesVector_holomorphic a)
    (fun _ => trivial) (fun _ => trivial) (exponentialVector_ode a) (seriesVector_ode a)
    zeroScalar (Setoid.trans (exponentialVector_initial a) (Setoid.symm (seriesVector_initial a))) z

theorem rotation_scaled (a : Scalar) :
    (rotation a).Equiv (OperatorPower.scaled (rotation oneScalar) a) := by
  intro x i
  have hi : i=0 ∨ i=1 := by omega
  rcases hi with rfl | rfl
  · exact equiv_symm (mul_equiv a.property a.property
      (mul_valid oneScalar.property (x.property 1)) (x.property 1)
      (equiv_refl _ a.property) (one_mul_equiv (x.val 1) (x.property 1)))
  · apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
      (hleft := ((rotation a).eval x).property 1)
      (hright := ((OperatorPower.scaled (rotation oneScalar) a).eval x).property 1)
    let A := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw a.val a.property
    let X := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (x.val 0) (x.property 0)
    change -(A*X)=A*(-(1*X))
    grind only

/-- Scaling the frequency is exactly a coordinate pullback, including
arbitrary represented irrational coefficients. -/
theorem seriesVector_reparametrization (a z : Scalar) :
    (seriesVector a).eval z trivial ≈ (seriesVector oneScalar).eval (scalarProduct a z) trivial :=
  Setoid.trans
    (MatrixExponential.value_congr (rotation a) (OperatorPower.scaled (rotation oneScalar) a)
      (rotation_linear a) (OperatorPower.scaled_linear (rotation oneScalar) (rotation_linear oneScalar) a)
      (rotation_scaled a) z z (equiv_refl _ z.property) initial initial (Setoid.refl initial))
    (MatrixExponential.value_scaled_operator (rotation oneScalar) (rotation_linear oneScalar) a z initial)

theorem scaled_sine_agrees_global (a z : Scalar) :
    ((sine a).eval z trivial).val.Equiv
      (((seriesVector oneScalar).eval (scalarProduct a z) trivial).val 0) :=
  Setoid.trans (computations_agree_global a z) (seriesVector_reparametrization a z) 0

import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.EntireExponentialHolomorphic
import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.LinearDifference

/-! The actual entire exponential satisfies the constant linear ODE. Finite
prefix equations and independently shrinking value and derivative tails
prove the identity; it is not an assumed property of a certificate. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.MatrixExponential
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory LocalSystem LocalODE
variable {n : Nat}

theorem derivativeTerm_image (A : ValueMap (Fiber n) (Fiber n)) (hA : IsLinear A)
    (x : Fiber n) (z : Scalar) (k : Nat) (i : Fin n) :
    (BoundedSeries.derivativeTerm (fun j => (coefficient A x j).val i) z.val k).Equiv
      ((A.eval (VectorSeries.term (coefficient A x) z k)).val i) := by
  let p : Scalar := ⟨power z.val k, power_valid z.val z.property k⟩
  let v := coefficient A x (k+1)
  have hc : ratScale ((k+1 : Nat) : Rat) (Fiber.scale p v) ≈
      A.eval (Fiber.scale p (coefficient A x k)) :=
    Setoid.trans (ratScale_scale _ p v)
      (Setoid.trans (Fiber.scale_congr (equiv_refl _ p.property) (coefficient_equation A x k))
        (Setoid.symm (hA.2 p _)))
  exact equiv_trans (BoundedSeries.derivativeTerm_valid _ z.val (fun j => (coefficient A x j).property i) z.property k)
    ((ratScale ((k+1 : Nat) : Rat) (Fiber.scale p v)).property i)
    ((A.eval (VectorSeries.term (coefficient A x) z k)).property i)
    (scaleRat_equiv (mul_comm_equiv (v.val i) p.val (v.property i) p.property)) (hc i)

theorem derivativeBlock_image (A : ValueMap (Fiber n) (Fiber n)) (hA : IsLinear A)
    (x : Fiber n) (z : Scalar) (N : Nat) (i : Fin n) :
    (BoundedSeries.derivativeBlock (fun j => (coefficient A x j).val i) z.val 0 N).Equiv
      ((A.eval (VectorSeries.block (coefficient A x) z 0 N)).val i) := by
  induction N with
  | zero => exact equiv_symm (hA.zero i)
  | succ N ih =>
      change (add (BoundedSeries.derivativeBlock (fun j => (coefficient A x j).val i) z.val 0 N)
        (BoundedSeries.derivativeTerm (fun j => (coefficient A x j).val i) z.val (0+N))).Equiv _
      simp only [Nat.zero_add]
      have hv : (add (BoundedSeries.derivativeBlock (fun j => (coefficient A x j).val i) z.val 0 N)
          (BoundedSeries.derivativeTerm (fun j => (coefficient A x j).val i) z.val N)).Valid :=
        add_valid
          (BoundedSeries.derivativeBlock_valid (fun j => (coefficient A x j).val i) z.val
            (fun j => (coefficient A x j).property i) z.property 0 N)
          (BoundedSeries.derivativeTerm_valid (fun j => (coefficient A x j).val i) z.val
            (fun j => (coefficient A x j).property i) z.property N)
      exact equiv_trans
        hv
        ((Fiber.add (A.eval (VectorSeries.block (coefficient A x) z 0 N))
          (A.eval (VectorSeries.term (coefficient A x) z N))).property i)
        ((A.eval (VectorSeries.block (coefficient A x) z 0 (N+1))).property i)
        (add_equiv ih (derivativeTerm_image A hA x z N i))
        (by simpa only [VectorSeries.block, vectorBlock, Nat.zero_add] using
          equiv_symm (hA.1 (VectorSeries.block (coefficient A x) z 0 N)
            (VectorSeries.term (coefficient A x) z N) i))

theorem onDisc_derivative_ode (A : ValueMap (Fiber n) (Fiber n)) (hA : IsLinear A)
    (R : QPos) (x : Fiber n) (z : Scalar) (hz : interior R.val z) :
    DomainVectorFunctions.derivative (discVector A hA R x) (discVector_holomorphic A hA R x) z hz ≈
      A.eval ((onDisc A hA R z hz).eval x) := by
  let M := discBudget A R.val
  let K := rate R.val
  let E := LocalSystem.initialBound x
  let C := 2*M*E
  let B := ValueMap.linearBound A
  let D := DomainVectorFunctions.derivative (discVector A hA R x) (discVector_holomorphic A hA R x) z hz
  let Y := (onDisc A hA R z hz).eval x
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := discBudget_nonneg A R.val
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := Rat.le_of_lt (rate_pos R.val (Rat.le_of_lt R.property))
  have hE : 0 ≤ E := LocalSystem.initialBound_nonneg x
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide) hM) hE
  have hR := Rat.le_of_lt R.property
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := ValueMap.linearBound_nonneg A
  have hq : 0 ≤ 2*K*R.val := Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide) hK) hR
  have h8 : 8*K*R.val ≤ (1 : Rat)/2 := rate_small R.val hR
  have h2 : 2*K*R.val ≤ (1 : Rat)/2 := by grind
  have h4 : 4*K*R.val ≤ (1 : Rat)/2 := by grind
  have he := RepresentedCauchySum.sum_shrinks _ _ (derivativeTail_shrinks C K R.val hC hK hR h4)
    (SeriesLimitLaws.shrinks_scale _ (operatorError_shrinks M E K R.val hM hE hK hR h2) B hB)
  intro i
  apply SeriesLimitLaws.equiv_of_small_sub_zero
  apply SeriesLimitLaws.small_closed _ 0 _ he
  intro N
  let p := VectorSeries.block (coefficient A x) z 0 N
  have hleft := BoundedSeries.sumDerivative_close_prefix (fun j => (coefficient A x j).val i) z.val
    (fun j => (coefficient A x j).property i) z.property C K R.val hC hK hR
    (fun j => operatorCoefficient_bound (coefficientMap A) M K E hE (disc_majorant A hA R.val hR)
      x (LocalSystem.initialBound_valid x) j i) (interior_bound R.val z hz) h4 N
  have hl : Small (sub (D.val i) ((A.eval p).val i)) (derivativeTail C K R.val N) :=
    Small.congr
      (sub_valid (D.property i) (BoundedSeries.derivativeBlock_valid _ z.val
        (fun j => (coefficient A x j).property i) z.property 0 N))
      (sub_valid (D.property i) ((A.eval p).property i))
      (FunctionTheory.sub_congr (equiv_refl _ (D.property i)) (derivativeBlock_image A hA x z N i)) hleft
  have hy : CoordinateBound (Fiber.sub Y p) (8*M*E*(2*K*R.val)^N) :=
    operatorValue_close (coefficientMap A) z M K R.val E hM hK hR hE
      (disc_majorant A hA R.val hR) (interior_bound R.val z hz) h2 x (LocalSystem.initialBound_valid x) N
  have hb : 0 ≤ 8*M*E*(2*K*R.val)^N :=
    Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide) hM) hE) (Rat.pow_nonneg hq)
  have hr := ValueMap.difference_bound A hA B (ValueMap.linear_bound A hA) _ hb Y p hy
  have hs := LocalODE.small_add hl
    (RepresentedCauchySum.small_sub_symm _ _ _ (hr i))
  have hc := Small.congr
    (add_valid (sub_valid (D.property i) ((A.eval p).property i))
      (sub_valid ((A.eval p).property i) ((A.eval Y).property i)))
    (sub_valid (D.property i) ((A.eval Y).property i))
    (equiv_symm (Fiber.difference_split D (A.eval Y) (A.eval p) i)) hs
  simpa only [Rat.zero_add] using hc

/-- Exact derivative identity on the whole represented complex plane. -/
theorem vector_derivative_ode (A : ValueMap (Fiber n) (Fiber n)) (hA : IsLinear A)
    (x : Fiber n) (z : Scalar) :
    DomainVectorFunctions.derivative (vector A hA x) (vector_holomorphic A hA x) z True.intro ≈
      A.eval ((value A hA z).eval x) :=
  onDisc_derivative_ode A hA (pointRadius z) x z (pointRadius_inside z)

/-- The equation applies to every independently justified holomorphic
witness, rather than to an internal derivative name alone. -/
theorem vector_derivative_ode_of_holomorphic (A : ValueMap (Fiber n) (Fiber n)) (hA : IsLinear A)
    (x : Fiber n) (hH : DomainVectorFunctions.Holomorphic (vector A hA x)) (z : Scalar) :
    DomainVectorFunctions.derivative (vector A hA x) hH z True.intro ≈ A.eval ((value A hA z).eval x) :=
  Setoid.trans (DomainVectorFunctions.derivative_unique _ hH (vector_holomorphic A hA x) z True.intro)
    (vector_derivative_ode A hA x z)

theorem derivative_ode_congr (A B : ValueMap (Fiber n) (Fiber n)) (hA : IsLinear A) (hB : IsLinear B)
    (hAB : A.Equiv B) (x y : Fiber n) (hxy : x ≈ y) (z w : Scalar) (hzw : z.val.Equiv w.val)
    (hH : DomainVectorFunctions.Holomorphic (vector A hA x))
    (hJ : DomainVectorFunctions.Holomorphic (vector B hB y)) :
    DomainVectorFunctions.derivative (vector A hA x) hH z True.intro ≈
      DomainVectorFunctions.derivative (vector B hB y) hJ w True.intro :=
  Setoid.trans (vector_derivative_ode_of_holomorphic A hA x hH z)
    (Setoid.trans (Setoid.trans (A.congr (value_congr A B hA hB hAB z w hzw x y hxy)) (hAB _))
      (Setoid.symm (vector_derivative_ode_of_holomorphic B hB y hJ w)))

end ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.MatrixExponential

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.EntireExponential

/-! The factorial exponential satisfies its actual derivative equation. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert

 theorem exponentialCoefficient_shift (n : Nat) :
    (scaleRat ((n+1 : Nat) : Rat) (exponentialCoefficients (n+1))).Equiv
      (exponentialCoefficients n) := by
  have he := congrFun FormalPowerSeries.expCoeff_derivative n
  change ((n+1 : Nat) : Rat)*(1/factorialRat (n+1))=1/factorialRat n at he
  have hp : 0 ≤ ((n+1 : Nat) : Rat) := Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.natCast_pos.mpr (Nat.succ_pos n))
  intro k
  apply (compareAt_overlap_iff _ _ k k).mpr
  simp only [scaleRat, exponentialCoefficients, ofQComplex, QBox.scaleRat, if_pos hp,
    QBox.Overlaps, QComplex.le_def, he, Rat.mul_zero]
  exact ⟨⟨Rat.le_refl,Rat.le_refl⟩,⟨Rat.le_refl,Rat.le_refl⟩⟩

theorem exponentialDerivativeTerm (z : Scalar) (n : Nat) :
    (BoundedSeries.derivativeTerm exponentialCoefficients z.val n).Equiv
      (LocalODE.seriesTerm exponentialCoefficients z.val n) := by
  have h := scaleRat_mul_equiv ((n+1 : Nat) : Rat) (exponentialCoefficients (n+1))
    (LocalODE.power z.val n) (exponentialCoefficients_valid _) (LocalODE.power_valid _ z.property _)
  exact equiv_trans
    (BoundedSeries.derivativeTerm_valid _ _ exponentialCoefficients_valid z.property n)
    (mul_valid (scaleRat_valid (exponentialCoefficients_valid _)) (LocalODE.power_valid _ z.property _))
    (LocalODE.seriesTerm_valid _ _ exponentialCoefficients_valid z.property n) h
    (mul_equiv (scaleRat_valid (exponentialCoefficients_valid _)) (exponentialCoefficients_valid _)
      (LocalODE.power_valid _ z.property _) (LocalODE.power_valid _ z.property _)
      (exponentialCoefficient_shift n) (equiv_refl _ (LocalODE.power_valid _ z.property _)))

/-- The independently constructed sum of derivative terms equals the value sum. -/
theorem exponentialChart_derivative_value (R : QPos) (z : Scalar)
    (hz : (exponentialChart R).domain z) :
    ((exponentialChart_holomorphic R).derivative z).Equiv ((exponentialChart R).eval z) := by
  let K := exponentialRatio R
  let C := exponentialBudget K
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := Rat.le_of_lt (exponentialRatio_positive R)
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := exponentialBudget_nonnegative K (exponentialRatio_positive R)
  have hR : 0 ≤ R.val := Rat.le_of_lt R.property
  have hzB := LocalODE.interior_bound R.val z hz
  have hcB := exponentialCoefficients_small K (exponentialRatio_positive R)
  have h8 := exponentialRatio_local R
  have hq : 0 ≤ 4*K*R.val := Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide +kernel) hK) hR
  have hr : 0 ≤ 2*K*R.val := Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide +kernel) hK) hR
  have h4 : 4*K*R.val ≤ (1 : Rat)/2 := by change 8*K*R.val ≤ (1 : Rat)/2 at h8; grind only
  have h2 : 2*K*R.val ≤ (1 : Rat)/2 := by grind only
  apply ScalarSeries.value_congr
    (BoundedSeries.derivativeTerm exponentialCoefficients z.val)
    (LocalODE.seriesTerm exponentialCoefficients z.val)
    (BoundedSeries.derivativeTerm_valid _ _ exponentialCoefficients_valid z.property)
    (LocalODE.seriesTerm_valid _ _ exponentialCoefficients_valid z.property)
    (C*K) (4*K*R.val) C (2*K*R.val) (Rat.mul_nonneg hC hK) hq hC hr h4 h2
  · intro n
    simpa only [Rat.mul_assoc] using BoundedSeries.derivativeTerm_majorant
      exponentialCoefficients z.val exponentialCoefficients_valid z.property C K R.val hC hK hR hcB hzB n
  · exact LocalODE.seriesTerm_bound exponentialCoefficients z.val exponentialCoefficients_valid
      z.property C K R.val hC hK hR hcB hzB
  · exact exponentialDerivativeTerm z

/-- The actual entire exponential has derivative equal to its value. -/
theorem entireExponential_derivative_value (z : Scalar) :
    (entireExponential_holomorphic.derivative z trivial).val.Equiv
      (entireExponentialValue z).val :=
  equiv_trans (entireExponential_holomorphic.derivative z trivial).property
    (entireExponentialValue z).property (entireExponentialValue z).property
    (exponentialChart_derivative_value (exponentialInputRadius z) z (exponentialInputRadius_mem z))
    (equiv_refl _ (entireExponentialValue z).property)

/-- The entire factorial exponential is normalized to one at zero. -/
theorem entireExponential_zero :
    (entireExponentialValue ⟨zero,ofQComplex_valid _⟩).val.Equiv (ofQComplex QComplex.one) := by
  let R : QPos := ⟨1,by decide +kernel⟩
  let z : Scalar := ⟨zero,ofQComplex_valid _⟩
  have hz : (exponentialChart R).domain z :=
    ⟨0,Rat.le_refl,R.property,Small.zero Rat.le_refl⟩
  have hinit := BoundedSeries.seriesMap_initial exponentialCoefficients exponentialCoefficients_valid
    (exponentialBudget (exponentialRatio R)) (exponentialRatio R) R.val
    (exponentialBudget_nonnegative _ (exponentialRatio_positive R))
    (Rat.le_of_lt (exponentialRatio_positive R)) (Rat.le_of_lt R.property)
    (exponentialCoefficients_small _ (exponentialRatio_positive R)) (exponentialRatio_local R)
  have hc : (exponentialCoefficients 0).Equiv (ofQComplex QComplex.one) := by
    intro k
    apply (compareAt_overlap_iff _ _ k k).mpr
    change ((1 : Rat)/((1 : Nat) : Rat) ≤ 1 ∧ (0 : Rat) ≤ 0) ∧
      ((1 : Rat) ≤ (1 : Rat)/((1 : Nat) : Rat) ∧ (0 : Rat) ≤ 0)
    decide +kernel
  exact equiv_trans (entireExponentialValue z).property
    ((exponentialChart R).valid z hz) (ofQComplex_valid _)
    (equiv_symm (entireExponential_chart R z hz))
    (equiv_trans ((exponentialChart R).valid z hz) (exponentialCoefficients_valid 0)
      (ofQComplex_valid _) hinit hc)

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.ExponentialRationalConjugation
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.ExponentialCenterApproximation
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.ExponentialAddition

/-! Actual entire exponential conjugation at every valid represented complex input. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open ComplexRaw RiemannHilbert FunctionTheory

def exponentialConjugateInput (z : Scalar) : Scalar := ⟨conj z.val,conj_valid _ z.property⟩

theorem exponentialCenterError_nonnegative (z : Scalar) (n : Nat) : 0≤exponentialCenterError z n := by
  have hC := exponentialBudget_nonnegative _ (exponentialRatio_positive (exponentialInputRadius z))
  have hK := Rat.le_of_lt (exponentialRatio_positive (exponentialInputRadius z))
  exact Rat.mul_nonneg
    (Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide) hC) (Rat.pow_nonneg hK))
    (centerError_nonnegative z.val z.property n)

theorem rationalCenter_conjugation (z : Scalar) (n : Nat) :
    rationalCenter (exponentialConjugateInput z) n =
      (⟨ofQComplex (QComplex.conj (z.val.compute n).center),ofQComplex_valid _⟩ : Scalar) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change ofQComplex (QBox.conj (z.val.compute n)).center = ofQComplex (QComplex.conj (z.val.compute n).center)
  congr 1
  simp only [QBox.center,QBox.conj,QComplex.conj]
  congr 1 <;> grind only

theorem entireExponential_conjugation (z : Scalar) :
    (conj (entireExponentialValue z).val).Equiv (entireExponentialValue (exponentialConjugateInput z)).val := by
  let w := exponentialConjugateInput z
  apply conjugateLimit_comparison _ _ (entireExponentialValue z).property (entireExponentialValue w).property
    (fun n => (entireExponentialValue (rationalCenter z n)).val)
    (fun n => (entireExponentialValue (rationalCenter w n)).val)
    (fun n => (entireExponentialValue (rationalCenter z n)).property)
    (fun n => (entireExponentialValue (rationalCenter w n)).property)
    (exponentialCenterError z) (exponentialCenterError w)
    (exponentialCenterError_shrinks z) (exponentialCenterError_shrinks w)
    (exponentialCenterError_nonnegative z) (exponentialCenterError_nonnegative w)
    (exponential_center_error z) (exponential_center_error w)
  intro n
  dsimp [w]
  rw [rationalCenter_conjugation z n]
  exact entireExponential_rational_conjugation (z.val.compute n).center

theorem entireExponential_conjugate_product (z : Scalar) :
    (mul (entireExponentialValue z).val (conj (entireExponentialValue z).val)).Equiv
      (entireExponentialValue ⟨add z.val (conj z.val),add_valid z.property (conj_valid _ z.property)⟩).val := by
  have he := mul_equiv (entireExponentialValue z).property (entireExponentialValue z).property
    (conj_valid _ (entireExponentialValue z).property)
    (entireExponentialValue (exponentialConjugateInput z)).property
    (equiv_refl _ (entireExponentialValue z).property) (entireExponential_conjugation z)
  exact equiv_trans
    (mul_valid (entireExponentialValue z).property (conj_valid _ (entireExponentialValue z).property))
    (mul_valid (entireExponentialValue z).property (entireExponentialValue (exponentialConjugateInput z)).property)
    (entireExponentialValue ⟨add z.val (conj z.val),add_valid z.property (conj_valid _ z.property)⟩).property
    he (entireExponential_addition z (exponentialConjugateInput z))

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
